Bis zum 1. Juli gehörte unser Geschäft zur BASF. Im Rahmen der aktuellen Übergangsphase werden alle Stellenausschreibungen und der Bewerbungsprozess weiterhin auf der BASF-Plattform gehostet und daher vollständig im BASF-Branding angezeigt. Bitte lassen Sie sich davon nicht beirren: Alle Stellen sind Positionen bei Surventis und Ihre Bewerbung wird an uns übermittelt. Bei Surventis stellen wir die Kundinnen und Kunden in den Mittelpunkt, denken einen Schritt voraus und entwickeln Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert und nachhaltige Partnerschaften schaffen - we ge beyond the surface. Wir inspirieren einander, weiterzudenken, Verantwortung für unsere Arbeit zu übernehmen und ständig danach zu streben, das Mögliche zu erweitern. Wenn Sie Ihre ganze Persönlichkeit einbringen, das Offensichtliche hinterfragen und mit einem Team wachsen möchten, das es ernst meint – dann sind Sie hier richtig. Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Entwicklung von Marketing und Kommunikationsaktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Employer Branding für unsere Standorte in Münster sowie Würzburg und bringst dabei eigene Ideen ein. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen mit Studenten:innen oder Mitarbeiter:innen, wie z.B. Recruiting-Events oder Inhouse Veranstaltungen. Zudem bringst Du Deine Kreativität bei der Gestaltung von Werbematerialien und Flyern ein. Nicht zuletzt wirkst Du im Tagesgeschäft mit und unterstützt bei Recherchen sowie Präsentationen. WAS DU MITBRINGST Bachelor- oder Masterstudent:in der Medien-, Kommunikations-, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbare Studiengänge Begeisterung für Themen im Bereich des (Personal-) Marketings und Projektmanagement Spaß am Organisieren von Events fließende Deutschkenntnisse selbständige Arbeitsweise, kreativ und kommunikativ WAS WIR BIETEN Du bist vom ersten Tag an Teil des Surventis-Teams. Wir bieten eine attraktive Praktikantenvergütung zwischen 1000 und 1200 € pro Monat, sowie die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten. Du kannst unser modernes Fitnessstudio sowie weitere Fitnessangebote vergünstigt nutzen und Deine Pausen in unserem Betriebsrestaurant verbringen. Bei uns steigst Du in anspruchsvolle Arbeitsgebiete ein und übernimmst spannende Aufgaben und nach Möglichkeit Teilprojekte in einem interdisziplinären Arbeitsumfeld. Ergänzend bieten die Surventis Standorte unterschiedliche Möglichkeiten wie Führungen oder Workshops an, um Surventis näher kennen zu lernen. SO ERREICHST DU UNS Bekim Krasniqi (Talent Acquisition), bekim.krasniqi@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56136 beantwortet gerne Deine Fragen zu dieser Position. jobs.description: FRENCH Nous embauchons! Canada Test Si vous avez… Créez votre propre chimie avec you@BASF Ajouter de la valeur à nos clients commence par ajouter de la valeur à vous. you@BASF est l'ensemble d'avantages, d'avantages supplémentaires, de programmes et d'opportunités uniques que nous offrons pour vous soutenir - tout entier - dans toutes les étapes de votre vie et de votre carrière. Avec you@BASF, vous créez votre propre chimie. Les récompenses totales que vous recevez en tant qu'employé de BASF vont bien au-delà d'un simple salaire. Des régimes de santé et d'assurance compétitifs aux avantages de retraite solides qui incluent des contributions correspondantes de l'entreprise, en passant par l'assurance que vous ne cessez jamais d'apprendre, nous croyons que investir en vous, c'est investir dans notre succès. Travailler pour une grande organisation mondiale vous donnera l'occasion de vous développer professionnellement et personnellement, d'étendre votre réseau et de construire une carrière enrichissante et dynamique. Nous offrons également des opportunités d'apprentissage et de développement stimulantes pour vous aider à tirer le meilleur parti de vos talents et de votre rôle. À propos de nous En tant que leader mondial de l'industrie chimique, nous trouvons des solutions pour répondre à vos besoins quotidiens et relever les défis économiques, environnementaux et de durabilité les plus complexes depuis plus de 150 ans! Nous nous efforçons constamment de devenir un lieu de travail encore meilleur. Grâce à notre engagement envers nos employés, BASF a remporté plusieurs prix, notamment la reconnaissance de Mediacorp en 2024 en tant que l'un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada pour la dixième année consécutive, l'un des meilleurs employeurs de la région du Grand Toronto pour la onzième année consécutive, et deux fois nommé l'un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada pour les jeunes et les meilleurs employeurs en matière de diversité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail épanouissant avec une forte emphase sur la sécurité physique et psychologique de nos employés et des communautés dans lesquelles nous opérons. Nous travaillons toujours à former la meilleure équipe en mettant l'accent sur la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, ainsi que sur l'apprentissage et le développement tout au long de la vie. Faites partie de quelque chose de plus grand. #belongatBASF Déclaration de confidentialité BASF prend la sécurité et la confidentialité des données très au sérieux. Nous ne demanderons jamais d’informations personnelles ou financières de quelque nature que ce soit via un message texte ou un message direct sur une plate-forme de médias sociaux ou un site d’emploi. De plus, nous n’offrirons jamais un poste à un candidat et ne demanderons jamais un chèque pour de l’équipement ou tout autre type de paiement pendant le processus de demande d’emploi. Si vous avez rencontré l’un des points ci-dessus, veuillez contacter myhr@basf.com pour signaler une fraude. Transparence Salariale Inclusion et égalité des chances d’emploi BASF est dédié à la création d'un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où nos employés peuvent être eux-mêmes en toute authenticité. Nous sommes un employeur offrant des chances égales, et toutes les personnes qualifiées recevront une considération pour l'emploi sans égard à la race, à l'âge, à la citoyenneté, au lieu d'origine, à l'origine ethnique, à la couleur, à la religion/au credo, au sexe/à la grossesse, à l'état matrimonial, à l'état familial, au statut de handicap, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité ou à l'expression de genre, ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Nous cherchons à rendre notre processus de recrutement accessible aux candidats handicapés. Si vous avez besoin d'un hébergement ou d'un soutien tout au long du processus de recrutement, veuillez contacter ta-canada@basf.com avec la mention "Demande d'hébergement pour le recrutement" dans l'objet du courrier électronique. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Wir verbinden Saatgut und Traits, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Werkzeuge und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze, um Landwirten und anderen Stakeholdern entlang der Wertschöpfungskette die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu liefern. WAS SIE ERWARTET Mit unserem 18-monatigen Trainee-Programm erhalten Sie einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Tätigkeitsfelder der Bereiche Finance und Controlling. Von Anfang an werden Sie eigene Projekte bearbeiten, in denen Sie Ihre Innovationsfreude einbringen und Themen im Bereich Finance oder Controlling weiter voranbringen können. Ihre drei Einsatzstationen à sechs Monate sowie Ihre spätere Zielfunktion werden individuell mit Ihnen abgestimmt. Dabei berücksichtigen wir Ihre Wünsche und Stärken. In jeder Einsatzstation arbeiten Sie sich in das entsprechende Themenfeld, wie z.B. operatives und strategisches Controlling, Innovationscontrolling, Geschäftsbewertungen oder auch Digitalisierungsprojekte ein. Bereits nach kurzer Zeit übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für spannende Projekte oder initiieren diese selbst. Dabei steht Ihnen immer eine fachliche Ansprechperson zur Seite. Während der gesamten Zeit des Traineeprogramms erhalten Sie Mentoring, welches Sie in Ihrer beruflichen und persönlichen Entwicklung stärkt. Ein Auslandseinsatz ermöglicht Ihnen, eine neue Kultur kennenzulernen und Einblicke in andere Arbeitsweisen zu erhalten. So entwickeln Sie Ihre interkulturelle Kompetenz weiter und bauen nebenbei Ihr globales Netzwerk aus. Auch hier stimmen wir die Location individuell mit Ihnen ab. Das Traineeprogramm bereitet Sie optimal auf eine Karriere im Bereich Finance und Controlling vor. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, in verschiedenen Bereichen und Positionen zu arbeiten und Ihre Karriere entsprechend Ihrer Interessen und Stärken zu gestalten. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, die Übernahme von verantwortungsvollen Projekten und Kontakt mit Senior Management, Trainees und Alumni bauen Sie ein starkes Netzwerk auf. jobs.name: Traineeprogram START IN Finance & Controlling with focus Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT With our 18-month trainee program, you will gain a comprehensive insight into the various fields of activity in the areas of finance and controlling. From the very beginning, you will work on your own projects in which you can advance topics in the field of finance or controlling. Your three assignment stations of six months each as well as your later target function will be individually coordinated with you. In doing so, we consider your wishes and strengths. In each assignment station, you will familiarize yourself with the corresponding topic area, such as operational and strategic controlling, innovation controlling, business evaluations, or digitalization projects. After a short time, you will take responsibility for exciting projects or initiate them yourself. You will always have a professional contact person at your side. During the entire time of the trainee program, you will receive mentoring that will strengthen you in your professional and personal development. An assignment abroad allows you to get to know a new culture and gain insights into other ways of working. In this way, you will further develop your intercultural competence and expand your global network at the same time. Here, too, we will coordinate the location individually with you. The trainee program prepares you optimally for a career in the field of finance and controlling. After completing the program, you will have a wide range of career opportunities within the company. By working closely with various stakeholders, taking on responsible projects and being in contact with senior management, trainees and alumni, you will build a strong network. In doing so, you will lay the foundation for a successful professional future at BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER We are looking for committed university graduates who set themselves goals and want to leave their comfort zone. We require the following minimum requirements: • Degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) • At least 3-month internship in Finance and/or Controlling • At least 3 months abroad (in the form of study semesters or internships abroad) A maximum of three years’ work experience. • Fluency in English is a must, German language skills are a plus Additional requirements: • Ability to work in a team: You enjoy working in a team and can quickly integrate into new groups. • Strong communication skills: You can convey complex issues in an understandable and precise way. • Analytical thinking: You have the ability to systematically analyze problems and develop solutions. • Initiative: You proactively show commitment and contribute your own ideas. WHAT WE OFFER Mentoring that supports your personal and professional development A wide range of seminars tailored to your needs Networking events where you can expand your career network Permanent employment contract from day 1 and best career opportunities HOW TO REACH US Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US As a reliable partner of the rural economy, Agricultural Solutions offers innovative, sustainable solutions for plant protection and health. With the agricultural center in Limburgerhof, close to the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you can expect an attractive place for both work and play in the Rhine-Neckar region. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/Headquarters Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Banco de Talentos - PCD - Pessoas com Deficiência - Brasil
jobs.description: Criamos química para um futuro sustentável Cerca de 111.000 funcionários do Grupo BASF contribuem para o sucesso de nossos clientes em quase todos os setores e em quase todos os países do mundo. Nossa carteira compreende seis segmentos: Químicos, Materiais, Soluções Industriais, Tecnologias de Superfície, Nutrição e Cuidados e Soluções Agrícolas. A BASF gerou vendas de cerca de 78.6 bilhões de euros em 2021. A BASF, em contínua busca pela equidade e pluralidade de seus colaboradores, representatividade na sociedade e em linha com sua estratégia global de Diversidade & Inclusão, lança seu Banco de Talentos – PCD - Pessoas com deficiência, com o objetivo de buscar profissionais para atuar em seus negócios. Acreditamos que a diversidade de nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras com sua pluralidade de ideias e experiências, traz novas perspectivas e resultados, permitindo que alcancemos nosso objetivo de ser uma organização de alta performance, gerando interações criativas, inovação e valor para nossa gente, nossos clientes e para a sociedade. Quer se juntar ao time BASF? Se inscreva em nosso Banco de Talentos e, caso surja uma oportunidade para o seu perfil, vamos entrar em contato com você. Este Banco de Talentos é direcionado para profissionais PCD - Pessoa Com Deficiência , que tenham interesse em oportunidades de trabalho em todo o Brasil. O que queremos? Queremos que nossos(as) colaboradores(as) se sintam valorizados(as) por serem quem são, do jeito que são e, assim, possam desempenhar 100% das suas potencialidades. Como atuamos? Atuamos sempre para alcançar três grandes objetivos: Promover equidade ao longo de toda jornada dos(as) colaboradores(as) e nos processos de gestão de pessoas. Desde a seleção, passando pela integração e todos os processos internos. Desenvolver ações afirmativas que garantam a representatividade das sociedades em que operamos negócios e que gerem oportunidades para grupos historicamente discriminados. Contribuir para gerar diferenciais competitivos ao influenciar a cadeia de valor. Nossa estratégia está ancorada em quatro pilares: Demografia: Queremos que o conjunto de características das pessoas que compõe nossa empresa reflita o conjunto de características que está presente na comunidade ou na sociedade onde atuamos. Comunicação e cultura: Queremos reforçar nosso cuidado na relação com todas as pessoas. To complete our Administration& Payroll team, we are looking for an HR Specialist/ Officer (m/f/d) with a strong enthusiasm for Payroll, HR processes and customer relations. Your responsibilities will include: You process variable elements for the preparation of monthly payroll, improve and maintain HR administrative processes in our HR systems. You prepare monthly and yearly reporting on HR data. You ensure that all legal and regulatory requirements concerning our HR services are met. You advise and inform the employees based in France regarding HR topics. You work closely with our local HR partners in France as well as with our internal departments in Berlin and our technical service providers. You are innovative and participate in internal projects, identify opportunities for improvement and encourage the sharing of best practices between our European HR teams. You take part in the digitalization of our HR services; by identifying opportunities for improvement and sharing best practices with your international colleagues. WHAT YOU OFFER You have successfully completed vocational training or hold a degree in Human Resources, Payroll, or a related field, and you bring initial professional experience in HR, including a first exposure to payroll processes. Building on this initial experience, you are motivated to further develop your knowledge of payroll processes and deepen your understanding of legal regulations related to social security, taxation, time management, and compensation & benefits. You feel comfortable working with HR systems (ideally SAP HR) and have a good level of confidence using Excel in your daily work. You are fluent in French and have a good command of English. Knowledge of German would be a plus. You enjoy working with people and interacting with stakeholders in a friendly, helpful, and service-oriented way. You have strong analytical and organizational skills and are able to structure your work well, even when working towards deadlines. WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US ? You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Vind je het leuk om hoogwaardige producten te maken en complexe technische vraagstukken op te lossen? Dan is de vacature proces operator bij BASF Heerenveen perfect voor jou! Bij BASF Heerenveen werken we met een enthousiast team van ruim 230 medewerkers aan de ontwikkeling en productie van innovatieve, watergedragen polymeerproducten en additieven. Deze producten worden wereldwijd toegepast in de verpakkings- en coatingindustrie. We werken in een dynamische omgeving waar passie, innovatie en teamgeest centraal staan. Samen met jouw ploeg ben je verantwoordelijk voor het soepel laten verlopen van onze geautomatiseerde productieprocessen. Jouw taken zijn onder andere: Grondstoffen beheren: Je zorgt voor de aanwezigheid van grondstoffen en halffabricaten, bereidt oplossingen en bedient het productiebesturingssysteem. Kwaliteit bewaken: Je neemt productiemonsters, voert analyses uit en definieert instructies voor afstelling en opwerking. Indien nodig stel je de situatie veilig en voer je eenvoudige onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit. Onderhoud ondersteunen: Je ondersteunt het onderhoudsteam, bijvoorbeeld tijdens shutdowns. jobs.name: Internship Predictive Maintenance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Global Engineering Services service unit contributes to shaping a sustainable future with outstanding technical expertise. With our dedicated, interdisciplinary teams, we support BASF's divisions in growing together with our customers and markets. We implement investments competitively. Around the globe, we provide safe and reliable solutions to ensure that production plants deliver excellent performance. We are continuously improving and driving digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our Asset Monitoring Solutions & Services unit develops innovative and sustainable solutions to increase plant availability. Unplanned downtimes are specifically reduced by combining process engineering/mechanical engineering knowledge with methods from applied mathematics, data science and IT. The overarching goal is the holistic and sustainable optimization of the maintenance process over the entire life cycle of a plant. As part of a mandatory internship of three to six months, with the option of supplementing this with a voluntary placement, you will have the opportunity to integrate different types of machines into the monitoring process from January 2027 and get to know different IT systems in the process: You will put innovative technologies & methods for model- and data-based condition monitoring of process engineering machines as well as apparatus into practice. You will quickly familiarize yourself with the system architecture and contribute your ideas to the further development of system tools. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team in which you will present and discuss your results. The focus of your work will depend on your interests and skills. WHAT YOU OFFER enrolled student in a bachelor's or master's program in a technical field, e.g. engineering or physics interest in linking plant engineering with digital technologies excellent knowledge of English and good knowledge of German ideally good knowledge of drive and driven machines, process engineering or chemistry motivation and perseverance to implement innovative and practical solutions based on scientific findings independent and autonomous work and ability to actively contribute ideas to the team WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Team buddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and areas of work Internship remuneration - recognition of your work, more information here: http://on.basf.com/VerguetungBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Tina Le (Talent Acquisition), tina.le@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56367 will be happy to answer your questions about this position. You can also book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information on our application process here . The selection process includes a background check of the last diploma obtained and a criminal record certificate. Please submit the required documents only after our request. ABOUT US BASF SE, based in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan economic area. BASF has stood for competence in chemistry since 1865 and today is represented in the world's major consumer markets with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers a wide range of career opportunities for students, graduates and professionals and provides training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sport, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. You can find out more about BASF SE at: http://on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Participate in all required safety training and wear proper personal protective equipment when working in the plant area. jobs.name: EHS Specialist III
jobs.description: Now hiring! EHS Specialist III Malcom, IA (On Site) We are looking for an EHS Specialist III to join our Performance Materials team in Malcom. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. Your primary responsibilities will include ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations related to environmental protection, hazardous waste management, and spill prevention, as well as adhering to BASF's internal standards, such as Responsible Care®. You will play a crucial role in enhancing our site programs to maintain our license to operate while fostering a culture of safety and compliance among all personnel.  In addition, you will lead our site security initiatives, identifying and mitigating security risks to uphold and optimize our security standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, you will collaborate closely with the site manager and contribute to the overall success of the Malcom site.  You will also be an integral part of the BASF EHS community, working alongside EHS experts across the organization and reporting directly to the EHS Director for Performance Materials North America. As an EHS Specialist III, you create chemistry by... Leveraging your effective communication skills to develop strong working relationships with employees, the EHS community, and regulatory agencies/third parties, serving as a positive change agent within the organization. Utilizing your knowledge of Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, and Environmental disciplines to develop and maintain EHS programs, policies, and procedures for the site. Drawing upon your experience in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental management, and Emergency Response program management in a manufacturing environment to lead and participate in risk assessments, accurately addressing identified deficiencies. Providing guidance - both tactically and strategically- to site leadership on critical EHS issues, ensuring adherence to corporate EHS policies and procedures, including the Responsible Care® Management Systems. Creating training content and, where appropriate, delivering training or coaching, facilitating the sharing of programs, procedures, tools, and best practices across the BASF EHS organization. Prioritizing opportunities and issues to drive the continuous improvement of EHS processes and systems. Utilizing your strong organizational skills to identify and monitor key performance indicators within your area of responsibility, making necessary adjustments to improve EHS performance. Leading and participating in project reviews, process hazard analyses, and change management processes, ensuring all internal and external reporting requirements are met through your solid analytical and computer skills. Being a role model and collaborating with hourly employees to reinforce a culture of behavior-based safety and support emergency response activities. Working with and traveling to other sites to evaluate audit readiness and share best practices Leading and/or participating in EHS work teams and/or task forces If you have... A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field. Two (2) years of experience in an industrial/manufacturing environment Ability to work independently under broad goals and objectives with minimal guidance. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience with Environmental Reporting and Safety Management Systems strongly preferred Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Deputy Manager- Technical Service - Personal Care
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Technical key account management and key interface of customers R&D Translate the customer needs into technical projects briefing Drive Technical service projects delivery with business impact How You Will Do It 1. Technical Interface & Application Development Serve as the gatekeeper for all R&D and technical exchanges between customers and BASF. Develop appropriate solutions in lab and present technical proposals, new concepts, and application ideas tailored to customer needs. Support implementation of these solutions at customer sites through trials, formulation guidance, and troubleshooting. Provide technical consulting, training, and hands-on support to customers. 2. Technical Service Strategy & Innovation Develop and execute proactive technical service strategies that enhance long-term customer loyalty. Identify customer-driven innovation opportunities and emerging application fields specific to Personal Care. Lead joint development projects with customers, ensuring strong project management and full accountability for deliverables. Manage and mitigate product and process risks, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory standards. 3. Technical Key Account Management & Stakeholder Influence Influence key decision-makers within customer organizations and internally within BASF—even without direct authority—to drive technical and commercial progress. Build and maintain strong, strategic, long-term relationships with key accounts across R&D, procurement, marketing, operations, and leadership. Leverage in-depth knowledge of Personal Care formulations, applications, and market value chains to anticipate trends and guide customer development efforts. Act as the liaison between customer teams and internal BASF functions to ensure smooth communication and high customer satisfaction. 4. Capability Building Enhance the technical capability of the sales team and distributor teams through structured trainings, coaching, and joint customer visits. Promote strong cross-functional understanding of product performance and application behavior 5. EHS & Compliance Follow and promote BASF’s Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) practices during all technical service activities. Ensure all technical recommendations meet regulatory and safety guidelines relevant to Personal Care products What We Look For Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Cosmetic Science, or related discipline Experience in technical service, formulation development, or application support in Personal Care- 8 to 12 years Strong understanding of Surfactants, UV filters, Bio actives, Emollients and other Personal Care ingredients Hands-on experience with lab formulations and customer trials Strong communication, influencing skills, and project management capabilities Work Location Turbhe, Navi Mumbai

jobs.description: Now hiring! Senior Control Systems Engineer Freeport, TX (Onsite) Annual bonus We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our Petrochemicals (CP) team in Freeport, TX. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Petrochemical division is the starting point of BASF's petrochemical value creation worldwide, also known as “the heart of the Verbund,” representing the world's largest chemical markets. Together, let us keep the heart beating one creative solution at a time! As a Senior Control Systems Engineer and member of the Acrylic Acid Process Management team in Freeport, you will ensure the unit’s control systems operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. You will lead control system lifecycle and migration efforts, guide maintenance strategies for automation assets, and collaborate closely with the Operations, Technology, and Maintenance teams to deliver consistent reliability and enable future improvements. As a Senior Control Systems Engineer, you create chemistry by... Leading configuration, preventive maintenance, hardware/software support, and overall administration of all control systems within the Acrylic Acid units, this includes programming HMI, DCS and (Safety) PLCs using function block diagrams, ladder logic, and sequential function charts. Supporting daily operations by troubleshooting, tuning, and optimizing PID control loops, including leading root cause failure analyses and implementing corrective actions for control system issues. Supporting capital and maintenance projects involving control system interfaces through the design, implementation, and commissioning phases, including serving as the Manufacturing Representative or MOC Coordinator for selected projects Developing long-term control system lifecycle plans for the unit in alignment with the Operations and Asset Management teams. In line with this you will maintain detailed logic drawings and system configuration to support troubleshooting, audits, and lifecycle planning. Tracking total cost of ownership for control systems by monitoring failures, tracking maintenance contracts, optimizing software upgrades, and coordinating with vendors. Participating in peer groups with other Control Systems Engineers, Instrument & Electrical Maintenance Engineers, Technologists and Technicians to drive standardization of control systems across the Freeport site and within the unit. If you... Have a bachelor's degree in Computer, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or related engineering majors. Possess 7+ years of experience with control systems, automation, and instrumentation including DCS and/or PLC programming (Foxboro DCS, Triconex, Allen-Bradley PLC preferred). Demonstrate strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, along with a keen attention to detail. jobs.name: Project Lead Strategy Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As Project Lead (m/f/d) you collaborate with colleagues on complex strategy consulting projects and provide impactful solutions for businesses and functions across BASF. You identify potential improvements in each project and advise the management team competently and empathetically. From Day 1, you apply your skills and contribute your ideas to ongoing projects. You communicate clearly and openly with all parties involved throughout all project phases. Our end-to-end consulting services allow you to accompany a project from start to finish. You enjoy top management visibility by working with BASF Executives globally on a wide range of strategic high-priority projects with sustainable impact. Our projects cover the fields of Innovation & Growth, Marketing & Sales, Organizational Excellence, and Post-Merger Integration/Carve Out. For an overview about our practice groups see here . WHAT YOU OFFER professional experience in strategic consulting and project work in a (global) strategy consulting firm depending on your qualifications and professional experience, you start as Project Leader (3-5 years) or Senior Project Leader (5-7 years) proven expertise in project management methods as well as consulting methodologies and approaches excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus convincing and competent behavior in client interactions open-minded and inclusive attitude, reliable team player international work experience is a plus WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks: An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US Moisturizing creams, mild shampoos, strong styling gels, glossy lipsticks and protective sunscreens – all of these products contain ingredients made by BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH, a BASF subsidiary. Using natural, renewable raw materials, we develop and produce a large range of ingredients for the personal care sector. Learn more about BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH at on.basf.com/ECareandNutrition Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Du tüftelst für dein Leben gerne? Deine Lieblingsfächer sind Mathe und Physik, aber noch viel lieber hättest du öfter die Fächer Mechanik, Elektrotechnik und IT? Das klingt ganz so, als wäre ein Beruf in diesem Bereich perfekt für dich! Wenn du es nicht mehr abwarten kannst, dich um technische Einrichtungen zu kümmern, sie am Laufen zu halten oder zu verbessern, dann bewirb dich für eine Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker bei uns! DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Lesen und Verstehen von Schaltplänen, Konstruktionszeichnungen und Bedienungsanleitungen – häufig in technischem Englisch Verbinden elektronischer Bauelemente oder Baugruppen mit mechanischen Bauteilen, Ventilen, Pumpen und Schlauchleitungen manuelles oder maschinelles Bearbeiten von Metallen in Betrieb nehmen sowie Installieren und Testen von fertigen Systemen, Maschinen und Anlagen selbstständige Fehlersuche und Reparieren beschädigter Bauelemente DAS BRINGST DU MIT mindestens eine Mittlere Reife sicheres Farbsehvermögen Grundkenntnisse in Englisch zum Verstehen von technischen Dokumenten Interesse an Mathematik, Physik und EDV, Spaß an technisch-handwerklichem Arbeiten sowie am Lösen komplexer Probleme Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine spannende Ausbildung im weltweit führenden Chemieunternehmen in Kooperation mit der BBS Technik I in Ludwigshafen maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote sowie die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an EU-Austauschprojekten attraktive Vergütung - du startest mit 1147 Euro pro Monat im 1. Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und hast Spaß daran, Menschen einen unvergesslichen Aufenthalt zu bereiten? Du bist engagiert und hast Lust, in einem einzigartigen Team zu arbeiten? Dann starte deine Ausbildung als Hotelfachmann:frau mit Zusatzqualifikation Hotelmanagement in unserem Hotel und erlebe wie vielseitig und spannend der Beruf in der Hotellerie sein kann! Du erlernst dabei zwei zusätzliche Fremdsprachen und erhältst zudem Einblicke in das Hotelmanagement als wertvolle Erweiterung deines Qualifikationsprofils. DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Front Office: ein- und auschecken sowie betreuen von Gästen, anlegen von Reservierungen, Betreuen der Hotelgäste Einblicke ins Yield Management Veranstaltungsmanagement: Verkaufsgespräche führen, bearbeiten und einbuchen von Tagungsanfragen und Veranstaltungen Housekeeping (professionell ein Hotel in Ordnung halten) Servieren von Speisen und Getränken, Barservice, Zubereiten einfacher Speisen Betreuen von Tagungen und Veranstaltungen mit Vor- und Nachbereitung inkl. Rechnungsstellung Korrespondieren mit internationalen Gästen und Lieferanten Einblicke ins Marketing und Controlling (Strategien, Budgets, Events) Inhalte der Zusatzqualifikation: Erlernen von drei Fremdsprachen (Englisch, Französisch und Spanisch) Einblicke ins Hotelmanagement DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens eine vollständige Fachhochschulreife Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit Gute Umgangsformen, ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild sowie sicheres Auftreten Gutes Ausdrucks- und Formulierungsvermögen sowie Interesse an fremden Kulturen und Sprachen Ausgeprägte Kontaktfähigkeit und Kundenorientierung Freude an kaufmännischen Tätigkeiten sowie am Planen und Organisieren Erste Erfahrungen in der Gastronomie wünschenswert DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG Diese Vorteile hast du während deiner gastronomischen Ausbildung im führenden Chemieunternehmen der Welt: Vergütung: Gehalt im ersten Ausbildungsjahr 1.147 € pro Monat; im Zweiten 1.232 € und im Dritten 1.343 €, Jahresprämie, Zukunftsbetrag und Urlaubsgeld, Feiertags- und Nachtzuschläge sowie Zuschuss zum Jobticket, 2 Tage bezahlte Freistellung zur Prüfungsvorbereitung Urlaub und Arbeitszeit: 30 Tage Urlaub, planbare Arbeitszeiten durch frühzeitig abgestimmte Dienstpläne, elektronische Zeiterfassung, Überstunden werden abgefeiert, außerdem zahlreiche Freizeit- und Fitnessangebote zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Zusatzleistungen: Tablet, Arbeitskleidung inkl. Reinigung, Finanzierung der Bücher für die Berufsschule, Wohnmöglichkeiten für Azubis von weiter weg Einarbeitung und Qualifizierung: Start in die Ausbildung Schritt für Schritt mit festen Ansprechpartnern und gleichzeitig direktem Einstieg in die täglichen Abläufe, maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote, eigenverantwortliche Aktionstage und Azubiprojekte sowie Teilnahme an Gastronomiewettbewerben, Kennenlernen aller Häuser der BASF Gastronomie inklusive dem Studienhaus St. Johann in der Pfalz, Berufsschulunterricht in der BBS Technik II in Ludwigshafen, Kennenlernen deiner zukünftigen Mitauszubildenden vor Ausbildungsbeginn AUSGELERNT UND BEREIT DURCHZUSTARTEN? jobs.name: (Senior) Project Manager Supply Chain Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Project Managing Consultant, you make a real difference for the future of BASF by providing innovative solutions and effective recommendations to BASF's leaders. Our internal customers include the entire value chain of BASF from base chemicals to specialties, each with their unique requirements. You will be focusing on the topics of sustainability, end-to-end supply chain processes, automation & digitalization initiatives and complexity management. End to end project leadership: You lead high impact supply chain consulting engagements from initial problem structuring and value case design through solution development and implementation planning. CORE value chain focus: You drive transformations in large scale, cost critical chemical and consumer care–relevant value chains, with emphasis on planning, S&OP, logistics, inventory, and network optimization. Senior stakeholder engagement: You act as a trusted sparring partner for senior leaders and project sponsors, communicating clearly, fact based, and with a strong value orientation. AI enabled consulting: You leverage advanced analytics and AI supported tools (e.g. scenario modeling, planning analytics, process mining, decision support solutions) to accelerate insights, improve decision quality, and increase consulting impact. Capability building: You coach and develop consultants in modern consulting methods, digital and AI capabilities, and BASF Winning Ways behaviors, ensuring sustainable adoption in the organization. Thought leadership: You continuously monitor external trends and internal priorities to develop new methodologies and scalable solutions for BASF’s future supply chain challenges. WHAT YOU OFFER several years of professional experience in supply chain consulting or transformation roles, ideally in CORE chemical, consumer care, or asset intensive industries proven expertise in areas such as supply chain strategy, planning, S&OP, cost optimization, inventory management, or logistics strong strategic thinker with a hands on, data driven mindset and experience leading teams and complex stakeholder environments exposure to advanced analytics, AI supported planning, or digital supply chain solutions is a strong advantage excellent proficiency in English, good German skills and international work experience are a plus high level of ownership, curiosity, and entrepreneurial drive, aligned with BASF Winning Ways WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks : An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US Moisturizing creams, mild shampoos, strong styling gels, glossy lipsticks and protective sunscreens – all of these products contain ingredients made by BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH, a BASF subsidiary. Using natural, renewable raw materials, we develop and produce a large range of ingredients for the personal care sector. Learn more about BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH at on.basf.com/ECareandNutrition Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Production Manager
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Responsible in managing daily production operations to ensure timely, safe, and high-quality production of products, while also focusing on training production personnel, optimizing procedures, and ensuring compliance. Main Responsibilities Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are fully adhered and maintaining high safety standards for a safe working environment. Plan, organize, and manage daily production activities to ensure that production schedules and target quantities are met. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Production Superintendent, Production Supervisors, Boardmen and technicians fostering a culture of teamwork and accountability. Conduct periodic training, performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training needs for team members (including succession planning for roles Boardman and above). Facilitate effective communication within the production team and across departments. Perform internal audits to support ISO9001, ISO14001 and ISO 50001 standards. Implement and uphold quality control measures to maintain product quality requirements and consistency within production team. Coordinate production trials, test and implement recommendations from Toray to improve plant operation and product quality as and when required (via MOC process). Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Polymer Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field At least 7 years of experience in production management within a manufacturing environment, preferably in polymerization and distillation processes. Technical & Professional Knowledge Proven experience leading teams and managing production operations. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written (English & Bahasa Malaysia) Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. A proactive and results-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement. Commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

Tot 1 juli maakte onze organisatie deel uit van BASF. In het kader van de huidige overgang worden alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog steeds gehost op het BASF‑platform en daarom volledig in BASF‑huisstijl weergegeven. Laat je hier niet door verwarren: alle functies zijn posities bij Surventis en jouw sollicitatie wordt bij ons ingediend. Bij Surventis kijken we een stukje verder — in alles wat we doen. We zetten de klant centraal, denken een stap vooruit en ontwikkelen oplossingen die echte waarde en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We inspireren elkaar om dieper te denken, verantwoordelijkheid over ons werk en streven er voortdurend naar om het mogelijke te vergroten. Als je jezelf volledig meebrengt, de voor de hand liggende antwoorden uitdaagt en wil groeien met een team dat het meent — dan is dit jouw plek. Als Technisch Specialist Autolakken ben jij de technische sparringpartner voor onze klanten. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van autolakken en spuittechnieken met het vermogen om die kennis helder over te brengen. Je ondersteunt klanten bij technische vraagstukken, verzorgt trainingen en begeleidt hen in het optimale gebruik van onze producten én softwareoplossingen. WAT JE KUNT VERWACHTEN Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van technische vraagstukken bij klanten, op locatie. Je geeft productdemonstraties en technische trainingen bij klanten en in ons eigen training center. Het analyseren en optimaliseren van werkprocessen en applicatietechnieken behoort tot je belangrijkste taken. Je ondersteunt en traint klanten in het gebruik van onze eigen software. Je draagt bij  aan kennisdeling en best practices binnen het team. Daarnaast werk je Intensief samen met collega’s van andere afdelingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor rapportage en documentatie. Je legt bevindingen en adviezen vast en geeft feedback aan de interne afdelingen. WAT JE AANBIEDT Je hebt een technische achtergrond of aantoonbare ervaring in autolakken en spuittechnieken. Praktische ervaring binnen een autoschadeherstelbedrijf is een vereiste. Je hebt een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch denkvermogen. Je hebt interesse in software (training & support) en bent digitaal vaardig. Bovendien ben je zelfstandig, gestructureerd en sterk klantgericht. Je bent bereid om klanten door heel Nederland te bezoeken. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en het Engels is een plus. WAT WIJ BIEDEN Een afwisselende technische functie met veel zelfstandigheid Werken met hoogwaardige producten en innovatieve systemen Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden en voortdurende bijscholing Een aantrekkelijk salaris met aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden Auto van de zaak Moderne werkomgeving met een eigen training center Werken voor een sterk en internationaal merk Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof. Damit sichern wir die Grundversorgung der Unternehmensbereiche, die dadurch erfolgreich am Markt agieren können. Zusätzlich beraten wir die Betriebe in allen Belangen rund um Umweltschutz, Arbeits- sowie Anlagensicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz und Genehmigungsrecht. WAS SIE ERWARTET Aus- und Weiterbildung bei BASF bedeutet Verlässlichkeit mit langer Tradition und eine Investition in die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und Zukunft der BASF. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern machen wir Auszubildende sowie Fach- und Führungskräfte fit für die moderne Arbeitswelt am Standort Ludwigshafen. Gleichzeitig möchten wir mit unserem Aktionsfeld „Mensch im Fokus“ ein positives Mindset für die Organisation und unsere Lernenden fördern und unsere Team- und Lernkultur stärken. Sie möchten Teil unseres interdisziplinären Projektteams sein und uns dabei unterstützen, mit Hilfe von Maßnahmen aus der Positiven Psychologie unsere Führungs-, Team- und Lernkultur mitzugestalten? Sind Sie an einer Universität oder Hochschule immatrikuliert und würden ab März 2027 zur Verfügung stehen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt für Hochschulpraktikum von 4 bis 6 Monate. jobs.name: Millwright
jobs.description: Now hiring! Millwright Regina, SK (On-site) Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Millwright to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Regina, SK. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Millwright, you will perform safe, reliable, and efficient mechanical maintenance activities to support continuous operation of the Regina chemical manufacturing facility. The Maintenance Millwright Technician is responsible for executing planned and corrective maintenance work, troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures, and supporting asset reliability and mechanical integrity. This role contributes directly to safe plant operation, equipment uptime, and effective execution of the site’s maintenance strategy. As a Millwright, you create chemistry by... Executing planned preventive and corrective maintenance work in accordance with SAP work orders, job plans, procedures, and safety requirements. You will also maintain accurate documentation by completing SAP work orders, inspections, and maintenance records. Troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures and supporting timely restoration of production during unplanned breakdown events, including participation in a rotating on call schedule with availability for evening, weekend, and emergency response as required by site operations. Installing, repairing, and replacing mechanical components including pumps, bearings, seals, gearboxes, conveyors, and associated equipment. Participating in equipment inspections, condition monitoring activities, and continuous improvement of maintenance tasks and job plans. Supporting shutdown, turnaround, and outage activities, including equipment preparation and commissioning. Participating in project design reviews, Management of Change (MOC) reviews, and other cross functional forums to provide maintenance expertise and feedback on equipment maintainability, serviceability, and reliability. Participating in safety meetings, job hazard analyses, and EHS initiatives. If you have... Interprovincial Red Seal Journeyperson Millwright (Industrial Mechanic) Certificate recognized under current Saskatchewan Apprenticeship and Trade Certification Commission (SATCC) requirements, and possess a valid Saskatchewan driver’s license or ability to obtain. Experience troubleshooting and maintaining mechanical equipment in a manufacturing or industrial environment and supporting equipment breakdowns in a 24/7 or continuous production setting, with working knowledge of industrial EHS requirements and safe work practices. Experience working within a planned maintenance and reliability‑based maintenance programs, and executing preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance work orders. Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with working knowledge of pumps, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, conveyors, rotating equipment and mechanical drives, with the ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical manuals, and P&IDs. Experience with alignment, rigging, precision measurements, and mechanical installation practices. Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably SAP PM, and demonstrate proficiency in basic computer use, electronic work order systems, and maintenance documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills. About us As the world’s leading chemical company, we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! We constantly strive to become an even better workplace. As a result of our commitment to our employees, BASF has earned various awards, including being recognized by Mediacorp in 2024 as one of Canada's Top Employers for tenth consecutive year, one of the Greater Toronto Area's Top Employers for the eleventh year in a row, and twice being named one of Canada's Top Employers for Young People and Best Diversity Employers. This role is on the Road . Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. The Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative (12-month contract) is responsible for the execution of summer demand creation activities including large scale grower trials and demonstration sites within the region. They are responsible for providing supportive data to meet sales objectives and address product usage questions. In addition, they are accountable for providing technical training to the sales force and key influencers within the region. This includes training the sales representatives on investigative field techniques and technical support with product inquiries where necessary. As an Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative, you create chemistry by... Executing and managing all Demand Creation trials and activities, including all technical requirements such as ability to operate equipment related to spraying, maintenance and harvest. Supervising Technical Agronomy Interns who support summer demand creation activities and data collection of large-scale grower applied trials and other key projects. Coordinating third party research associated with third party demo sites. Monitoring and positively influencing key centers of influence (COI) such as universities, consultants, provincial extension staff and retail agronomists through relationship building and regular contact. Technically transferring information through the development and delivery of presentations to both external and internal customers through a variety of presentation tools. Providing technical training and reinforcement of product positioning with sales team. Supporting sales team members and a defined list of external customers within the region, ensuring that marketing, sales and technical positions are in alignment. Using generated field and university research data to develop tools that support marketing and sales tactics. If you have... Représentant de Service Technique 1 1 Nous sommes à la recherche d'un représentant de service technique pour rejoindre notre division Agricultural Solutions à l’est de l’Ontario ou au Québec. Venez créer de la chimie avec nous! La division Agricultural Solutions de BASF met en relation l’innovation, les clients, les partenaires et les experts agricoles et intègre des critères de durabilité dans toutes les décisions commerciales. Nous aidons les agriculteurs à obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en s’efforçant d’atteindre l’équilibre entre la création de valeur économique, environnementale et sociale pour une agriculture durable et efficace. Le représentant de service technique (contrat de 14 mois) est chargé de s’assurer que le positionnement des produits marketing, commerciaux et techniques est conforme à la région et à l’équipe de spécialistes des cultures qu’il soutient. Comme Représentant de Service Technique 1 1, vous créez de la chimie en... Dispensant une formation technique à la force de vente et aux principaux influenceurs de la région. Cela comprend la formation des représentants commerciaux sur les techniques d’enquête sur le terrain et, le cas échéant, une assistance technique pour les demandes de renseignements sur les produits. Soutenant également les objectifs de vente par une interaction directe avec les ventes et indirecte en influençant les principaux clients externes de la région. Exécutant des activités estivales de création de demandes, y compris des essais chez les producteurs à grande échelle et des sites de démonstration dans la région. Il est chargé de fournir des données utiles pour atteindre les objectifs de vente et répondre aux questions sur l’utilisation des produits. Surveillant et en influençant positivement les principaux centres d’influence tels que les universités, les consultants, le personnel chargé de la vulgarisation provinciale et le commerce de détail agricole en établissant des relations et des contacts réguliers. Il fournit à ces centres d’influence des renseignements sur les produits, des mises à jour de la marque et des résultats techniques. Jouant un rôle clé dans le transfert des connaissances sur les nouveaux produits et les cultures vers d’autres régions de vente, en interagissant régulièrement avec les chefs de marque, les représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, les responsables de comptes stratégiques, les responsables du marketing technique, de la réglementation et de la biologie. Si vous avez... Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en agriculture ou en biologie avec un accent sur la science des cultures, la malherbologie, l’agronomie, l’entomologie, la phytopathologie ou une discipline connexe est recommandé. Les candidats titulaires d’un baccalauréat en sciences et ayant un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience seront également pris en considération. Un professional agrologist, CCA ou CCSC (Certified Crop Adviser ou Certified Crop Science Consultant) avec au moins 2 ans d’expérience relative sur le terrain. Des compétences en développement et enlivraison de présentations aux clients externes et internes. Vous devez avoir d’excellentes compétences informatiques et maîtriser divers logiciels, notamment PowerPoint, Excel et Word. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale est essentiel. Être efficace pour communiquer avec une grande variété de publics. Être capable d’établir des relations avec les principaux contacts influents sur les attributs techniques des produits et les problèmes agronomiques relatifs aux principales cultures de la région. Capacité à recommander le positionnement d’un produit en fonction de l’évaluation des données et des besoins des clients. Expérience de travail avec des représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, des universités ou des consultants serait un atout. Une capacité à fournir un leadership technique au sein de l’équipe de vente est un avantage. Posséder de solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps est essentiel. Le bilinguisme est considéré comme un atout. jobs.name: Senior Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the centre and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface’ makes it clear that we are not only focussed on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT For our Internal Audit unit, we are looking for a committed and analytically minded Senior Auditor (m/f/d). In this role, you support the unit in enhancing and protecting the organization’s value by providing independent and objective audit services aimed at creating added value and improving organizational processes. In your role as Senior Auditor, you independently conduct risk-based audits at group companies globally. You analyze and assess business processes with regard to compliance, efficiency, and effectiveness. Moreover, you identify key risks and develop appropriate audit programs based on those risks. Furthermore, you document your work steps and audit results in a structured and transparent manner. You prepare audit results concisely and communicate them in a target-group-oriented way to senior management. Finally, you follow up on the implementation of agreed measures and contribute to the further development of internal audit methods and tools. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed university degree in business administration, economics, finance, accounting, or a comparable field several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in internal audit, external audit, accounting, controlling, or risk management strong analytical skills as well as a structured and thorough working style high level of initiative, sense of responsibility, and professionalism strong communication skills and confident interaction across different management levels very good German and English skills; confident use of MS Office, SAP knowledge is an advantage WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. As a founding member of the Diversity Charter, BASF stands for diversity – we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC and CultiConnect. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information about our application process here . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. In het kader van de huidige overgang worden alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog steeds gehost op het BASF‑platform en daarom volledig in BASF‑huisstijl weergegeven. In unseren Kantinen und Locations sorgen wir für Vielfalt, Qualität und echte Genussmomente. Jetzt fehlen nur noch Sie! WAS SIE ERWARTET Fachliche Führung & Verantwortung - Sie leiten zehn Betriebskantinen in Ludwigshafen und führen die Küchenleiter:innen (8) sowie das Team Angebotskonzeption (2). Führung & Entwicklung - Sie coachen und entwickeln Führungskräfte, begleiten Recruiting, Onboarding und Qualifizierungen und bauen ein einheitliches Führungsverständnis auf. Kulinarische Steuerung & Konzepte - Sie verantworten standortübergreifende Speisepläne, Rezepturen, Kalkulationen und Ernährungsstandards und entwickeln gastronomische Konzepte kontinuierlich weiter. Qualität & Standards - Sie stellen die Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Prozess- und HACCP-Standards sicher und optimieren Abläufe sowie Rezepturen fortlaufend. Organisation & Wirtschaftlichkeit - Sie unterstützen die Küchenleitungen bei Wareneinsatz, Kalkulation, Personaleinsatz und Organisation und stellen effiziente Ressourcennutzung sowie stabile Abläufe sicher.
