jobs.name: Technical Sales Rep PA
jobs.description: Where the Chemistry Happens: The Technical Sales Representative will contact established and prospective customers in an assigned territory for the purpose of selling Chemetall surface treatment chemicals. This individual will provide complete sales and service which ensures safe quality product performance while maximizing profitability within their assigned territory. Formula for Success: Sales Analysis and Planning Understands the business activities of accounts in the territory and applies knowledge of the customer’s internal operation to tailor sales presentations and sales proposals to the account’s specific needs. Manages territory profitability by reviewing territory compensation margins, providing margin improvement by product selection and optimum pricing.  Assures that technology provided within the territory strengthens the company’s competitive position within the accounts. Plans a weekly itinerary of calls to allocate time effectively and to ensure proper territory coverage by industry, geography and account potential. Sales Execution Calls on established and prospective customers, determines their needs, and sells appropriate products to markets, targeted by the business units of the company. Makes proper number of calls per day based on territory requirements. Must be able to physically service and call on existing and prospective customers. Selects the process and the right material to solve customer cleaning, sanitation or surface treatment problems. Makes sales presentations, both orally and in written. Answers customers questions concerning product use. Price negotiation: Provide pricing quotes, price and delivery policy within established limits, subject to approval. Attain sales plan by securing new customers, increasing sales to current customers and maintaining up to date opportunity pipeline in CRM (Salesforces) Customer Service Works closely with customers focusing on building strong business relationships. Maintains contacts with customers in relation to their service requirements. Provides information on new products, methods, techniques and other general information such as safety and disposal. Trains customers and insures proper and safe use of Chemetall materials. Reports competitive activities, that impact sales in the territory, to the supervisor (District Manager) Prepares and submits call reports, exception reports, and in-plant service reports via CRM (Salesforce) Use of the CRM ( Salesforce) for management of the accounts. Share reports with appropriate with colleagues to ensure collaboration with different functions to keep all necessary information on all accounts Sales Support Activities Improves technical knowledge of Chemetall materials through self-study and participation in professional Association. Participates in team selling activities in cooperation with other TSR’s, technical support personnel and application engineers. Requests samples according to company policy. Exercises proper caution in handling company materials and equipment. Operates automobile (company car) safely and maintains it in proper operating condition. Complete all necessary reports in due time ( expenses, mileage report, etc.) Ingredients for Success: BS Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Engineering, or Business is required. Minimum of 2 years of relatable experience is required. B2B/outside industrial sales experience, in specialty chemical sales (surface treatment-paint pretreatments, wastewater treatments, metalworking fluids, etc.) preferred. Ability to make sales presentations and follow up with written proposals and manage customer contracts. Well organized with sales planning. Managing customer accounts within the assigned territory. Strong selling skills for customer acquisition and continuous up-/cross-selling opportunities (customer support/account management) Build and strengthen customer relationships. Technical consulting capabilities regarding products and processes; will learn and understand Chemetall product portfolio. Strong business acumen. Strong Negotiation skills Problem solving skills Time management Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Travel up to 50-60%, with occasional overnight travel. Valid driver's license in good standing .

jobs.name: Senior Officer, Order to Cash (Japanese Speaker)

Capture customer expectations / requirement and feedback to the business team. Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliant with business rules, internal standards, and local government regulations. Report any areas of concern immediately to Supply Chain Manager. Provide order status report and monitor customers’ order placement against sales forecast and Joint-customer call to customers in case of request by sales team as sales supporter. Understanding of end-to-end OTC process Possess excellent communication, and interpersonal skills Good proficiency in Japanese language and English Proactive, can work independently and in teams About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. Diese Spezialchemikalien werden in vielen Industrien und Märkten genutzt, wie zum Beispiel Automobil, Luftfahrt, Aluminiumveredelung, Coil oder in der metallverarbeitenden Industrie – unterstützt von einem großen Netzwerk technischer Experten. WAS SIE ERWARTET In Ihrer Rolle als Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) GmbH Controlling erwarten Sie folgende Aufgaben: Business Partnering: Ganzheitliche betriebswirtschaftliche Beratung der Werks- und Betriebsleitung bei operativen und strategischen Fragestellungen Reporting & Analyse: Erstellung und Interpretation von monatlichen Werksberichten, Abweichungsanalysen sowie Überwachung der Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Fristgerechte und genaue Durchführung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen der Produktion inkl. Prozessauftragsabrechnung, Standard- und Ist-Preisberechnungen Durchführung und Pflege der Kostenarten- und Kostenstellenrechnung Produktkalkulation: Durchführung und Pflege der Produktkalkulation sowie die Analyse der Herstellkosten Planung & Forecasting: Verantwortung für den jährlichen Budgetprozess sowie (Fixkosten, variable Kosten, Investitionen) Erstellung von Sonderauswertungen und Profitabilitätsanalysen WAS SIE MITBRINGEN Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Controlling eines produzierenden Unternehmens zwingend erforderlich Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten, selbständige Arbeitsweise und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, sehr gute Excel und SAP (CO, FI, PP) Kenntnisse. Reisebereitschaft zwischen Headquarter und Produktionsstätte (monatlich) WAS WIR BIETEN Moderne und umweltfreundliche Verfahren, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, flexible Arbeitszeiten, vielfältige und herausfordernde Aufgaben, attraktive Sozialleistungen und weltweit engagierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen Im Rahmen unseres Onboardings erhalten unsere neuen Mitarbeitenden eine individuelle, auf ihre Tätigkeit zugeschnittene Einarbeitung, unterstützt durch zahlreiche Schulungsangebote Ein familiäres Miteinander mit wertschätzendem, offenem und vertrauensvollem Umgang sind bei uns gelebte Werte und die Basis für unser gutes Betriebsklima Die Position kann an den Standorten Frankfurt am Main oder Langelsheim besetzt werden. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Sie haben Fragen zum Ablauf oder zu der Stelle? Für nähere Informationen steht Ihnen Britta Schneider (HR Business Partner, Chemetall GmbH), Tel.: +49 69/7165 - 3361, gerne zur Verfügung. ÜBER UNS Das Portfolio besteht aus Lösungen zur Gewährleistung von Korrosionsschutz und Haftung von Beschichtungen, zum Verformen und Bearbeiten von Substraten, für Anwendungen zur Vorbereitung von Oberflächen für den Lackierprozess, sowie Dichtungsmassen für spezifische Anwendungen in der Luftfahrtindustrie. Chemetall hat den Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, mit rund 2.500 Mitarbeitern weltweit und einem globalen Netzwerk an Vertriebs- und Produktionsstandorten. Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Belgium Coordination Center CommV in Ghent, Belgium. We are seeking people who thrive in a culture of creativity, openness, responsibility, and entrepreneurial spirit. In our organization, we encourage and celebrate innovative thinking, where ideas flow freely and are nurtured. We value individuals who take ownership of their work and are accountable for their actions. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset, where taking calculated risks and seizing opportunities are encouraged to drive growth and success. Join our team and be part of an environment that values and rewards creative thinking, collaboration, and a can-do attitude. Within BASF Seed and Traits R&D, Trait Research we focus on the design, creation and testing of candidate leads as gene-based solutions for herbicide tolerance, pest and disease control in key crops including soybean, oilseed rape, wheat and cotton. We are currently seeking a talented, motivated, and inspiring Nematologist to join our Trait Research team at the R&D Innovation Center in Ghent, Belgium. In this role, you will develop and execute research strategies aligned with business goals to successfully commercialize innovative nematode resistant traits and germplasm. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You propose innovative nematode trait concepts and develop and implement nematode control research strategies using state-of-the-art know-how and technologies including suitable third-party collaborations to ascertain scientific competitiveness of the nematode program. You evaluate scientific progress of nematode control programs with the project leader and with support of team members (technicians and scientists in the lab and GH) and take decisions to ensure the achievement of scientific objectives and critical milestones with optimal use of available resources. You design and oversee the execution of nematode control assays to support program goals. You articulate a clear, innovative and competitive testing scheme to meet these goals and to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality nematode traits. You proactively report on your scientific progress and new opportunities to all relevant stakeholders as requested. You develop the innovative ability and competence of research teams, and you act as a mentor and give scientific guidance across the organization. You support the program leader to ensure strategy competitiveness by working closely with Intellectual Property colleagues to build a proactive patenting (and, if needed, licensing-) strategy and ensure a competitor IP analysis in the program field. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a PhD in Nematology with 12-15 years of relevant experience or equivalent. You are internationally acknowledged as a consistent innovator and leading authority in the field of Plant Nematology and have a profound knowledge of GM trait development. You provide innovative solutions for plant parasitic nematode issues and demonstrate knowledge and expertise from working directly with plant parasitic nematodes. You are familiar with crop business strategies and the principles of value creation for growers. You understand the connection between the lab and the field. You have a track record of providing scientific leadership for internal and external program work packages, effectively managing collaborations with partners, and excel in developing innovative research proposals that incorporate novel technology platforms to advance plant parasitic nematode control project objectives. You possess leadership and team coaching skills, motivating and inspiring others, while fostering collaboration in diverse environments through a multi-cultural mindset. You demonstrate proactivity, with well-developed communication skills that enable effective interactions with stakeholders. You build a culture of innovation by creating an environment that supports creativity and by coaching and developing people. You are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. An attractive base salary in relation to your diploma and competencies, an annual bonus and extra-legal benefits. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Regional Data & AI Engineer, Operations, Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
About the Role Regional Data & AI Engineer builds and advances a scalable data and AI backbone for smart manufacturing across Asia sites within Coatings business unit. It combines the development of a standardized production data architecture across sites with the ability to translate data into business value through advanced analytics, AI-ML, and agentic AI solutions. The role ensures that production data is consistently leveraged to improve performance, enable better decisions, and drive continuous optimization across the regional manufacturing network. How You Will Do It Production Data Architecture Define and implement the target architecture for the capture, integration, and provision of production and process data across multiple sites, ensuring scalability and alignment with global standards. IT/OT Integration Develop and implement standards and concepts for the integration of production-relevant data sources, including sensors, PLC, SCADA, historian, MES, LIMS, quality, and ERP systems, with a focus on data quality, availability, and cybersecurity. Data Modeling, Analytics and AI Enablement Design and structure production data models to support reporting, root cause analysis, process optimization, as well as advanced analytics and AI applications, establishing the foundation for scalable data products. Technical Leadership and Consulting Provide technical guidance and advisory support to business functions, production sites, and project teams; translate business requirements into robust architectural solutions and support the implementation of data-driven and AI-enabled initiatives. Standards and Governance Establish and maintain regional standards for data models, interfaces, documentation, and governance to ensure consistency, traceability, compliance, and reusability across the organization. Global Collaboration and Continuous Development Collaborate within an international network of sites, experts, and stakeholders; contribute to and drive global roadmaps; continuously advance the production data architecture in line with business and technology developments. AI and Agentic AI Solution Development Drive the design, development, and industrialization of AI-ML based and agentic AI-based solutions tailored to manufacturing operations, including predictive analytics, intelligent process control, and decision-support systems. External Innovation and Partnerships Identify, evaluate, and manage partnerships with external vendors, startups, and technology providers to incorporate advanced, manufacturing-specific AI and digital solutions into the operational ecosystem. What We Look For Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence or a comparable scientific or technical field. Working Experience: Min. 5 years of professional experience in data architecture, data integration, industrial data platforms or advanced analytics, ideally in a global production-related environment. Experience in designing scalable data architectures and a good understanding of data quality, governance, information security and standardization. Technical & Professional Knowledge / Others: Strong understanding of production processes and industrial system landscapes as well as solid knowledge of integrating IT and OT systems and relevant standards such as ISA-95, OPC or MQTT. Strong knowledge of data processing, data modeling and data analysis as well as technologies such as Python, SQL, ETL/ELT concepts and modern data platforms. Knowledge of Databricks platform, Agentic AI, Machine Learning techniques, including decision tree learning, clustering, artificial neural networks, etc., and their pros and cons. Strong communication and facilitation skills, confidence in working with global stakeholders, a strong team orientation, as well as a high degree of initiative and structuring capability. Very good written and spoken Chinese and English skills. jobs.description: Now hiring! TPU Operator Wyandotte, MI We are looking for an Operator to join our PM team in Wyandotte, MI. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. As a Chemical Plant Operator for our Wyandotte TPU Plant, you will be responsible for all aspects of personal safety, product quality, and operating all aspects of the extrusion lines and their auxiliary and utility equipment including truck unloading and packout. Work 14 out of 28 days in a 12-hour rotating shift. During your 12-hour shift (day/night) as a TPU Operator, you will Operating PLC systems and environmental control systems Reading, recording, and interpreting data from various industrial equipment such as extruders Making safe, prompt, and effective corrective adjustments to ensure efficient production, including troubleshooting Controlling flows, pressures, reactions, temperatures, and material makeup for batch sheets and formula cards Handling transfer of solutions/batches and loading/unloading chemicals from tanks, trucks, and rail cars Performing maintenance tasks such as visual inspections of operating equipment Following verbal and written instructions from the Shift Supervisor, standard procedures, batch sheets, and loading sheets Cross-training in additional production areas and supporting team members in tasks and problem-solving Participating in miscellaneous duties such as painting, cleanouts, assistance during plant outages, and maintaining operating condition of key equipment. jobs.name: Auditor, Corporate Audit
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Why does this position exist?  With what permanent objectives? Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 3 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. How Will You Do It We are seeking for an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. It is also expected that you actively collaborate with Global experts (Domain Owners/ SPOCs) as regional subject matter expert for specific audit topic/ risk aspect. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Provide value adding recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Communicate audit observation and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behaviour, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, professionalism, and teamwork mindset in the role. What We Look For Education: Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, or Data Scientist. Preferable Candidate should have Professional Certifications such as: required CIA (Certified Internal Audit) – or work in progress, optional CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit) Working Experience 4 – 7 Years experience. Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies. Travel Requirement Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Orther Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics that comes with complex organization, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks and propose effective solutions. Ability to embracing technology and data analytics. With the increasing volume of data and the complexity of business operations, you will leverage data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Work Location Godrej One - Vikroli (Mumbai)

jobs.name: Category Buyer ( Site and Business services )
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Support procurement activities for BASF Global Digital (GD) and Global Business (GB) Service Centres being established in Hyderabad. Manage procurement for large and complex offices and sites with multiple production units, businesses, and functions, including Site and Business Services across BASF locations beyond Hyderabad. Contribute to the development, implementation, and monitoring of regional category strategies covering Site and Business Services (e.g., Facility Management, Fleet, HR Services, Marketing & Communications, and Legal). Oversee contract implementation and performance monitoring. Drive category management initiatives to achieve cost efficiencies and value creation. Execute supplier management, including performance evaluation and relationship management. Ensure vendor compliance with human rights practices in line with applicable country laws and regulations. Manage Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes effectively. How Will You Do It Supplier Management: Monitor supplier performance to ensure alignment with BASF standards on quality, quantity, and service responsiveness. Maintain strong supplier relationships through regular communication and drive corrective actions using established performance management tools when required. Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on market dynamics, including pricing trends, supply risks, supplier performance, and insights. Identify and develop new suppliers through market research and analysis to support business growth, including supplier evaluation, commercial negotiations, contracting, and onboarding. Supplier Qualification: Identify and develop new supplier sources, with a strong focus on local vendors in Hyderabad. Lead supplier audits and qualification processes in collaboration with technical teams. Source-to-Contract (S2C) Management: Manage the end-to-end S2C process using BASF procurement tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, Mercanis). Take full ownership of bidding processes for medium- to high-value purchases, including documentation, evaluation, and award. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Management: Oversee the complete P2P cycle, including purchase orders (via SAP), contract execution (including paper-based agreements where applicable), and vendor payments. Negotiation & Cost Management: Develop and execute negotiation strategies for high-value contracts, with a strong focus on achieving EBIT savings in line with BASF policies. Category Management – Business & Site Services: Lead S2C activities for Business Services categories, including: HR services (manpower outsourcing, recruitment) Marketing services (events, promotions, corporate communications) Legal and professional consulting services Maintain deep category knowledge across site services (facility management, leasing, fleet management) and business support functions. Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to human rights, governance, and regulatory requirements, particularly in manpower outsourcing for manufacturing and business operations. Manage internal and external audits and ensure compliance across all assigned procurement activities. Market Intelligence & Strategy: Continuously monitor market trends, cost developments, and supplier landscapes through data analysis and external engagement. Translate insights into procurement strategies and provide forecasts on cost and supply impacts to relevant stakeholders. Stakeholder & Supplier Communication: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure effective implementation of BASF procurement policies and procedures. Additional Responsibilities & Requirements Operate under the functional guidance of the Regional Category Manager. Execute supplier and risk management strategies as defined, including performance evaluation, innovation initiatives, and mitigation plans. Report negotiation outcomes and procurement performance metrics. Collaborate closely with headquarters in Mumbai and regional teams in Shanghai. Preferred Experience Strong knowledge of the Hyderabad market is an advantage. Experience managing procurement for large multinational corporate offices (GCCs, GSCs, shared services centers). Exposure to large-scale office environments (approx. 100,000 sq. ft., 2,000–3,000 headcount). Experience in office interiors procurement is an added advantage. What We Look For Education: Master’s degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of experience across two relevant roles. An MBA / CPSM/CIPS is an added advantage. Professional Experience: Proven experience in Procurement, preferably within a corporate or multinational environment. Core Competencies: Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills In-depth knowledge of suppliers, market dynamics, products, and technologies within relevant categories Good understanding of Business Services, including HR, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Legal, and engagement of professional consultants Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Hindi Knowledge of regional language (Telugu) is an added advantage Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP systems (e.g., SAP R/3, Cobalt, SAP Business Warehouse, Strategic Procurement Suite) Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Familiarity with digital tools such as Copilot and Power BI

jobs.name: IAM Architect - Identity & Access Management (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM In the Coatings division, we focus on developing, producing, and marketing innovative coating solutions – from applied surface technologies to automotive paints. We drive innovation, design, and new applications to meet the needs of our partners worldwide in globally connected teams. This portfolio is complemented by “Beyond Paint Solutions,” enabling new surfaces and advanced materials WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As an IAM Architect, you are responsible for designing, evolving, and ensuring the effective implementation of our global Identity & Access Management (IAM) landscape. You combine strategic architecture ownership with hands-on expertise, acting as the IT-Infrastructure key interface between internal teams (esp. Cybersecurity, SAP, Applications, business units) and Managed Service Providers (MSP). In cooperation with the MSP, you ensure that IAM solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with business and compliance requirements. You will take ownership across the following IAM domains: Entra ID / Azure AD, Access Governance, SSO, MFA, PIM/PAM, Joiner–Leaver–Mover Integration, Password Management Vault, PKI & Key Management. Your key responsibilities include: Define and evolve the global IAM strategy together with security and infrastructure experts Design end-to-end IAM architecture across all identity lifecycle processes (Joiner–Mover–Leaver) Act as professional counterpart towards MSPs: steer and govern external service delivery Ensure stable, secure, and compliant IAM operations as well as integration with enterprise architecture (I&O Platform, applications, cloud) Provide hands-on expertise in solution design, integrations, and complex troubleshooting scenarios Support and advise projects and business stakeholders on IAM-related topics WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in computer science, business informatics, or comparable qualification Several years of practical experience in IAM, ideally in an international industrial environment with strong SAP footprint Broad expertise as an IAM generalist across multiple domains Hands-on experience across core IAM domains, leveraging solutions such as Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, SuccessFactors & ServiceNow, Keeper and DigiCert Strong expertise in: Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Identity Governance solutions (e.g., SailPoint, One Identity) Authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) Directory services (LDAP, Active Directory) Cloud platforms (Azure, & AWS) Experience working with and steering Managed Service Providers Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments Strong collaboration mindset with willingness to work closely with international teams and travel to sites esp. headquarter Münster, Germany Ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic, scalable solutions Structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented working style Strong communication skills and experience working in global teams Fluent in Spanish and English WHAT WE OFFER Continuous learning and career development through our internal job opportunities. A safe work environment where we actively promote your health and well-being. Subsidized canteen on site. Free company shuttle service between Alcalá and Marchamalo. Competitive compensation package including a fixed salary and performance-based variable pay. Opportunities to connect outside the office and stay active through company sports groups. Flexible benefits package, which can be allocated voluntarily to transportation, training, childcare, and more. Financial support for schooling and additional benefits for families. Nomination as Country/Site Dangerous Goods Safety Advisor. Training and Guidance to TDS related personnel involved in distribution safety processes. Conduct TDS Reviews for all Responsible person. Conduct Safety and Quality Assessments of suppliers, service providers and customers that transport or store our raw materials or goods. Incorporation of Transportation and Distribution Safety Performance in the Procurement Process. Carrier/Trucker Qualification Checks and Performance Evaluation. jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Our GDD/D – Digitalization of Operations unit implements digital technologies and applications in production plants. This enables us to increase production effectiveness. At the same time, processes become more efficient and safer. RESPONSIBILITIES Our goal is the implementation of digital technologies and applications in chemical plants, to improve work processes and increase the production efficiency. As a part of the global Digital Plant team you will coordinate the creation of a digital, intelligently linked representation of a real asset – the so-called digital twin. The digital twin will therefore enable many future use cases in other products like augmented reality or artificial intelligence. Your activities will include the digitalization of a real plant, by following a standardized and proven procedure create validated 2D- and 3D-data. The implementation of the necessary technology, digital workflows and roles within the whole organization of a plant and the respective service providers will be part of your activities, too. You will guide users how to use digital methods and processes during the asset lifecycle, to raise the potentials of cost and lead time reduction combined with quality increase in engineering, construction, brownfield projects, plant modifications, maintenance, TARM and operations. On the way to the digital asset lifecycle, you will offer change management support, accompanied by training and coaching on easy-to-use tools and enhanced digital processes. QUALIFICATIONS Master Degree in Chemical/Process Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 3+ years’ experience in planning or construction of or in chemical plants Experience in usage of digital tools and methods in data driven engineering projects Very good project management and coordination skills Ideally working Experience in international projects and agil methods The will and ability to drive change and an entrepreneurial spirit Creative and motivated working style with a strong focus on innovation Ability to work in a multicultural and virtual team Excellent communication skills in English WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Production Engineer
jobs.description: Objective of the Position Responsible for ensuring day-to-day plant operations run smoothly, with a strong focus on daily production safety, process reliability, quality, and regulatory compliance, while optimizing asset utilization and production efficiency. Assist the Production Manager in ensuring the operation of the production section is carried out on time according to EHS, quality and other agreed requirements. Key in driving continuous improvement, cross-shift standardization, and effective problem-solving to sustain high-performance operations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activies EHS Strictly comply with and implement the company's EHS policies and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification requirements. Guide and ensure shift operations to strictly follow SOPs regarding safety, environment, and occupational health in their operations. Take appropriate measures for any safety, environmental, or occupational health incidents and report to the Production Manager as per procedures. Using personal protective equipment (PPE) according to the Safe Work Guidelines or PPE Matrix Carry out emergency actions as required by procedures during emergency response events. Operations Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are being adhered to and maintained by the production personnel. Providing technical and operational leadership to support day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safe execution of production plans in full compliance with BASF Process Safety standards, and applicable environmental regulation. Acting as a technical authority and trusted advisor to Operations, leading complex troubleshooting efforts and guiding Daily Operations teams toward effective, sustainable solutions for process, production, quality, and EHS challenges. Driving continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to improve asset efficiency, optimize equipment cycle times, reduce waste, and sustain nameplate production capacity. Influencing cross shift standardization, cost optimization, and asset performance by working collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Asset Effectiveness teams to align priorities and maximize plant utilization. Leading cross functional coordination and technical input for inspections, outages, capital projects, and investigations (RCA, NCM), partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prevent repeat incidents and improve first pass quality. Lead production team in trial production of new products and internal test products (PTO). To check and revise if necessary; HIRA, Procedures, Working Instructions, and Work Checklists. Manage the inventory of materials and tools, including staging materials for production and packaging by conducting periodic stock counts. Support on evaluating training needs for the operation, to ensure they are provided the adequate training for operation and continuous improvement. Responsible as 5S leader coordinator for Production Department. Review process condition and downtime report, GAP reporting and propose for improvement. Represent the Production Manager on production matter during the Production Manager absence. Ensure effectiveness of the implementation audit for Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and IATF 16949 Quality Management System for the automotive industry. Ensure good housekeeping and proper handovers among shift team members. Other production-related tasks assigned by superiors. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Polymers Science or Chemical Engineering. At least 5 - 8 years’ of experience in delivering technical expertise in a plastics compounding manufacturing plant. Posses demonstrated track record of leading through influence, providing expert technical guidance, and partnering with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and EHS teams to achieve safe and reliable plant performance. Proficient in production management software (e.g., ERP systems, MES). Hold strong production and operations background with the ability to independently support troubleshooting, root cause failure analysis, and investigations across Production, EHS and Quality. Have proven continuous improvement capability, including practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive efficiency, waste reduction, asset utilization, and sustained nameplate performance. Highly effective collaborator with strong attention to detail and communication skills, able to coordinate complex activities and influence priorities across cross functional teams without formal supervisory authority. Knowledgeable on ISO 9001, ISO 14001, TS 16949 and ISO 45001 requirements. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Belgium Coordination Center CommV in Ghent, Belgium. We are seeking people who thrive in a culture of creativity, openness, responsibility, and entrepreneurial spirit. In our organization, we encourage and celebrate innovative thinking, where ideas flow freely and are nurtured. We value individuals who take ownership of their work and are accountable for their actions. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset, where taking calculated risks and seizing opportunities are encouraged to drive growth and success. Join our team and be part of an environment that values and rewards creative thinking, collaboration, and a can-do attitude. Within BASF Seed and Traits R&D, Trait Research we focus on the design, creation and testing of candidate leads as gene-based solutions for herbicide tolerance, pest and disease control in key crops including soybean, oilseed rape, wheat and cotton. We are currently seeking a talented, motivated, and inspiring Nematologist to join our Trait Research team at the R&D Innovation Center in Ghent, Belgium. In this role, you will develop and execute research strategies aligned with business goals to successfully commercialize innovative nematode resistant traits and germplasm. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You propose innovative nematode trait concepts and develop and implement nematode control research strategies using state-of-the-art know-how and technologies including suitable third-party collaborations to ascertain scientific competitiveness of the nematode program. You evaluate scientific progress of nematode control programs with the project leader and with support of team members (technicians and scientists in the lab and GH) and take decisions to ensure the achievement of scientific objectives and critical milestones with optimal use of available resources. You design and oversee the execution of nematode control assays to support program goals. You articulate a clear, innovative and competitive testing scheme to meet these goals and to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality nematode traits. jobs.name: Technical Account Manager FCC Catalysts
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Catalysts Division is the world's leading supplier of environmental and process catalysts. We develop technologies for air protection, fuel production and for efficient manufacturing of chemicals and other products, including battery materials. We help our customers to be even more successful with our knowledge of precious and base metals and our passion for innovation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Serving as the priary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites, providing hands-on technical support, troubleshooting, unit optimization, performance improvement, and advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection and operational strategy. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations, customer proposals, and performance improvement initiatives. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts, including volume, margin, pricing, receivables, sales forecasting, CRM management, and account planning. Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives, including pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts, expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders, and positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers, acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams, and representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. Location: Fully remote role, ideally based in Southern Europe or the Mediterranean region to ensure proximity to key refinery customers. Territory: Responsible for refinery accounts across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean area, with a dedicated focus on FCC catalyst applications. Travel: Expected travel of approximately 30–50% to visit customer sites, support technical discussions, and strengthen business relationships across the assigned region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline. Strong experience in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts (mandatory). Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Experience managing multiple refinery accounts in an international environment. Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Expertise in FCC technology and refinery processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving capabilities and strategic thinking. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to operate independently in a remote, regional role. WHAT WE OFFER CCNL (National Chemical Collective Agreement). Gross annual salary (RAL) between €70,000 and €85,000, to be assessed based on the candidate’s skills and relevant experience. Variable bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. High-impact regional role focused purely on FCC catalysts. Combination of technical leadership and commercial ownership. Flexible remote working within Southern Europe. Opportunity to work with leading refinery customers in the region. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US Join a global FCC leader and contribute to advancing refinery performance through technical excellence and strong customer partnerships.

jobs.name: Senior Engineer, EP Material Testing (ID & Failure Analysis)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Take the functional leadership of the sub-team of ID Analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure Analysis to assist lab leader of EP Material Testing lab to manage EP material testing lab, and thus to assist head of Materials & Parts Testing to provide ID analysis and failure analysis supports to Research & Development, production, sales and marketing, business development, technical research & development and strategic objectives for company’s Engineering Plastics related PM business in China and Asia Pacific in an effective way. How You Will Do It Be responsible for operation of ID analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure analysis related part of EP Material testing lab. Review test results; monitor progress of testing requests; participate in the process changes to be made; contribute to customer on-site audit; participate in the investigation on customer complaints on EP Material mechanical tests. Lead the execution of testing tasks and make the routine maintenance plan of equipment related to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Devise tests, procedures and apparatus required to achieve experimental results, help to develop new testing methods to meet requirements, and lead the training for new employees on ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Write comprehensive reports and evaluations on the data obtained relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Participate in the CAPEX plan relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP material and execute the plan accordingly. Oversee the new equipment purchase for related tests and contact from the negotiation period of the deal. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of global testbox program and the discussion for improve testing procedures relating to ID analysis and failure analysis. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of testing harmonization and the global testing harmonization relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Contribute to the management of external resource of EP material testing relating to ID analysis and failure analysis, conduct external resource screening, audit, negotiation and monitoring. Co-operate with development/technical service/manufacturing/sales & marketing in providing technical assistance to demonstrate company products, and to solve field problems. Contribute to safety, health and environmental standards of EP & FR lab. Coordinate to maintain EP Material Testing lab to fulfil Quality Management System (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, etc.). What We Look For Education: Master or Bachelor in polymer chemistry, analytics chemistry, material science or other polymer or chemistry related. Working Experience: Master with more than 5 years’ experience or bachelor with more than 8 years’ experience in material analysis (more than 3 years’ experience on FTIR, DSC and TGA of EP materials) and material testing of polymer materials. Over 3 years’ supervisor or leadership experience. Over one year’s ISO 17025 experience will be plus. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Knowledge and hand-on experience on material analysis and material testing of polymer materials. Ability to deliver technical presentations in Mandarin and English. Ability to write comprehensive technical report by English. Knowledge on ISO 17025 system management will be a plus. Language: Ability to communicate with written and spoken English smoothly. 请时刻警惕任何可能的招聘欺诈行为！请注意，巴斯夫绝不会在任何情况下向候选人以任何形式收取任何费用

jobs.name: Technical Account Manager - Refinery Catalysts (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The world needs innovations, and our team needs you! BASF is the world's leading chemical company #WeCreateChemistry and one of the best places to work and develop your career. We are looking for diverse, passionate, and creative talent who wants to make a difference. BASF Española S.L. markets more than 5,000 products to meet the needs of our customers and society across a wide variety of sectors. The chemical industry is changing; and so is BASF. Discover our new strategy: #WinningWays Do you want to boost your career to the next level and create chemistry with us? WHAT YOU WILL DO By joining BASF’s Catalysts division, with exclusive focus on Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) applications within refinery customers across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean region, you will be: Serving as the primary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites. Providing hands-on technical support, including troubleshooting, unit optimization, and performance improvement. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations and proposals. Advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection, performance, and operational strategy. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts (volume, margin, pricing, receivables). Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives. Managing pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Delivering accurate sales forecasts and managing CRM tools for account planning. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts. Expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders. Positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers. Acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams. Representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU University degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related disciplines. Strong background (at least 5 years of experience) in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts. Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Knowledge on any Mediterranean language is a plus. Availability to travel ~30–50% of your working time. WHAT WE OFFER Healthy work environment : where your safety and health (both physical and mental) are always our priority. Attractive salary package : based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible working model : you will be able to work remotely within the country and adjust your schedule. Flexible compensation plan : to take advantage of ser vices such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development : we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Investments for your future: with a Pension Plan, Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, and even the opportunity to participate in the Stock Program after one year in the company. Work-life balance measures : as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections : where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile is a match, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: talent-acquisition-spain@basf.com * *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. MORE ABOUT BASF We celebrate diversity and actively promote an inclusive work environment where every voice is heard, and every idea is valued, regardless of age, gender, marital status, ethnicity, religion, physical/mental condition, or sexual orientation. #BeYourself We are C reative, O pen, R esponsible and E ntrepreneurial people. This are o ur values , they guide us and describe who we are and how we act. If you identify with them, BASF is the place for you! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digitalization is a true part of BASF's DNA — creating new customer experiences, driving business growth, and making processes more efficient. Global Digital Services drives BASF's digital transformation through innovative, global, high-quality digital products and a strong agile culture, and the Digital Hub Madrid is one of our key global delivery locations. We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer for BASF's DevHub — the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by thousands of engineers and product teams across BASF. DevHub already ships an enterprise AI Gateway (50+ governed models, Entra ID, EU data residency, per-cost-center billing, Grafana observability) and a catalog that is a schema-validated knowledge graph of every product and its infrastructure. Your mission is to make AI a first-class platform capability: build reusable, production-grade AI services and developer experiences that help users discover, create, configure, operate, scale and govern their products, surfaced where they already work — the portal, the IDE (GitHub Copilot/MCP) and Teams. You will treat the platform as a product — shipping paved-road components other teams reuse, serving both humans and agents, with the multi-tenant scoping, cost-tracking, guardrails and governance an enterprise platform demands. RESPONSIBILITIES Treat the platform as a product. Build paved roads and self-service: reusable AI building blocks (shared retrieval/"context engine," guardrail & evaluation libraries, an MCP/tool layer), scaffolder templates, SDK/API access and stable, versioned interfaces — built once, reused across features. Ship AI experiences that delight developers. Grounded, well-cited assistants, copilots and wizards across the product lifecycle (e.g. a conversational knowledge assistant over our docs and catalog), meeting users on the portal, IDE (Copilot/MCP) and Teams via one shared API. Serve humans and agents. Expose platform capabilities through an MCP / SDK / API surface — read-first, RBAC- and tenant-aware — so internal and external AI clients can query and (later, gated) act on the platform. See the AI-Assisted Platform Strategy RFC. Own evaluation and quality. Build eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics so features are correct, grounded and regression-tested in CI; invest in context engineering over model-shopping — the Gateway already solves model choice. Pick the right pattern. Prefer deterministic pipelines + structured outputs + human-in-the-loop where outcomes are structured; reserve multi-step/multi-agent orchestration (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangGraph / Microsoft Agent Framework) for genuinely open-ended tasks, keeping state-changing actions gated. Strengthen MLOps / LLMOps. Improve prompt/version management, model adaptation, CI/CD and the path from experiment to production; treat prompts and retrieval as versioned, tested production assets. Build for multi-tenancy. Default to per-product / per-tenant scoping of context, tools and actions; bake in observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, distributed tracing) and per-product cost/FinOps visibility. Help advance security, safety & governance. Inherit platform RBAC (Entra ID / AccessIT), defend against the OWASP LLM Top 10, keep AI usage auditable, and respect BASF / EU AI Act and data-residency requirements. QUALIFICATIONS BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related field. 4+ years in Software Engineering or Platform Development, with demonstrable recent experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic Systems. You don't need to tick every box. Strong Python + hands-on LLM application experience + a platform/developer-experience mindset matter most; we expect you to grow into the rest. AI / LLM engineering. Practical experience building LLM-powered applications; familiarity with RAG and agentic patterns (ReAct, plan-and-solve, multi-agent) and a clear sense of when not to use an autonomous agent. Evaluation & quality (core). Designing eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics for LLM/RAG systems (grounding, retrieval precision, hallucination control); context engineering over model selection. Backend & API development. Python proficiency is highly desired (FastAPI, Pydantic, async); designing and operating production backend services and well-versioned APIs. Platform / Developer-Experience engineering. Building reusable, self-service components and paved roads (templates, SDKs, golden paths) and operating multi-tenant services in production (SLOs, observability, "you build it, you run it"). Software development across the stack. jobs.name: Controlling Manager - Value & Cost Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a newly standalone business, we are also adapting our Controlling organization with a strong focus on value creation. As Controlling Manager – Value & Cost Controlling, you will build and lead a team that ensures financial transparency, drives performance management, and supports value-oriented steering across our global business. Your team owns three key areas: functional cost controlling, the financial steering of the company's value creation initiatives, and the controlling of our Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers during the first phase of our standalone journey. As the direct finance partner for senior management on all cost and value creation topics, you play a key role in achieving the company's financial targets. In your new role, you lead and develop the Value & Cost Controlling team, foster a collaborative, business-partner-oriented culture, and ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant financial insights to senior management. You further enhance reporting on primary cost controlling, implementing new allocation models and driving process automation. In addition, you oversee the financial steering of value creation initiatives, ensuring transparency on the financial impact, milestones, and progress of the company’s strategic initiatives portfolio and providing management with clear insights into status, risks, and opportunities. Furthermore, you steer the controlling of all Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers, ensuring transparency on scope, costs, service levels, and timelines while supporting a smooth and timely transition into the target setup; always in close collaboration with internal stakeholders. You design and implement a robust performance management framework, including KPI definition, target setting, variance analysis, and continuous monitoring of profitability and efficiency initiatives, and you play a key role in budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning cycles, ensuring consistent alignment between corporate strategy, financial planning, and execution. Last but not least, you partner closely with finance leadership, business units, and operational functions to identify performance improvement opportunities, support strategic and operational targets, and drive the standardization, automation, and digitalization of controlling processes to enable data-driven decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in finance, controlling, business administration, economics, or a related field; CFA or MBA is an advantage 8–10+ years of professional experience in controlling, FP&A, or performance management within a multinational corporation, including several years in a leadership role strong analytical background, ideally complemented by experience in strategy, corporate or business development proven track record in cost controlling, profitability steering, and performance improvement; experience in service agreements or shared services controlling is a plus, as well as experience in the chemicals industry or in business transitions strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders in a multicultural environment proficiency in SAP S/4HANA, BI and planning tools such as SAC, Power BI, or Anaplan, as well as advanced MS Office skills very good language skills in English WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour". HOW TO REACH US Julia Kilias (Talent Acquisition), julia.kilias@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59139 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: AI Data Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digital Hub Madrid attracts, grows, and develops passionate people who will meaningfully impact the digital future of BASF. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey. Describe your Product Mission here / objective of the role: The AI & Automation Enablement team designs and engineers scalable AI and automation solutions that deliver measurable business value. By combining strong architecture, engineering excellence, and industrialization capabilities, we enable BASF to turn opportunities into production-ready systems – consistently, reliably, and at scale. About the Job: AI Data Architect in a project-oriented team who designs scalable, enterprise-grade data architectures and leads the engineering of robust data platforms, collaborating across domains and teams to enable the development and industrialization of AI solutions that deliver measurable business value. RESPONSIBILITIES Define and own the end-to-end data architecture for AI solutions, from ingestion and storage to serving layers powering models and analytics (e.g., batch pipelines, real-time APIs). Design the data foundations for compound AI systems, including retrieval architectures (e.g. RAG), vector and knowledge stores, and feature/embedding layers. Establish data modelling standards, semantic layers, and reusable reference architectures across workloads (batch, streaming, real-time, analytical, AI-driven) across the organization. Define and enforce governance frameworks for data quality, lineage, security, and compliance, ensuring trustworthy and well-managed data products. Set architectural guidelines and best practices for scalable data platforms and pipelines, and ensure their consistent adoption Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, data scientists, and business partners on data and AI architecture. Evaluate emerging technologies and define the strategic roadmap for the data and AI platform. Stay current with trends and best practices in data architecture, AI, and cloud platforms. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree or Master’s in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, including designing data models, platforms, and end-to-end data pipelines. Proven experience defining data architecture for AI/analytics solutions on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS a plus) and Big Data architectures. Data architecture and modelling for relational and NoSQL systems, including modern storage paradigms (e.g., object storage, lakehouse, warehouse). Design of scalable data platforms and architectural patterns (e.g., Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Medallion), including governance, lineage, and quality considerations. Architecture of compound AI systems, including data layers for AI solutions (e.g., RAG, GraphRAG), vector stores, graph databases, and embedding pipelines. Strong programming skills in Python, including asynchronous programming (asyncio) and data processing. Apache Spark and Databricks platform Cloud data platform expertise, preferably Azure Could and Azure data platform services. Streaming and event-driven architectures, using streaming services such as RabbitMQ or Apache Kafka Big data and large-scale compute architectures, including batch and real-time processing patterns. Design of microservices and distributed systems, including API-based data services. Containerization and deployment practices using Docker (and Kubernetes as a plus) Data security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR), including encryption, access control, and data masking/anonymization Software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps (CI/CD with GitHub Actions) Container orchestration platforms: Kubernetes Graph database technologies and data modelling Workflow orchestration and task management frameworks such as Apache Airflow and Celery AI/ML platforms and cloud AI services LLM and agentic solution patterns, including prompt engineering and orchestration of AI agents. MLOps practices, including model lifecycle management, CI/CD for ML, deployment, monitoring, and retraining pipelines. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical architectures and influence decision-making across teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities
