jobs.name: Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred) We are looking for a Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs to join our Agricultural Solutions team in [Location]. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. This position leads the regulatory function in the US, ensuring freedom to operate for the Crop Protection business units within the Agricultural Solutions business. The role requires a strategic, agile and highly collaborative senior manager with a deep technical understanding of regulatory affairs/science and demonstrated success interfacing with Federal and State regulatory agency senior leadership. As a key member of the APD North American Crop Protection leadership team and industry influencer, you will leverage your connections with management in the commercial, supply chain and development functions and apply your understanding of competitive threats, changing regulatory dynamics, and new technologies to set the regulatory direction that facilitates successful business outcomes. As a Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred), you create chemistry by... Synthesizing complex scientific and regulatory information in a continually changing regulatory environment into understandable, clear and effective regulatory strategies at the portfolio level. Ensuring maintenance and defense of existing products, and ensure new products have robust submission dossiers.  Provide active support and alignment on policies and procedures both within APN and globally. Setting expectations and reinforcing a culture that emphasizes empowerment and a drive to meet customer needs while meeting regulatory requirements. Ensuring appropriate roles and staffing levels to meet business needs, with clear responsibilities while meeting budget requirements. Serving as key interface between US Regulatory and key internal BASF stakeholders, proactively facilitating collaboration and coordination to assure strategic alignment and build relationships with stakeholder groups including EPA, USDA, and trade associations, including leadership. Ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory standards and record-keeping requirements. Working with other key stakeholders (legal, supply chain, technical service, etc.), managing potential issues. If you... Have a Ph.D. with 5+ years, MS with 10+ years, or BS with 15+ years of agricultural chemical industry experience. Previous agricultural chemical regulatory experience required. Demonstrate expert understanding of US agricultural chemical laws and regulations, including FIFRA, TSCA, and state requirements, with a proven track record of successful registration of pesticide products. Have proven experience and ability to build and lead a high-performance team. Have experience working with US EPA Office of Pesticide Programs, USDA and other government agencies, and trade associations. Show ability to synthesize complex scientific and regulatory information into a coherent and effective regulatory strategy that provides clear guidance to the business. Display negotiation skills and ability to build relationships with key stakeholders and negotiate outcomes beneficial to the business, weighing both short and longer-term needs, both internally and externally. Decision making. Ability to manage through difficult situations to evaluate and provide optimal outcomes, managing relationships to ensure key stakeholder needs are met. Possess the ability to deliver challenging messages to stakeholders, willing to seek creative solutions, maintain focus and provide a regulatory perspective. Demonstrate strong interpersonal and networking skills and an ability to understand motivations of others and build and maintain key relationships. This includes key leadership at government agencies (US EPA, USDA, state lead agencies, etc.), with the BASF global regulatory team, global supply chain, and the US Crop, Seed Treatment, and P&SS businesses. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. jobs.name: Unified Communication Specialist
jobs.description: Who we are: We are BASF, the largest chemical company in the world, with over 150 years of experience. In Montevideo, we are a Hub made up of more than 1,000 employees who provide services for all BASF companies in the Americas. We offer professional solutions in finance, purchasing, reporting, logistics, technology, human resources, projects, communication, legal matters, environment, safety, health, and quality. Main Objective As part of the service delivery team your main role will be to support in the daily coordination, external operation and governance of Unified Communication services delivered by our external provider, while acting as a liaison between customers, internal stakeholders and the provider to ensure reliable and business-aligned service delivery. Tasks Support the Service Delivery global team in the day-to-day coordination of Unified Communication services delivered by the external provider, ensuring business continuity working closely with all regional service managers. As first line of operational contact you will assist the Service delivery manager to ensure the service delivery performance is aligned with the agreed SLAs, KPIs, and operational expectations. Support the organization and coordination of regular service review meetings with the provider for changes, incidents, requests, problems, etc. Follow up on open actions, service issues, improvement measures, and escalations to ensure timely resolution. Act as a supporting contact for the external UC provider in operational and service-related matters. Help ensure that incidents, service requests, escalations, and changes are properly tracked and followed by the provider. Ensure critical tasks receive the proper level of attention. Assist in reviewing provider performance, identifying trends, and highlighting risks or recurring issues to the Service Delivery Manager. Support the coordination of provider activities with internal teams and business stakeholders. Support in major incidents when required. Serve as a day-to-day liaison between customers / stakeholders and the external provider for service-related topics. Collect and consolidate feedback, requirements, and service concerns from business stakeholders, sites, and internal IT teams. Help to transfer the business needs into structured inputs for the Product Owner and the external provider. Communicate status updates, planned activities, service issues, and follow-up actions to relevant stakeholders. Support coordination with critical business stakeholders (Fire Brigade) Support the tracking of major incidents, recurring issues, problems, and escalations affecting Unified Communication services. Ensure that escalated issues are documented, followed up, and visible to the Service Delivery Manager. Help coordinate communication and follow-up during major service disruptions impacting end users or business operations, establishing contact with service desk, management, and other stakeholders. Support the Problem management process, RCA analysis and improvement actions for repeated service issues. Coordinate, analyze, review, and approval of change requests. Support and work in close contact with Contract value management to identify gaps in the CMDB ensuring the provider applies the needed corrections and permanent remediation to the identified process gaps. Support reporting activities related to service quality, incident trends, provider performance, and user feedback. Assist in identifying opportunities for service improvement, standardization, optimization, cost reductions and better user experience. Support improvement initiatives, rollouts, and service transition activities as required. Ensure governance artefacts and service records are accurate and up to date. Requirements Education: Degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Business Informatics or in a comparable field. Working Experience: 6+ years of experience in Unified Communications technologies and services. 3-5 years of experience in IT service coordination, service delivery, and provider management. 3-5 years of experience working with ITIL service management processes. 3-5 years of experience working with external service providers and managed services. 3-5 years of experience supporting global enterprise environments. 1-3 years agile project experience (nice to have). Language skills: Advanced level in English. Technical skills: Advanced skills in Unified Communications technologies and services. Advanced skills in IT service management and service delivery governance. Advanced skills in ServiceNow and service management tools. Intermediate skills in cloud solutions, virtualization, and monitoring tools. Intermediate skills in networking and telecommunications infrastructure. Intermediate skills in IT security and vulnerability management. Intermediate skills in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices. Soft skills: Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills. Advanced organizational and coordination skills. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced decision-making and prioritization skills. Advanced self-organized working skills with a proactive mindset. Advanced collaboration skills in multicultural and global environments. Advanced continuous learning and growth mindset. What we offer: Living BASF means being part of a culture where the focus is on people and on their professional and personal development. Our diversity, collaboration, and leadership style make the difference. When you join our team, we offer you: A hybrid and flexible working model Access to a learning ecosystem with on ‑ demand resources and tools Private medical insurance for you and your family from day one, as well as life insurance Additional flexible leave days, in addition to your statutory vacation days The possibility of remote work from abroad for up to 6 weeks a year A day off on your birthday A day off for moving Annual bonus (subject to meeting the requirements established by internal policies) Well ‑ being benefits, such as on ‑ site nutrition services and massages BASF considers Law N° 19.691 and Decree N° 73/019 in all its hiring processes. Every qualified candidate who meets the requirements established in the job description will be considered in this hiring process with no distinction. Moreover, BASF is an equal-opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, age, civil and social status, national origin, disability, sex, gender identity or expressions, or any other candidate or employee´s characteristic or group that is not related to their aptitude and suitability for the position. jobs.name: EHS Specialist Italy
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Agriculture is all about balance. The balance that is crucial to everyone’s existence – also for our Agricultural Solutions division. We connect innovative thinking with practical action to find the right balance for success – for farmers, agriculture and future generations. With seeds and traits, crop protection and digital solutions, we help farmers produce food more efficiently, protect the land and meet the needs of society. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will employed by BASF Agricultural Solutions Italy S.r.l. Managing EHS Specialist and RSPP responsabilities for BASF small sites in Italy, ensuring compliance with Italian Health & Safety legislation and internal EHS standards. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the EHS management system, including BASF Responsible Care requirements, procedures, and governance. Promote a strong safety culture across Italian sites through EHS campaigns, training initiatives, Safety Days, and Behavior-Based Safety programs. Monitor regulatory developments and ensure the timely implementation of required actions related to health, safety, environment, process safety, and security. Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions, emergency preparedness activities, and site safety reviews. Support environmental compliance activities, including emissions, water, waste management, supplier audits, and environmental assessments. Functionally coordinate EHS representatives across sites, organize follow-up meetings, monitor action plans, and support management reviews. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, external service providers, contractors, authorities, and regional EHS teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in EHS, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field, with relevant experience in an industrial environment. 3–5 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment roles, preferably within manufacturing, chemical, or industrial sites. jobs.name: Observability Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. You will join the Visibility Team of BASF whose mission it is to build an AI and big data fueled observability solution to predict, avoid and analyze complex disturbances in BASF’s global infrastructure. The team provides and develops the platform that stakeholders such as infrastructure operations, application teams and other business partners can get the required insights from. Aim is to give BASF an end to end visibility solution for Application Performance Management (APM), Network Performance Monitoring (NPM) and IT Infrastructure Monitoring (ITIM). RESPONSIBILITIES Understand the needs of internal Business Partners and their use cases regarding observability. Steering of managed services. Own end-to-end accountability for the BASF observability landscape—from infrastructure design and tooling development through CI/CD deployment, operational monitoring, and continuous improvement. Combine the strengths of observability tools in place, e.g. Grafana. Gigamon. Traffic Broker. Zabbix. Cisco. Thousand Eyes. ELK. Find additional ways to leverage the collected system data to generate value for BASF. Leverage AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort in daily business QUALIFICATIONS Good overview across enterprise IT landscape architectures. Expertise in network infrastructure desirable. Proactive mindset. Cloud experience (AWS, Azure) highly beneficial. Python/JavaScript/Shell scripting. Experienced in using code repository (GitLab, Bitbucket). Knowledge about CI/CD tools is also a plus. Monitoring tools (not all mandatory, some background/understanding): APM: Datadog, Dynatrace. NPM: SolarWinds, NetScout. ITM: Zabbix, Nagios, checkMK. Log engines: ELK, Splunk. Steering managed services experience. Daily usage of AI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot). Well understanding about AI concepts like: LLM. MCP Server. Agent. Skills. Good ability to gain competence in new assignment areas quickly and independently covering new technologies, methods and skills is essential. Extraordinary analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills. Out of the box thinking is desirable to understand and eliminate complexity and to find innovative solutions for complex problems. Able to work as part of a globally spread, virtual team. Strong will and ability to communicate within and outside the team is key. Education and Work Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree / University degree / University of applied Sciences degree (IT, Business IT) is required. Professional English skills mandatory. Minimum 5+ years job experience in security operations within mid & large-size enterprise environments. Technical career preferably in information technologies, telecommunications technologies, process control technology, communication technologies. Ability to work within small, creative teams as well as cross-functional teams. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. CONTACT Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco ( felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com )

jobs.name: Purchase-to-Pay (Intern) - Mandarin Speaker
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Provide Accounts Payable's payment process related support to deliver AP services to BASF companies in Asia Pacific in accordance with established processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC), local company legal and statutory requirements. Ensure that timelines and quality are met within the service levels agreements. Main Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to): To monitor P2P RISK MONITOR by ensuring SPOT Checks samples are strictly checked and completed before the last day of the month/document due date. Work closely with respective team (eg: invoicing team) to reduce the SPOT and duplicate check error rate. Ensure SPOT check and duplicate error root cause is identified and correction action is in place. To monitor and manage domestic payment method e.g. Bank acceptance draft To support forex payment (trade and non-trade) compliance check documentation e.g. tax clearance documents, customs clearance, shipping documents and invoice copy. To process payment proposals run for 3rd Party vendors and employee vendors & intercompany based on country requirement and schedule (daily and weekly and schedule) To ensure task are performed completely within timeline and before bank cut off time. To ensure Manual Payment Instruction (APOB) is cleared or vendor open item is blocked before payment proposal run. To monitor payment traffic/Global Payment System (GPS) status and bank rejection once proposal executed. To ensure payment transaction is successfully transferred to bank. In case of GPS rejection, to perform immediate corrective action and execute additional payment to ensure on time payment, if required. To prepare and perform manual payment, free format instruction (FFI) and obtain bank approval from authorizers before bank cut off time To download bank slip from bank portal and save them in shared drive upon payment execution. To liaise closely with bank authorizers in handling online bank transaction (manual payments, local bank, free format instruction) is and ensure timely approvals To support local business/ local finance and BSSCKL internal in urgent payment handling on stipulated deadline To attend request or inquiry on Account Payable especially payment related queries via payment functional mailbox, AP Service Desk and Payable Query mailboxes To support vendor management team (if required) in attending calls from 3rd party vendor, external parties as well as BASF users in payment related queries Be the Key person/ focal person to liaise with banks in payment rejection/payment failure related matters To support transition/projects activities and perform testing, whenever necessary To support centralized audit activities whenever required including system demo and provide required documentation and samples, and attend to audit queries etc. To response to payment related queries or concerns from local business/local finance, BSSCKL internal and vendors To act as back up to team members and perform payment task as when required. To ensure processes are complying to BASF policies & guideline, local company’s policy, bank/ legal and statutory requirements. To maintain awareness of the latest fraud trends especially phishing call and email. To ensure that all the emails sent/received are to/from accurate email addresses and avoid revealing company details to unknown callers. Quality and Continuous Improvement Identify and recommend new idea / solutions to Specialist/Expert & Managers for continuous improvement opportunities. Perform routine update to Accounts Payable documentation (e.g. Work Instruction, Process Definition, Job Aid< Knowledge Management) when required Support existing team members through proper knowledge transfer, sharing of resource, knowledge and experience and best practice thereby ensuring quality is maintained through any staff transition. Support regional and global project improvements activity e.g. involve in User Acceptance Test and Training Service Management Execute work in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and excellent customer service. Stakeholder Management Develop and maintain working relationships with customers to ensure that solutions are adopted, implemented and maintained appropriately. Frequent cooperation within BASF Group and/or BSSCKL: Counterparts in local company and end-users Cross function teams within BSSCKL Manager, senior analyst and peers within Finance Delivery teams Other support functions within BSSCKL e.g. Control, Project, Quality & Compliance (PQC) team, Corporate Audit teams Requirements Education & Working Experience: Currently pursuing or completing the final year of a diploma or bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or other related disciplines. Able to commit to a minimum internship period of five (5) months. Fluent in Mandarin (spoken, written, and reading) to support Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and markets. Reputable knowledge and understanding of P2P and accounting functions is a plus. External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing is a plus. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Experience working in an SAP work environment is a plus. Knowledge and experience of MS office tools, CONCUR, SAP system or another ERP system is a plus.

En caso de requerir algún apoyo, favor de comunicarlo durante tu primer contacto con Atracción de Talento. Estamos buscando un(a) Especialista Senior de Servicio al Cliente. El objetivo de la posición será gestionar el proceso order-to-invoice para la cartera de clientes asignada, garantizando una experiencia de servicio excepcional mediante una coordinación efectiva con los diferentes stakeholders internos. Asimismo, será responsable de asegurar el cumplimiento de los lineamientos regionales y las políticas de BASF. En este rol estarás a cargo de: Gestionar el proceso de Order to Invoice, garantizando una experiencia de servicio excepcional para los clientes regionales asignados y asegurando el cumplimiento de los lineamientos corporativos y del negocio. Responsable de resolver situaciones complejas, anticipar necesidades del cliente e impulsar acciones de manera proactiva. Gestionar clientes estratégicos del negocio BASF Care Chemicals, brindando un servicio personalizado y asegurando el cumplimiento de altos estándares de atención y servicio. Contribuir a los resultados financieros de los clientes, identificando oportunidades de crecimiento, iniciativas de venta adicional y posibles desviaciones en los pronósticos Impulsar iniciativas de mejora continua, orientadas a incrementar la satisfacción del cliente. Analizar y gestionar procesos complejos de Order-to-Cash, utilizando habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas para apoyar la toma de decisiones y asegurar la continuidad operativa. Monitorear y analizar KPIs de Supply Chain y negocio, identificando oportunidades de mejora e impulsando la adopción de mejores prácticas. Desarrollar e implementar soluciones sostenibles, mitigando riesgos y garantizando la continuidad del negocio ante escenarios complejos o cambios en el entorno operativo. Liderar el onboarding de nuevos colaboradores y actuar como referente en procesos complejos. Si cuentas con: Título universitario en Administración, Cadena de Suministro, Logística o carreras afines. Entre 5 y 8 años de experiencia en Servicio al Cliente y cadena de suministro, desempeñándote en entornos dinámicos e interfuncionales, con interacción directa con clientes y gestión de procesos operativos, preferentemente con exposición a los mercados de Estados Unidos y/o Canadá. Compliance Manager,Tokyo 勤務地 会社 ジョブフィールド 職種 ジョブID 柔軟な働き方の選択肢 勤務地 会社 ジョブフィールド 職種 ジョブID 柔軟な働き方の選択肢 今すぐ応募する 輸出入・通関・貿易コンプライアンスマネージャー 勤務地 ：東京 グレード ：5 ポジション概要 日本における輸出入業務、通関業務および貿易コンプライアンス全般の責任者として、ハブ組織および日本国内の関係部門と連携しながら、物流・通関オペレーションの最適化とコンプライアンス遵守を推進します。社内外のステークホルダーとの窓口として機能し、物流サービスプロバイダーの管理、業務改善、リスク管理、デジタル化推進などを主導します。 主な職務内容 1. 輸出入・通関オペレーション管理 日本における輸出入および通関業務のKPI達成、品質維持、法令遵守を統括 フォワーダー、通関業者、船会社、タンクオペレーター等の物流サービスプロバイダーを管理 サービスレベル、コスト、パフォーマンスの継続的改善を推進 日本およびAPAC地域のサプライチェーンチームと協働し、安定した物流オペレーションを実現 業務効率化、デジタル化、自動化プロジェクトを推進 2. 通関・貿易管理 関税法、外国為替及び外国貿易法などの関連法規および社内ポリシーの遵守を確保 輸入関税・消費税等の適正な申告・支払いプロセスを管理 税関や関係当局との窓口として監査、照会、紛争対応を実施 EPA/FTA（経済連携協定・自由貿易協定）を活用した関税最適化を推進 AEO制度、保税制度、フリートレードゾーンなど各種優遇制度の運用管理 グローバルおよびリージョナルへの各種レポーティングを担当 3. 物流ベンダーマネジメント 物流サービスプロバイダー（3PL/LSP）の契約・サービス管理 業務移管、ナレッジトランスファー、変更管理の推進 ベンダーパフォーマンスの評価・改善活動の実施 輸配送リスクおよびコンプライアンスリスクの管理 物流コスト最適化の推進 4. 貿易コンプライアンス 日本における National Trade Compliance Officer（NTCO）として機能 貿易管理・輸出管理規制の変更をモニタリングし事業影響を評価 規制対象品目、制裁対象者・取引先のスクリーニング管理 Internal Compliance Program（ICP）の維持・改善 貿易コンプライアンス教育および啓発活動の推進 5. リスク管理および継続的改善 アクセス権管理、データ保護、事業継続計画（BCP）を含むリスク管理の実施 業務プロセスの標準化および文書化 グローバル・リージョナルプロジェクトへの参画 データ分析を活用した業務改善とオペレーショナルエクセレンスの推進 応募資格 必須要件 大学卒業以上 （経営学、サプライチェーンマネジメント、国際物流、貿易関連分野歓迎） 通関・貿易実務またはサプライチェーン領域で5年以上の経験 多国籍企業またはグローバル環境での業務経験 サプライチェーンおよび物流オペレーションに関する知識 ステークホルダーマネジメント能力 英語による業務遂行能力（海外チームとの協業あり） 歓迎要件 通関士資格 貿易管理・輸出管理の知識 SAPの使用経験 BIツール（Power BI等）の活用経験 物流ベンダーマネジメント経験 プロジェクトマネジメント経験 今すぐ応募する A unique total offer: you@BASF jobs.name: Assistant Manager - Technical Development Polyurethane CASE
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Main responsibilities Administration & Management of EHS requirements: Support of internal / external ISO 9000 & IATF16949 audit. Responsible for the safety of the workplace with fulfilling the requirement from both local organization and regional requirements. Product application and Project management: Handles management and resource planning for country TD team to prioritize projects & customers, monitor and prioritize resources as needed to ensure proper success rate. Aligns Technical Development resources with local sales needs to achieve trial and troubleshooting requests. Analyzes all opportunities, Identifies, coordinates, and follows up development of new customers business, new applications, relevant processing technologies. Coaches & drives Technical Development team in all customer/processing related requests. Aligns Technical Development resources with country Sales head to achieve local sales team support requirements. Secures Know-how/IP protection with PMD/Technical Development teams. Work closely with product management team to ensure reliable supply, monitor RM/FG cost and process optimization project to ensure competitiveness on market. Ensure that lab equipment for CASE in ATDC (Application & Technical Development Center) is well-maintained, always calibrated in desired frequency and in perfect working condition, particularly equipment used in daily Quality Control. Technical support of market strategy: Drive as a coordinate to consolidate ASEAN CASE business update (data collection from CASE ASEAN Sales colleagues) & project update for timely and monthly update/report to CASE regional team. Identify and provide the guidance on CASE target applications, mapping with ASEAN country requirements. Provide technical inputs/ recommendation to strategy development. Visit customers to collect and analyze field information for industry trends. Aligns Technical Development resources with country Sales needs to achieve business support requirements. Aligns with regional CASE Technical development team and collaborate with CASE research developments regional team for having a necessary to drive and strive for a project achievement. Manages resources for TD/TS to achieve SBU/BM/country strategy targets. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. At least 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in the polyurethane industry, preferably in technical service or R&D , with exposure to polyurethane coatings, adhesives, sealants, and elastomers markets . Expertise knowledge in PU System from product properties, product development, application development, processing technology. Good understanding on technical perspective on the related target applications of footwear industry. Full experience of PU applications in Automotive or CASE industries. Strong written and spoken English skills, with good computer literacy. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

jobs.name: SAP EWM, StRM, IM Consultant - (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. The role provides Application support for SAP logistics processes, ensuring stable operations, fast incident resolution and continuous improvement across SAP EWM, Inventory Management and Stock Room Management (SAP MM-IM or/and SAP WM) Key Responsibilities : • Application support: Receive, prioritize and document incidents and service requests with impact, evidence and reproduction steps. Analyze complex warehouse and inventory issues across configuration, logs, interfaces and process dependencies. • Standard issue resolution: Resolve user issues, authorization questions, errors and transaction problems using defined procedures and knowledge articles. Get supported by AI features for ticket handling support. • Cross-team coordination: Work with cross teams to resolve technical defects, interface failures and performance issues. • Problem management: Being able to early identify recurring issues and define PDCA to able to resolve problems • Change and release support: Support approved fixes, configuration changes, testing, transport preparation, release activities and cutover support. • Operational excellence: Maintain runbooks, support documentation and knowledge base articles to improve first-time resolution and system stability. • Escalation management: Escalate to Level 3 or development teams where required, providing full diagnostics, evidence and business impact assessment. Required Qualifications : • Several years of experience in SAP application support, preferably in logistics, warehouse management or inventory management environments. • Good functional knowledge of SAP EWM, SAP MM-IM and SAP SRM Stock Room Management (or Warehouse Management (SAP WM)), including inbound, outbound, stock movements, inventory handling and warehouse execution. • Strong experience with ITSM processes, ticket handling, incident management, change management and structured troubleshooting. • Basic technical understanding of SAP logs, jobs, interfaces, IDocs, RFCs and integration monitoring. • Basic understanding, monitoring and error handling for APIs, Kafka streams, BTP and debugging • Strong analytical skills, customer orientation and clear communication in English. Nice to Have • Experience with MES or other Level 3 system integrations connected to warehouse and inventory processes. • German, Spanish or Mandarin WHAT WE OFFER Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

jobs.name: Assembly and Inspection Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Assembly and Inspection Technician Wyandotte, MI We are looking for an Assembly and Inspection Technician to join our Performance Materials team in Wyandotte. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. As a member of the Inspection & Assembly department at Wyandotte, you are responsible for verifying finished part quality and assembling different components into a finished product.  You will work with other inspectors and assemblers in the department to ensure good product quality as well as the supervisor, assembly lead, and material handlers.  You will partner daily with this team to hit production targets and identify defects to reduce waste and customer impact while following safety protocols. During your 8-hour shift as a Assembly and Inspection Technician, you will Inspect molded parts for defects, following work instructions to ensure adherence to quality standards Assemble components together to create a finished part per standard Sort parts based on labeling, physical requirements, and other criteria Move & organize bins, boxes, and other items If you... Possess a High school diploma or equivalent. Have previous experience at a manufacturing plant Are able to work in fast-paced environment to assemble or inspect parts at high rate and quality in a safe manner Are able to collaborate and work well in a team setting Have the ability to lift at least 30 pounds Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. jobs.name: Canola Sites Operations Lead
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Canola Site Operations Lead, you will enjoy a diverse role overseeing the safety, compliance and efficient operation of BASF's canola seed sites across Australia. You'll be responsible for site governance, infrastructure, EHS and regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and CAPEX delivery while working closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to drive operational excellence across multiple locations. How You Will Do It Lead the safe, compliant and efficient operation of BASF’s Australian canola seed sites, ensuring consistent standards across multiple locations. Drive site governance, infrastructure maintenance and asset management to support reliable and audit-ready operations. Coordinate contractors, suppliers and service providers, ensuring strong performance, compliance and operational excellence. Champion EHS, stewardship and regulatory compliance through audits, inspections, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead site CAPEX activities, partnering with key stakeholders to deliver operational improvements and business outcomes. Collaborate closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to support successful canola seed production programs across Australia. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring experience in agricultural operations, along with a strong commitment to safety, compliance and operational excellence. You'll enjoy working across multiple sites, building relationships with diverse stakeholders and driving efficient, well-governed operations. You will: Hold a qualification in Agricultural Science, Business, or a related discipline. Have experience in agricultural operations, farming, seed production or rural business coordination, ideally within a multi-site environment. Demonstrate knowledge of EHS requirements, auditing processes and regulatory compliance within an agricultural setting. Be highly organised with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate contractors, suppliers and site activities effectively. Have a hands-on approach, with experience operating farm machinery or agricultural equipment highly regarded. Be a proactive communicator who can collaborate effectively across operations, breeding, seed production and support teams What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position As the Key Account Owner for the customers in Greater China as assigned, the incumbent is responsible to achieve sales target and KPIs according to the sales strategies Lead, challenge and support distribution, marketing, technical and customer service to realize the sales plan together Identify high-potential new customers and set up action plans for new business realization Main Tasks Responsible for the day-to-day sales management of the customers. jobs.name: Technical Services Manager
jobs.description: About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Technical Marketing Manager, you'll play a pivotal role at the intersection of agronomy, technical expertise and commercial strategy. Working closely with sales, customers and industry stakeholders, you'll lead the technical direction of BASF's crop protection portfolio, develop compelling technical marketing programs and drive the successful launch of innovative solutions across New Zealand. How You Will Do It Lead technical strategy and provide expert support for BASF's crop protection portfolio, helping drive customer success and commercial growth. Develop and manage agronomy trials, translating technical data and field insights into practical recommendations and commercial opportunities. Create technical marketing materials, product positioning and data-driven stories that support customer engagement and sales effectiveness. Partner with sales teams, customers and industry stakeholders to provide technical advice, training and product expertise. Lead the planning and execution of new product launches, including business case development, market assessments and launch strategies. Investigate field performance enquiries and provide technical guidance to optimise product performance and customer outcomes. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring a strong foundation in agronomy and crop protection, combined with the ability to translate technical information into practical solutions for customers and commercial teams. You'll enjoy building relationships, sharing knowledge and influencing outcomes across a diverse stakeholder network. You will: Hold a degree in Agricultural Science or a related discipline. Have significant experience within the crop protection, agrichemical or agribusiness industry, ideally with exposure to a broad range of crop segments. Bring proven agronomic expertise and experience working with crop protection products. Be confident presenting technical information, delivering training and engaging with customers, industry groups and commercial teams. Demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to convert data and field observations into actionable business insights. Possess excellent communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.name: Portfolio Manager/ Trader Energy (m/w/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF BASF's future is climate-neutral - and we are shaping the way there! We give BASF access to renewable electricity and other energy sources with low upstream emissions. We participate in production, conclude long-term supply contracts, trade on wholesale markets and thus competitively supply BASF's European sites with essential energy sources. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As part of our European portfolio management and trading team at BASF, you will take on a key role in managing energy market exposures and actively contribute to the development of trading strategies. In your new position, you manage and optimize short-term exposure in Gas and Carbon markets. Together with your colleagues, you develop, implement, and execute hedging and trading strategies across European energy markets. Furthermore, you execute trades both OTC and on exchanges across different maturities and instruments. Your expertise is in demand! You closely collaborate with Analytics and Origination teams to support informed trading decisions. Not least, you ensure alignment with internal stakeholders and foster transparent communication within BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER degree in economics, energy economics, natural sciences or a comparable field at least three years of professional experience in trading or portfolio management of energy commodities strong understanding of at least two commodities (power, gas or carbon) as well as hands-on experience in trading, hedging and basic technical analysis very good german and english skills as well as confident use of MS office; programming skills (e.g. python) are a plus analytical team player with strong communication skills, high level of initiative and a structured way of working WHAT WE OFFER Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in BASF) Mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development Career paths as professional development to other positions in the company (including job rotation) Support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) Fitness and health studio, medical center with numerous offers for your health Deutschlandticket as a discounted job ticket, job bike, availability of e-charging stations for private vehicles HOW TO REACH US Bonnie Gardt (Talent Acquisition), bonnie.gardt@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59672 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US The future of BASF is climate-neutral – and we are shaping the path to get there! We enable BASF to access renewable electricity and other energy sources. We invest in production facilities, conclude long-term supply contracts, trade on wholesale markets, and thus supply BASF sites with energy at competitive prices. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Intern, Master Data (Finance) 1
jobs.description: Do you want to work with passionate teams, providing excellent business and digital services to the Asia Pacific region? Do you want an open, supportive, and caring working environment? Do you view your development needs seriously as we do? If YES, then take your career to the #NextLevel with BASF ! The internship program is available all year long and here’s what you can expect A rewarding internship journey with tasks and projects that enable you to transfer your theoretical skills to a real business environment and gain exposure to diverse parts of the Order to Cash (O2C) team. You will be able to explore digital technologies such as data management Collaborative and multicultural atmosphere where you are an essential team player to support colleagues and managers in a wide range projects and activities Guidance, coaching and feedback from supervisors on performance which help you learn and shape your working style About The Role During the internship period, you will be exposed to these areas: Data Analysis & Visualization: Responsible for turning raw data into valuable insights using relevant analytics tools i.e VBA Macro, Power BI, Tableau or other useful visualization tools Visualize and present data as well as insights in a comprehensible manner to all stakeholders and teams. Collect, organize and interpret data closely with the team for process improvement. Process Improvement & Digitalization: Design and implementation of measures to solve specific improvements related business problems. Facilitate the O2C community in process optimization by providing insight related to strategic and industry trends via utilization of new tools or technologies. About You Currently pursuing Bachelor degree in computer science, programming or data science Knowledge in data analysis and statistical modeling with acumen in finance and accounting is a plus Proficient in visualization tool e.g. Power BI, Tableau or other useful visualization tools and programming languages [Phyton, R, Javascript] Curious about data, new technologies and detail oriented Proficient in English Preferably 6 months internship Application Procedure Submit your CV on our online job portal. In your application, state clearly your available period , and your expected graduation date. You will be contacted for interview if you are shortlisted for the position. In any case, we will retain your profile in our database for future opportunities. BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre was established in 2005. Located in Kuala Lumpur, the regional service hub has approximately 1,100 employees and growing. Focused on being a competency and digitalization driven hub, it also provides quality functional and know-how services in the areas of finance, controlling, human resources, real estate and facilities management, communications, environmental, health and safety, procurement, import-export order management, and information services to BASF companies and affiliates in the Asia Pacific region. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay that cover the Europe and Americas regions. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 111,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €87.3 billion in 2022. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the U.S. Further information at www.basf.com .

Main responsibilities EHS Management System Gap analysis and implementation for the new EHS regulation and requirement. Maintains EHS management system (IMS) and documentations. Support to implement EHS standards to compliance according local and BASF requirement. Define training needs, coordinate/arranges/delivery EHS training. Benchmarks the EHS performances in the site (i.e. Initiates measures and proposals to contain the potential issues and continuously improves EHS standards of the Sites). Stakeholder Management Interfaces with site management & Business unit. Interfaces with local industry groups on behalf of BASF for issue management and advocacy. Represents BASF to participant local industry organization. Dialogues regularly with site managements to evaluate level of service, prioritizes & allocates resources and improves effectively and efficiency of the EHS service. Implement service catalogue and conducts service dialogue with site and business unit to fine-tune the service scopes. TDS (Transportation & Distribution Safety) Ensure safety and security standards for all modes of transportation are implementing and compliance. Nomination as Country/Site Dangerous Goods Safety Advisor. Training and Guidance to TDS related personnel involved in distribution safety processes. Conduct TDS Reviews for all Responsible person. Conduct Safety and Quality Assessments of suppliers, service providers and customers that transport or store our raw materials or goods. Incorporation of Transportation and Distribution Safety Performance in the Procurement Process. Carrier/Trucker Qualification Checks and Performance Evaluation. Incident Investigation, Corrective Actions and Reporting. ER (Emergency Response) Nomination as Country Emergency Expert. Assist to develop, review On-site Emergency Response Plans and scenario, fire prevention concept and compliance to legal and BASF requirement. Conduct Fire prevention assessment and fire prevention concept to meet as per requirement. Provide expertise to support and review for fire prevention design and equipment installation. Crisis and Security Management Nomination as Country/Local Security Manager as per BASF requirement. Provide expertise to support Site Security concept. Conduct self-assessment site security and security risk assessment. Coordinate with regional team to provide security review. Lead to investigate security incident. Develop and prepare readiness Country Incident Management. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in EHS, Science, Engineering, Production, Chemical Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or PhD is an advantage. At least 5 years of experience in production, engineering, or EHS is required. Leadership experience is an advantage. A professional-level Safety Officer must hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field. Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required. Strong communication and management skills, familiarity with local EHS legislation and legal requirements, and a solid understanding of EHS unit scope and functions are required. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. jobs.name: National EHS Specialist
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a National EHS Specialist, you will be the trusted advisor for Environment, Health & Safety across BASF's Agricultural Solutions business in Australia and New Zealand. You'll partner with business leaders to strengthen our EHS culture, drive compliance, influence safe work practices and deliver continuous improvement across diverse agricultural operations, sites and supply chain partners. How You Will Do It Partner with business leaders across ANZ to provide expert EHS guidance and drive EHS priorities across the Agricultural Solutions (AP) business. Ensure compliance with Responsible Care principles, Australian and New Zealand legislation, and BASF EHS standards across sites, warehouses, contractors and suppliers. Champion and strengthen BASF's OneAP EHS culture through engagement, coaching, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, assess business impacts and implement practical compliance and risk management strategies. Analyse EHS performance data and KPIs to identify trends, drive improvements and support leadership decision-making. Travel across ANZ operational sites to build strong stakeholder relationships and support safe, compliant and high-performing operations. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring significant EHS leadership experience and a passion for creating safe, compliant and high-performing workplaces. You'll be confident influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex operational environments and translating regulatory requirements into practical business solutions. You will: Hold a Diploma in Environmental Health & Safety or equivalent. Jusqu’au 1er juillet, notre activité faisait partie de BASF. Dans le cadre de cette transition, toutes les offres d’emploi ainsi que le processus de candidature sont encore hébergés sur la plateforme BASF et présentés sous l’identité visuelle de BASF. Merci de ne pas vous laisser dérouter par cette situation : tous les postes proposés sont des opportunités au sein de Surventis, et votre candidature nous sera directement transmise. Chez Surventis, nous allons au-delà des apparences dans tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous plaçons nos clients au cœur de nos décisions, anticipons leurs besoins et développons des solutions qui créent une véritable valeur ajoutée ainsi que des partenariats durables. Nous nous inspirons mutuellement à voir plus loin, à prendre pleinement la responsabilité de notre travail et à repousser sans cesse les limites du possible. Si vous venez avec toute votre authenticité, osez remettre en question les évidences et souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une équipe qui met réellement ses valeurs en pratique, alors vous êtes au bon endroit. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Rattaché au Responsable HSE, vous proposez et mettez en œuvre les systèmes et les programmes de prévention destinés à améliorer la sécurité des procédés du site en adéquation avec les exigences règlementaires et Groupe SURVENTIS. À ce titre : Vous garantissez l'animation de la politique du site en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous garantissez le pilotage des analyses de risques des installations lors des projets d´amélioration ou des installations nouvelles (APR, HAZOP, SHE review, PID review etc. ) en accord avec les référentiels Groupe et en lien avec les experts Groupe ; Vous garantissez la mise à jour des Études de Dangers sur les installations neuves ou existantes, notamment dans le cadre des révisions quinquennales ; Vous garantissez le conseil et l'assistance dans votre domaine ; Vous contribuez à la prévention et la maîtrise du risque industriel sur le site y compris au travers de l'animation du système de gestion de la sécurité (SGS) incluant la rédaction des dossiers de sécurité ; Vous contribuez à la mise en place et à l´évolution des procédures et consignes en sécurité des procédés et veiller à leurs conformités d'application ; Vous contribuez au respect des législations et réglementations et des exigences SURVENTIS en vigueur en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous contribuez à la gestion des modifications sur le site ; Vous contribuez aux missions du service HSE. VOTRE PROFIL Doté d'un diplôme en Ingénierie des Procédés, vous possédez une expérience confirmée en suivi de site SEVESO ainsi que dans les méthodologies d'analyse des risques (APR, HAZOP, ...) ; Vos capacités relationnelles vous permettent de gérer des projets transversaux ; Vous êtes capable d'animer des sessions de formation ; Vous maîtrisez l'informatique (MS Office) et parlez couramment l'anglais. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. jobs.name: Senior Manager, Technology
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Own and drive regional technology for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates as the single technology focal point for Asia Pacific. Lead technical execution of investment projects and ensure on‑time, on‑budget delivery. Drive OpEx and cost‑reduction initiatives to improve asset effectiveness and KPIs. Coordinate cross‑functional stakeholders to implement technology and reliability measures. Provide hands‑on technical support, troubleshooting and capability building across the region. Main Tasks Act as the accountable regional technology owner for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates in Asia - proactively drive technical support, decisions and improvements at all production sites. Lead technical dialogues with external partners and project teams to define, design and approve tie‑ins, plant integrations and raw‑material feed specifications; own the technical interface and ensure robust integration plans. Serve as the single interface between Global Technology & Strategy, Operations and Regional Business Management; prepare and steer internal decision packages and approval processes (Commissions S and F). Evaluate technical and economic viability of projects - from debottlenecking and new site assessments to alternative feedstock options - and recommend clear go/no‑go and make‑or‑buy decisions aligned with regional strategy. Drive and/or lead cost and technology benchmarking studies, delivering actionable recommendations to reduce manufacturing cost and improve competitiveness. Own process and product safety activities for the portfolio in Asia, including regulatory compliance and risk‑mitigation measures; escalate and resolve safety or compliance gaps. Lead Operational Excellence across all Acrylic Acid & Acrylates assets in the region: define targets, prioritize initiatives, sponsor implementation and ensure sustained KPI improvements. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a closely related engineering/technical field. Experience: Minimum 6 years of hands‑on experience in chemical manufacturing or technology development, with demonstrated problem‑solving in production environments and proven responsibility in managing investment projects (engineering, commissioning or debottlenecking). Technical expertise: Strong, practical knowledge of Acrylic Acid & Acrylates production processes, including process design, plant operations and process control systems. Project and commercial skills: Solid track record in project management (scope, schedule, budget), technology and manufacturing cost evaluations, and executing make‑or‑buy assessments. Operational excellence & safety: Experience driving OpEx initiatives and applying process and product safety, regulatory compliance, and risk‑reduction measures in plant environments. Communication & leadership: Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin preferred. Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and cross‑functional communication skills; ability to lead technical discussions with internal and external partners. Tools & methods: Proficiency with engineering design standards, manufacturing cost models, common process simulation/control tools and standard office software. 请时刻警惕任何可能的招聘欺诈行为！请注意，巴斯夫绝不会在任何情况下向候选人以任何形式收取任何费用。

jobs.name: Operatore di Produzione - Fino Mornasco (CO)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Lozioni per la cura della pelle, shampoo delicati, creme per la protezione solare, detergenti delicati ed efficienti per la casa e l'industria: tutti questi prodotti impiegano ingredienti formulati dalla nostra divisione Care Chemicals. In collaborazione con i nostri clienti, lavoriamo in tutto il mondo a soluzioni innovative, sempre più attraverso l'utilizzo di materie prime naturali e sostenibili, per rispondere alle richieste degli utilizzatori finali. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Il candidato eseguirà con precisione le procedure coordinando l'attività di produzione in base a metodi di lavoro prestabiliti, rispettando gli standard di qualità BASF, le norme di sicurezza e le linee guida. Si interfaccerà con il sistema di controllo automatizzato d'impianto (DCS). Effettuerà determinazioni analitiche dei prodotti in processo. Effettuerà operazioni ausiliarie seguendo il programma consegnato al Supervisore di Produzione (movimentazione delle merci, carico delle materie prime, scarico dei prodotti finiti, pulizia linee e svaporamenti...). Utilizzerà il carrello elevatore per la movimentazione del materiale necessario per le lavorazioni, seguendo scrupolosamente tutte le norme di sicurezza. Verificherà costantemente e direttamente le condizioni delle apparecchiature, segnalerà al Supervisore di Produzione le eventuali anomalie e darà il proprio contributo alla risoluzione delle stesse, secondo le proprie conoscenze e informazioni. Gestirà la documentazione prevista dai sistemi di ambiente, qualità e sicurezza. WHAT YOU OFFER Il candidato ideale è in possesso di un diploma di scuola superiore tecnica (perito chimico) e/o ha maturato una prima esperienza in ambito chimico. La conoscenza delle norme in materia di sicurezza e salute costituisce un requisito qualificante per la scelta del candidato. Conoscenza di base della lingua Inglese. Lavoro su ciclo continuo. WHAT WE OFFER Opportunità di crescita in un contesto multinazionale e multibusiness. Offriamo benefit che soddisfano le necessità e le aspettative dei nostri collaboratori nelle aree formazione e sviluppo, ambiente lavorativo e retribuzione: clicca qui per saperne di più Cosa Offriamo HOW TO REACH US Hai domande sul processo di selezione o sulla posizione? I suoi prodotti sono impiegati in molti settori di attività quali edilizia, agricoltura, packaging, materie plastiche e automotive. You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes. Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations. In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation.
