jobs.name: Digital Trainee Program - Software Engineering (Data Products & Semantics)
jobs.description: Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur attracts, inspire and develop diverse talents who will elevate BASF’s digital journey. As one of the world’s largest chemical companies, BASF is on a mission to create chemistry with a sustainable future. The Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur, alongside four other Digital Hubs across the globe are part of the technology powerhouse driving our vision. Join our organization and make an impact in an inclusive and diverse work environment. We value individual differences and provide opportunities for you to contribute your unique perspective towards our collective goals. With BASF’s Digital Trainee Programme, we believe in preparing you for the future: as we embark on one of the largest digital transformation journeys in Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur (DHKL) Hub, we are on the hunt for bright digital talents to be a part of this exciting digital vision for BASF! Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur is supporting the BASF business in transforming the digitalization landscape – our mission is to drive forward the digital transformation of BASF, providing innovative, global and high-quality digital products and services through a strong agile culture – question is, are you up for the challenge? Rest assured, you will be given full accountability from Day 1 to make an impact – be involved in exciting projects that allows you to bring your creativity, passion, and pioneering spirit to our global teams. You will learn from the best mentors and coaches we have to offer, coupled with opportunities to work with some of the brightest digital minds. You will also have opportunities to train and develop technical and functional capabilities – a highly valued expertise for your career development. What to expect: Our 20-month Digital Trainee Programme will give you insights into the various activities that take place in Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur. You will familiarize yourself with various topics across various systems, and how it works in the larger BASF landscape. Gain a comprehensive understanding of unit-specific and cross-unit tasks. After just a short time, you will assume responsibility for exciting projects or subprojects. You will be assigned to four rotations, each lasting approximately five months each. Coordinar el programa de medio ambiente para dar seguimiento a monitoreos de Ruido perimetral y emisiones a la atmosfera de acuerdo con el programa anual para asegurar el cumplimiento requerido por la normatividad aplicable y los requisitos corporativos. Elaborar los reportes y documentos para el cumplimiento de la legislación ambiental vigente y estándares corporativos (RC Report, OD Report, COA. otros relacionados) Desarrollar y administrar los programas de Higiene Industrial y Seguridad Industrial requeridos por la Normatividad Mexicana y BASF, como iluminación, ruido, protección respiratoria, protección auditiva, exposición a agentes químicos, en coordinación con el departamento de Salud Ocupacional y responsables de área, para implementar estrategias de reducción a la exposición y asegurar el cumplimiento legal. Dar soporte en materia de EHS a los equipos multidisciplinarios durante la ejecución de MOC's, y durante en las investigaciones de los incidentes de Ecología, Higiene y Seguridad (por ejemplo: derrames, exposición a químicos y lesiones que ocurran) a fin de identificar causas raíz y establecer acciones correctivas que eviten su recurrencia dentro del sitio, así como los manejos de cambio y el seguimiento al cumplimiento de las acciones generadas de los mismos. Proporcionar soporte con las recomendaciones técnicas de EHS durante la revisión de proyectos de capital, HIRAs y WWA. Desarrolla y administra el programa de capacitación en materia de EHS  de acuerdo a los procedimientos, legislación mexicana aplicable y estándares corporativos. Atender visitas de inspección y auditorías de autoridades federales, estatales o municipales y corporativas.  Mantener comunicación con las autoridades ambientales federales, estatales, municipales y asociaciones (AISTAC, ANIQ) para garantizar que la operación del sitio cumpla con el marco legal y estándares corporativos y representar a la empresa en el área de EHS. Elaborar y estandarizar procedimientos dónde se establezcan los lineamientos para el manejo integral de residuos, sustancias químicas peligrosas, temas ambientales y los requeridos, para garantizar el cumplimiento legal del Sitio. jobs.name: Global Customs Classification Manager I - Expert 1
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position The Global Manager, Customs Classification is accountable for leading and overseeing all customs classification activities for BASF products, raw materials, and non-chemical materials in compliance with international and national regulations. The role ensures accurate classification, regulatory compliance, and harmonized processes globally, while providing strategic direction and governance across regions. In addition, the position is responsible for building and developing a high-performing global team, driving operational excellence, and ensuring alignment with business and regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Customs Service Delivery Lead the delivery of customs classification services to business units globally Act as escalation point for complex classification and customs-related issues Ensure timely and high-quality response to business queries and operational needs Drive effective collaboration with Trade Compliance, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders Customs Classification (Operations) Oversee and ensure accurate classification of products, raw materials, and non-chemical materials Maintain accountability for classification master data quality and governance Define and implement global standards, policies, and procedures for classification Monitor changes in customs laws, ensuring timely implementation across regions Drive global harmonization of classification data and processes Represent BASF interests in internal governance and external regulatory discussions Compliance & Risk Management Ensure full compliance with customs regulations, trade laws, and tariff schedules Lead audit readiness, compliance assessments, and internal control frameworks Identify and mitigate classification-related risks and discrepancies Oversee development and maintenance of SOPs and related documentation Performance Management & Reporting Define and track KPIs for classification activities across regions Review monthly reports, dashboards, and performance metrics Drive data transparency, analytics, and performance improvement initiatives Ensure effective reporting standardization and automation Process & Systems Improvement Lead digitalization and automation initiatives for classification processes Oversee system enhancements (e.g., SAP / SAP GTS) and related testing activities Drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency Ensure alignment of IT solutions with business and compliance needs Leadership & Team Management Lead, develop, and manage a globally distributed classification team Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations Conduct performance reviews and drive a culture of accountability Coach and develop team members to strengthen technical and leadership capabilities Ensure effective workload distribution and resource planning across regions Stakeholder & Governance Management Act as key interface between global, regional, and local classification teams Engage with senior stakeholders (e.g., Trade Compliance, Supply Chain leadership) Lead governance forums, alignment meetings, and knowledge-sharing platforms Ensure consistent adoption of global standards and best practices Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineer or any major in related scientific discipline Minimum 8-10 years’ relevant experience in Classification, Customs and Foreign Trade; familiar with Supply Chain operations Strong expertise in customs classification and trade regulations Knowledge of chemical and non-chemical product classification Experience with SAP and SAP GTS systems Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills Proficient in Microsoft Office tool English (fluent in spoken and written) German language will be advantages

jobs.name: Technician, Utilities & WWTP
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Supports the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Utilities plants to ensure continuous supply of utilities to the site and production plants according to required quality and operational demand. • Provides operational support to Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) activities through monitoring, sampling, laboratory testing and routine operational tasks to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory and operational requirements. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Boiler Operation 1. Supports the safe and reliable operation of Utilities plants and ensures equipment is maintained in good operational condition, including: i. Treated water storage and supply system, Water Demineralization Plant, Cooling Water System, and Fire Hydrant pumping facilities. ii. Steam generation plants and steam distribution system. iii. Air compressors and compressed air supply system. iv. Nitrogen Membrane Generator, LIN storage and evaporator, and nitrogen distribution system. 2. Support to operate and monitor the Diesel Engine Emergency Generator set during TNB power failure or emergency situations. 3. Records daily stock levels and consumption of utilities direct and indirect raw materials, including boiler gas fuel, water treatment chemicals, and other related consumables. 4. Supports the recording and updating of daily utilities supply data and operating parameters in computerized log sheets to ensure accurate operational records 5. Assists maintenance technicians during maintenance activities, major overhauls, plant shutdowns, troubleshooting, and repair works on Utilities equipment and machinery. 6. Supports the site Emergency Response Plan, including firefighting activities and other emergency requirements, as instructed. Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Support Operations 1. Supports the operation and routine monitoring of the Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) to ensure stable operation and compliance with environmental, safety and operational requirements. 2. Support Performs routine wastewater sampling, field inspections, laboratory testing and operational checks in accordance with established procedures, monitoring plans and schedules. 3. Assists in monitoring and recording key operational and laboratory parameters, including pH, COD, flow, sludge-related observations and other relevant process indicators to support effective WWTP operation. 4. Assists the WWTP Technician/Competent Person in routine plant operation, troubleshooting activities, process monitoring and follow-up actions arising from abnormal operating conditions. 5. Supports sludge handling, dewatering, storage, documentation and scheduled waste management activities in accordance with applicable regulatory and site requirements. 6. Maintains accurate operational records, laboratory results, inspection findings and related documentation to support environmental compliance and reporting requirements. 7. Reports abnormalities, equipment issues, process deviations or potential compliance concerns to the superior or WWTP responsible person for further evaluation and action. Others 1. Supports the implementation and compliance of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, 5S, Process Safety Management, and other site management systems by practicing established procedures and requirements. 2. Maintains good housekeeping and cleanliness at Utilities plants, Wastewater Treatment Plant areas, and related work locations. 3. Supports safe work practices and complies with BASF safety, health, environmental, quality, and operational requirements at all times. 4. Performs any additional duties or tasks assigned by management from time to time. Job Requirements (minimum requirement to carry out the work) Minimum Diploma in Environment, Chemical or Mechanical background Possess a valid 2nd Grade Boiler Operator Certificate. Possess relevant DOE certifications such as CePIETSO-PCP and CePSWaM. Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Boiler Operation, with hands-on knowledge and skills in boiler system troubleshooting. Minimum 1 to 3 years of experience in Wastewater Treatment Plant operations would be an added advantage. Technical & Professional Knowledge Strong technical knowledge of boiler operation, including equipment and machinery design, function, operating limitations, maintainability, and safety features. Good understanding of local regulatory requirements related to boiler operation. Additional knowledge of utilities systems such as Water Demineralization Plant, Air Compressors, Nitrogen Membrane Generators, LIN Evaporator, and related distribution systems. Able to use computers for routine work management and familiar with common Microsoft Office applications such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Good command of English, with the ability to speak, read, and write effectively. Familiar with management systems and workplace practices such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001/18001, 5S, and other BASF site standards. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: About BASF in Vietnam BASF has been active in Vietnam since the establishment of its representative office in 1994 and celebrates its 30-year presence in the country this year. BASF Vietnam Limited was set up in 2009. The company maintains two sales offices in Hồ Chí Minh City and Hà Nội, offering solutions for Vietnam’s key industries, including Agriculture, Construction, Automotive, Footwear, Paints & Coatings and Electrical & Electronics. BASF’s sales to customers in Vietnam were approximately €238 million in 2023. BASF employed 110 people in Vietnam as of the end of the year. Further information on BASF in Vietnam is available at www.basf.com/vn . Objectives Oversee all accounting and tax-related operations to ensure full compliance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), IFRS, local tax regulations, FDI policies, and BASF group policies and Corporate requirements. Ensure financial integrity and transparency through proper accounting, compliance reporting, and support for audits. Act as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. auditors, local authorities, BASF teams, and consultants) Execute Customer Credit Risk Management, Receivables, and Treasury operations in line with local regulations and BASF guidelines to support business needs. Provide technical and functional guidance on these areas to stakeholders. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Compliance and Governance: Ensure timely and accurate recording of all financial transactions, ensure compliance with IFRS, VAS, tax regulations, and FDI requirements through up-to-date knowledge and liaison with authorities and advisors. Establish, document, and maintain internal accounting policies, procedures, and tax guidelines. Regularly communicate updates to relevant stakeholders. Monitor and implement changes in local GAAP and tax regulations to ensure compliance and operational readiness. Coordinate and prepare accurate and timely financial statements in compliance with local and group standards including Tax filings (VAT, CIT, FCT, etc.), CbCR (Country-by-Country Reporting), transfer pricing (local file) report, and Quarterly tax notes. Lead statutory and tax audits. Serve as the primary contact point for local tax authorities, tax advisors, and compliance consultants. Operational excellence: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations to ensure transactional accuracy and alignment across systems. Support fixed assets management and impairment review. Coordinate physical verification of fixed assets. Coordinate with the auditors, supply chain and warehouse team to ensure an accurate and thorough observation of the annual physical stock count. Coordinate effectively with internal departments and Shared Service Centers to ensure smooth and timely execution of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities. Manage cash/liquidity position of the company and liaise with Regional Treasury team to ensure availability of funds Prepare and administer bank-related documentation (hedging, deposits, guarantees, facilities), and manage signatory rights and user access. Ensure full compliance with transfer pricing requirements, including managing the preparation of Transfer Price documentation in collaboration with external consultants. Play the role of Insurance gatekeeper (e.g.: Marine Cargo Insurance (MCI); Public and Products Liability Insurance (PPL); Property all risks and Business interruption Insurance (PDBI)). Perform contract review from local finance and tax perspectives. Lead enhancements to the local e-Invoice portal to ensure compliance with updated tax regulations. Play the role of expense processor and local key user of Non-Trade Portal and MDG (Customer). Support cross-functional projects, including finance transformation and digitalization initiatives. Credit Management Oversee collection of all receivables for business teams, minimize DSO (Day Sales Outstanding), and performance indicators. Carry out credit risk evaluation, risk mitigation and annual credit review in line with sales strategies and local market practices. Perform business partnering with customer visits, financial consultancy, business, and customer trainings. Handle debt recovery with collection agent, lawyer, or court. Ensure relevant documents are maintained for effective debt validation and recovery. Handle provision for doubtful debts and write-off of bad debts with business teams. Assume local key user of SCO (Smart credit optimized), CARAT (Controlling Accounts Receivable Analysis Tools), and FSCM (Financial Supply Management) or other system as applicable. Account Receivable Oversee end-to-end request/ transaction process together with Supply Chain, GB Hub and related stakeholders. Provide insight to resolve issues, inefficiencies, and queries. Oversee process of non-trade business (Customer). Oversee accounts receivable adjustments such as Rebate process, Goods return, Customer compensation. Requirements Degree in Accounting / Finance or equivalent professional qualifications. Chief Accountant certificate 7 years of relevant working experience in MNCs with international manufacturing and trading operations, preferably with a finance-shared service center environment. Experience in business partnering or financial planning and analysis roles are preferred. In-depth knowledge of local accounting practices, the Vietnamese Accounting Standards and System, Vietnamese tax regulations, and related statutory requirements. Knowledge of relevant international financial and reporting standards. Hands-on knowledge of SAP or other International ERP systems is advantageous. E.G Oracle Good command of English and Excel skills.

jobs.name: Data Scientist - IP (on contract)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About the Role This contractual position is part of BASF's Global IP team, which plays a critical role in generating strategic technology and innovation insights. The team leverages advanced analytics, AI-ML, and Intellectual Property data to support technology scouting, trend analysis, competitive intelligence, innovation portfolio assessment, and strategic decision-making across the organization. he objective of this role is to transform complex internal and external data into actionable intelligence and continuously enhance the impact of IP Intelligence through modern digital and AI-driven methodologies. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will contribute to: Designing and developing end-to-end AI and analytics solutions. Building scalable and modular AI applications. Developing and deploying LLM-powered solutions, AI agents, and workflow automation frameworks. Working with advanced technologies such as RAG, MCP, Knowledge Graphs, and Agentic AI. Data preprocessing, harmonization, feature engineering, and machine learning model development. Developing full-stack web applications and REST APIs. Leveraging tools and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and related technologies. Collaborating with IP Intelligence experts to derive technology, innovation, and competitive insights from patent and scientific data. Desired Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, or a related field. 2-4 years of relevant professional experience. Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries such as Pandas, Scikit-learn, Streamlit, SpaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face, Transformers, OpenAI. Experience in Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI, and LLM integration. Experience developing Web Applications and REST APIs using Python and JavaScript frameworks. Exposure to Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud environments. Strong problem-solving abilities and a keen interest in applying AI within the Intellectual Property and Innovation Intelligence domain.

jobs.name: Senior Manager, Sales Home Care ASEANA
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives Take full commercial responsibility for the Home Care business in ASEAN and ANZ (ASEANA), delivering sustainable and profitable growth. Own the regional commercial P&L, including sales volume, pricing strategy, profitability, working capital, discretionary costs, inventory management (DIV), and receivables management (DSO). Develop and execute regional business strategies aligned with global and Asia Pacific growth ambitions. Strengthen BASF's market leadership position through strategic account management, customer partnership development, and new business acquisition. Lead and develop a high-performing sales organization, fostering a customer-centric, performance-driven, and compliant culture. Establish strong cross-functional collaboration to ensure execution excellence across the value chain. Ensure full compliance with BASF standards, local regulations, trade controls, and chemical industry requirements across ASEAN and ANZ. M ain Tasks 1. Commercial Leadership & P&L Management Own and deliver regional commercial targets covering sales volume, revenue, contribution margin, profitability, working capital, and cash-flow related KPIs. Define and implement pricing strategies to optimize market share, profitability, and value capture. Drive rigorous management of discretionary spending, inventory levels, and accounts receivable to achieve financial targets. Establish robust forecasting processes and monitor business performance through regular reviews and corrective actions. Identify business risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure sustainable performance delivery. 2. Business Strategy & Market Development Develop and implement the ASEANA Home Care commercial strategy in alignment with global business objectives. Drive market expansion initiatives across priority countries, market segments, and customer groups. Lead commercialization of new product launches and innovations in collaboration with Product Management, Marketing, Technical Service, and R&D teams. Evaluate and optimize go-to-market models, distribution networks, and sales channels to maximize business effectiveness. Develop strategic growth plans for key markets and customer segments. 3. Strategic Account Management Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with Local, Regional, and Global Key Accounts. Act as executive sponsor for strategic customers and lead engagement with senior customer stakeholders. Drive account planning processes and establish multi-year growth partnerships. Lead complex commercial negotiations, contract discussions, and strategic supply agreements to defend and expand BASF's supply share. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive issue resolution and value-added partnership development. 4. Market Intelligence & Business Insights Monitor and analyze market trends, customer requirements, competitive activity, regulatory developments, and macro-economic conditions. Translate market intelligence into actionable commercial strategies and growth initiatives. Identify emerging business opportunities and potential threats to support proactive decision-making. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to regional and global leadership teams. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration Foster strong collaboration and alignment between Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical, R&D, Supply Chain Management, Operations, and other business units. Ensure customer strategies are fully supported through effective cross-functional execution. Lead resolution of supply, product, service, and operational challenges impacting business performance. Promote knowledge sharing and best-practice exchange across countries and functions. 6. People Leadership & Talent Development Lead, coach, and inspire the regional sales organization to achieve ambitious commercial objectives. Establish annual targets, performance objectives, and development plans for team members. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching and feedback. Develop succession plans for critical positions and strengthen organizational capabilities. Attract, retain, and develop top talent while fostering an inclusive and high-performance culture. 7. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Ensure full compliance with BASF Code of Conduct, EHS standards, trade compliance requirements, product stewardship requirements, and local regulations. Oversee import/export activities and commercial transactions in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. Ensure compliance with chemical-specific regulations across all countries within the ASEANA region. Implement preventive measures to achieve zero non-compliance incidents and safeguard BASF's reputation. Promote a strong culture of safety, ethics, and operational excellence. Education and Qualification Education Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or related discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 10-15 years of commercial experience within specialty chemicals, ingredients, Home Care or related industries. Proven leadership experience managing regional sales organizations across multiple countries. Strong track record of P&L ownership and profitable business growth. Demonstrated success in strategic account management and complex commercial negotiations. Experience managing distribution networks and regional market development initiatives. Technical & Functional Competencies Strong strategic and commercial acumen. Advanced pricing and profitability management skills. Strong understanding of Home Care market dynamics and value chains. Excellent negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within matrix organizations and cross-functional environments. Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking Customer Focus Results Orientation Entrepreneurial Mindset People Development Collaboration & Influence Accountability Change Leadership Language Fluent in English & Bahasa Indonesia is required. Additional ASEAN language capabilities are advantageous. Travel Requirement Travelling across ASEAN and ANZ markets as required

jobs.name: Operator Associate
jobs.description: Now hiring! Operator Associate Savannah, GA We are looking for an Operator Associate to join our Performance Chemicals team in Savannah, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As an Operator Associate within our Catalyst division, you will begin your career in a hands-on manufacturing role supporting the production of innovative catalyst technologies that help improve air quality, enable cleaner fuels, and support the efficient manufacturing of chemicals, plastics, and advanced battery materials. Based at our Savannah facility, you will contribute to the production of FCC catalysts, co-catalysts, and additives that help petroleum refiners convert crude oil into gasoline, transportation fuels, heating oil, and petrochemical feedstocks serving industries worldwide. During your 12-hour rotating shift as a Operator Associate, you will Operate major plant equipment and/or processes (pumps, valves, filters, screens, compressors, dryers, etc.) following standard procedures and practices, as well as participate in system improvement processes. Maintain equipment and diagnoses problems to avoid shutdowns. Drive/Operate a Forklift. Keep records and interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. This includes the ability to rate, ratio, percent and to draw as well as interpret bar graphs. Responsible for product quantity and quality (including analytical testing). If you... Have a High School Diploma or GED. Have minimum of 2 years of experience in manufacturing and Operations. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Specialist, Process &Technology Transfer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives bridge development with commercial manufacturing. Lead and coordinate the transfer of innovative chemical manufacturing processes from laboratory development through pilot-scale validation and commercial production with external partners at toll manufacturing sites. collaborate closely with Process Development scientists, tolling steering manager and external toll manufacturing organizations to ensure robust, safe, and economically viable production processe M ain Tasks Lead end-to-end technology transfer projects from laboratory through pilot-scale validation and commercial manufacturing with external partners and toll manufacturers. Develop and execute technology transfer plans to ensure smooth implementation at manufacturing sites. Establish clear project objectives, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria. Evaluate process scalability, equipment compatibility, and manufacturing feasibility. Prepare and maintain comprehensive technology transfer packages. Identify and mitigate technical risks associated with process scale-up. Support pilot plant campaigns and analyze results to optimize process performance. Provide technical support during production startup, validation, and commercial manufacturing. Troubleshoot process, yield, quality, or operational issues during scale-up and introduction into mass production. Work with manufacturing teams to improve productivity, cost efficiency, process robustness, and product quality. Monitor critical process parameters and establish process control strategies. Generate project reports for internal and external stakeholders. Serve as the technical interface between BASF and contract manufacturing partners. Take part to or conduct technical assessments of external manufacturing facilities. Support pilot & production trials and process validation activities at tolling sites. Ensure all process transfers comply with BASF EHS standards, safety & operational standards, local regulatory requirements, quality management systems and customer requirements. Contribute to process innovation and best-practice sharing across BASF Global manufacturing networks. Be an active part of cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of project milestones. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Education Engineer Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemical Process Engineering, Industrial Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific field with significant industrial experience in chemical manufacturing and process scale-up Alternatively PhD in Chemistry with experience in Industrial Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Process Chemistry, or a related discipline with significant industrial experience in chemical manufacturing and process scale-up. Language Chinese native + Fluent in English written and spoken. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese and English. Professional experience Minimum 3 years of industrial experience in Chemical manufacturing, Technology transfer, Process scale-up or Pilot plant operations Proven experience in transferring processes from laboratory to pilot scale and commercial production. Experience in working with external contract manufacturers or toll manufacturers is highly desirable. Experience in specialty chemicals, performance materials, coatings, polymers, electronic materials or related industries is an advantage. Understanding of process safety and manufacturing risk assessment methodologies is an added value.

jobs.name: Supply Chain Nerve Center (Specialist)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Digitalization will be part of our DNA at GB. We will change processes that will simplify life within but also outside of GB, sometimes even without our BASF colleagues noticing it. Within GB, we will use digital tools to stop us spending too much time on tasks that hinder us from doing the things that are really needed, such as consulting our service recipients. Digital tools will free up our time to help our internal partners and we will be able to actively shape our division’s digital footprint. GB Strategy is to transform Kuala Lumpur Hub into a digital Hub to support BASF. GBC Supply chain team is looking for an exceptional Supply chain professional to support in development and implementation of new digital tools that will help operations. You will focus on designing and implementing (along with counterparts and solution architects) Control Tower solutions for BASF Overseas delivery services. In addition, you will need to understand the customers' requirements and use cases to map to the Control Tower solution. As part of the digital transformation, you will play a key role in change management and communication to stakeholders. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities (50%) Supply chain Tactical Support •    You will be responsible for providing tactical support for door-to-door supply chain delivery process •    You will monitor exceptions at each supply chain stage to allow timely and informed decisions for effective escalation management •    You will drive supply chain disruption monitoring activities including what-if scenarios and help create recommended actions / options •    You will support operations teams during crisis management events by providing impact analysis and recommending corrective / preventive actions •    You will conduct market analysis to identify market trends, new opportunities, alternate ports, carriers, and modes •    You will improve supply chain resilience and mitigate our customer delivery risk exposure •    You will identify improvement opportunities for supply chain process and recommend best fit solutions or tools (20%) Communication and Change Management. •    You will work closely with operations to identify business requirements and structure them into actionable and meaningful objectives •    You will drive change management and help deployment of new tools and processes •    You will work with carriers and service providers identify and resolve issues impacting service delivery •    You will provide timely communication to relevant stakeholders on disruptions, identify impacts, provide recovery options and estimate expected back to normal (20%) Citizen data science •    You will coordinate analytics and data ETL (Extract, Transform and Loading) activities for all deliveries. •    You will work with data science and digitalization experts to implement statistical and machine learning models to create predictive and prescriptive solutions that provide users with key insights. •    You will build prototype models for proof of concept and paving way for new digitalization tools. (10%) Supply chain operations support •    You will create and run monitoring, exception, performance and KPI reports for delivery and shipment status. •    You will help automate and maintain reporting for operations and performance •    You will Identify and evaluate automation and technology opportunities to drive operational improvements. Education Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply chain, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Chemistry, or related field Working Experience At least 4 years of relevant Supply Chain / Logistics / Transportation Management Technical & Professional Knowledge Knowledge of working with SAP and business reporting Knowledge of working with SQL, Azure, and cloud databases Knowledge of supply chain, logistics and shipping industry Advantage for knowledge of working with business intelligence applications like Tableau, Power BI etc Self-driven and takes initiative to learn and experiment Open minded with diversity and strong communication skills Great analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving abilities BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. jobs.description: Now hiring! Product Preservation Specialist Charlotte, NC  (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! This role is designed to lead product preservation efforts and expand microbiology and product preservation capabilities supporting a diverse portfolio of water-based formulations and materials. This role combines hands-on laboratory expertise with scientific leadership, applying microbiology, analytical chemistry, polymer characterization and data-driven problem solving to support product development, manufacturing, quality improvement, and customer success. The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert for microbiology and preservation science, analytical & polymer science and working closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Technical Service, and external partners to investigate complex challenges, improve testing capabilities, and develop practical solutions that enhance product performance, sustainability and reliability. As a Product Preservation Specialist, you create chemistry by... Develop, optimize, perform and interpret microbiological, biocide efficacy, and analytical and polymeric studies to evaluate product performance, stability, and preservation effectiveness to support product development, manufacturing, QA, and customer investigations. Lead and execute projects using microbiological methods (sample collection/isolation, culturing, gram staining, imaging, sequencing, challenge tests, etc.) and analytical/polymer techniques (redox/pH, GC, LC, MS, thermal analysis, DMA, rheometer, SEM, etc.) to diagnose issues and drive solutions. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV in Gent, Belgium. The position provides dedicated operational support for laboratory, greenhouse and research activities involving biological and chemical materials, ensuring that all activities remain compliant, audit-ready and authorized to operate. A primary objective of this role is safeguarding the site's biosafety permit compliance while simultaneously ensuring robust chemical safety governance through the effective management of chemical inventories, hazard communication, regulatory compliance and operational risk controls. Biosafety Compliance & Permit Management Maintain continuous compliance with Belgian biosafety legislation and LTO permit conditions. Monitor implementation of biosafety requirements across laboratories and greenhouse facilities. Support preparation and maintenance of documentation required to sustain permits and authorizations. Identify and address compliance gaps related to biological activities. Act as operational subject matter expert during inspections and audits. Maintain documentation demonstrating compliance with regulatory obligations and permit requirements. 2. Chemical Safety & Regulatory Oversight Ensure effective management and oversight of chemical safety across research and operational facilities. Maintain the integrity of LabCup as the central source of information for chemical products on site. Monitor approximately 1,600 chemical registrations representing nearly 900 unique products, ensuring the accuracy of hazard classifications, SDS documentation, storage locations and lifecycle information. Identify, investigate and resolve discrepancies between Safety Data Sheets and locally available information. Ensure compliance with applicable GHS, CLP, REACH and SDS requirements. Monitor and implement changes in product classifications, hazard information and regulatory requirements. Support chemical product substitutions, lifecycle management and Management of Change (MOC) processes. 3. Operational Safety Oversight Conduct routine inspections of laboratories, greenhouses, storage facilities and operational workspaces. Verify compliance with biosafety and chemical safety requirements. Assess storage conditions, containment measures, inventory management and expiry status of materials. Review operational practices and identify opportunities for risk reduction and continuous improvement. Support risk assessments related to biological and chemical materials. Promote practical implementation of safety requirements at the workplace. 4. Governance, Documentation & Inventory Control Maintain biosafety procedures, work instructions and records. Ensure biosafety and chemical safety documentation remains current and inspection-ready. Oversee biological and chemical inventory management systems and ensure data quality. Coordinate administration and operation of the Belgian Biosafety Committee. Maintain documentation demonstrating compliance with legal, regulatory and corporate requirements. 5. Training, Awareness & Culture Develop and deliver biosafety and chemical safety training. Ensure employees receive appropriate instruction before working with biological or chemical materials. Maintain training records and competency tracking systems. Promote a strong safety culture through coaching, awareness initiatives and field engagement. Act as a trusted advisor for operational teams, researchers and managers. 6. Audit, Inspection and CAPA Management Coordinate internal inspections, compliance reviews and self-assessments. Support implementation of new projects, new technologies and new products from a biosafety and chemical safety perspective. Strengthen the integration between biosafety and chemical safety management systems. Strong knowledge of biological and/or chemical hazards. Understanding of GHS, CLP, REACH, SDS and biosafety regulatory requirements. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Excellent organizational and analytical capabilities. High attention to detail combined with a practical and pragmatic mindset. Ability to influence and drive compliance across multidisciplinary teams. Training, coaching and facilitation skills. jobs.name: Principal Analyst Cyber Security Defense Center (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. As Principal Analyst, you are the most senior technical authority within the CSDC - a recognized subject matter expert who leads from expertise, not hierarchy. You shape the strategic direction of our detection and response capabilities, act as the technical bridge to adjacent security functions, and represent the CSDC in internal governance bodies and external communities. RESPOSIBILITIES Lead the technical response to our most complex and high-risk security incidents as Case Lead - from triage and analysis through containment, eradication, resolution, and closure Lead investigations and compromise assessments Analyze complex malicious artifacts (binaries, scripts, documents) through static and dynamic analysis and reverse engineering to determine their underlying, often obfuscated, functionality Drive our hypothesis-driven threat hunting program: design hunting campaigns, validate hypotheses against threat intelligence, and convert findings into durable detection coverage Design, review, and continuously improve detection logic, correlation rules, and SOAR playbooks on our Elastic Security platform, applying Detection-as-Code practices Shape the CSDC automation and AI roadmap: co-design AI-assisted triage and investigation workflows and supervise their operation with clear human-in-the-loop safeguards Define the strategic roadmap for detection and response capabilities together with CSDC leadership; evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies Act as technical advisor to CSDC leadership on capability development, and as senior escalation point and on-call resource for critical incidents Mentor and train Tier 2 and Tier 3 analysts; develop advanced training content and drive knowledge transfer across the team Lead cross-functional initiatives with adjacent teams (Cyber Threat Intelligence, Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Platform Engineering) and steer external service providers to meet BASF security requirements Represent the CSDC in internal security governance bodies and in external communities and trusted networks (e.g., BSI, Deutscher CERT-Verbund, CSSA, FIRST) QUALIFICATIONS Education and Experience Degree in computer science, IT security, or a comparable technical qualification 8+ years of professional experience in cyber defense, incident response, with a track record as a recognized subject matter expert Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and investigations under pressure in high-stakes situations Technical Expertise Expert-level knowledge of the internals of mainstream operating systems (Microsoft Windows, Linux) and of network protocols and traffic analysis Deep understanding of current attacker tradecraft: advanced persistent threats, actors, infrastructures, and TTPs, structured along MITRE ATT&CK Strong hands-on expertise with Elastic Security as SIEM and EDR: detection rule development and tuning, investigation and hunting; experience with Elastic automation capabilities (workflows, AI Assistant) and ES|QL is a strong plus Proficiency with modern DFIR tooling (e.g., OSQuery, Velociraptor, Volatility, Suricata, Wireshark) and with malware analysis and reverse engineering tools (e.g., Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, WinDbg) Solid experience in cloud and identity threat detection and response (Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Azure, AWS) Ability to program in Python and ideally Go; confident scripting in common shells (Bash, PowerShell); ability to read C and x86/x64 assembly in the context of reverse engineering Working understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations (model-assisted triage, LLM-assisted investigation, explainability) is a plus Leadership and Communication Proven ability to lead technical experts through stressful situations and to remain a calm, structured decision-maker during critical incidents Strong mentoring and coaching mindset; genuine motivation to grow the analysts around you Confident communication in English, both spoken and written, up to executive level; German language skills are a plus Excellent organizational and time management skills; willingness to participate in an on-call rotation Certifications Relevant certifications are valued as supporting evidence of your expertise - none of them is a strict requirement. We particularly welcome: GIAC / SANS: GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCTI, GDAT, or GCDA; the GIAC Security Expert (GSE) designation is a distinguishing qualification at this level Elastic: Elastic Certified Analyst or Elastic Certified Engineer Cloud security: Microsoft SC-200 or AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or GIAC GCLD Offensive and intrusion analysis: OffSec OSCP or OSDA, or CREST Registered Intrusion Analyst (CRIA) BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking and on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. HOW TO REACH US If you're interested in the position or know someone who might be and need support on how to take next steps, please send an email to felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com

Perform Work Permitting process and prepare equipment for daily maintenance activities. Train new employees on unit activities. Participate on emergency response teams condition of employment. If you... Hold a High School Diploma or GED. Are results oriented, dependable, safety conscious, and able to work effectively in a team environment. Preferrably have Honeywell TDC 3000, DCS Operational, and Work Permit Writing experience Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . You will help shape BASF's future Talent Acquisition technology landscape and play a key role in the transformation towards AI-enabled, manager-centric recruiting. You evaluate and introduce AI-supported recruiting capabilities, ensuring business value, regulatory compliance and responsible AI governance. You consult and support global business stakeholders on complex functional and technical topics related to our recruiting solutions in SAP SuccessFactors. You translate business requirements into solution designs, assess impacts across processes, data, integrations and reporting, and present recommendations to senior stakeholders and project committees. You lead Project Workstreams to design & implementation activities, and continuous optimization of recruiting processes and digital Talent Acquisition solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements, compliance standards, and global HR strategies. Degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Human Resources, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with recruiting-related third-party solutions: AI-supported matching, interview tooling, document generation, marketing automation, CRM. SAP SuccessFactors certification in Recruiting, Employee Central or related modules. Practical experience collaborating with German works councils. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking. And on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Agronomic Excellence Summer Intern
jobs.description: Agronomic Excellence Summer Intern – Grow Your Future with BASF As a Agronomy Excellence Summer Intern, you’ll be part of a team that’s shaping the future of agriculture while building your own career foundation. Internship Details: Duration : 4 months (Summer 2027) Location: Strathmore, AB and Winnipeg, MB. Compensation : $25 - $32 / Hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Conduct field trials to evaluate canola hybrids, seed technology, and agronomic practices — all aimed at developing hybrid-specific recommendations for Western Canada. Build Your Network : Work closely with the Agronomic Excellence team and collaborate with casual staff and regional experts. Learn by Doing : Get hands-on experience with all phases of field trial activities — from seed setup and planting to pest control, plot maintenance, and harvest. Grow Your Career : Gain exposure to agronomic research and hybrid development, setting the stage for future roles in agriculture. Have Fun : Expand your horizons through travel, hands-on learning in new environments, and opportunities to see innovation in action. Students will be hired and employed through a third-party contracting agency - Raise Recruiting. Opportunities are based on business needs at our sites. Candidates resumes will be presented to BASF based on requirements of the assignments being a match and fit based on experience. Applications can be considered for multiple opportunities now through March 31, 2027. If you are selected, you will be contacted about the summer employment opportunity directly. What You’ll Learn: How to conduct agronomic field trials and analyze crop performance. The practical application of seed technology and hybrid development. Field scouting techniques and crop health diagnostics. Leadership and problem-solving skills in dynamic field conditions. What You’ll Do: Conduct field trials with the Agronomic Excellence team. Assist with all phases of crop cycle activities — from land prep and planting to harvest. Monitor field and research plots, collect data, and analyze results. Supervise casual employees as needed. Travel regularly within your assigned territory for field scouting and diagnostics. What We’re Looking For: You’re currently enrolled in an agriculture or related degree program. You’re passionate about agronomy, hybrid development, and field research. You’re a strong communicator, organized, and ready to learn. You have a valid driver’s license and are open to travel. You’re familiar with agricultural equipment and field research practices (preferred but not required). You’re detail-oriented and adaptable to changing field conditions. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

jobs.name: Auditor
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 4 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities We are seeking an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. Demonstrates a proactive approach by actively using analytic tools and AI programs utilized such as Co-pilot, PowerBI, and Power Automate/Apps, to drive improved audit efficiency and effectiveness. You will also collaborate actively with global experts (Domain Owners/SPOCs) as the regional subject matter expert for specific audit topics and risk areas. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures with the annual audit plan. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Develop recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Leverage data analytics and data management expertise to analyze financial and operational data, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement. Develop data-driven insights to support audit findings and recommendations. Communicate audit findings and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behavior, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, and professionalism in the internal audit role. Requirements Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, Software Engineer, Data Scientist. (Bachelor’s degree in Accounting / Engineering / Computer Science / Statistics / Business Technology related discipline) Preferable Candidate with Professional Certifications such as: CIA (Certified Internal Audit), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit), ESG. Data analytics related experience etc. 4 – 7 Years of experience in these skills - internal audit, internal control, risk based auditing, financial controlling Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies and with ERP experience (SAP). Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes.

Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions.BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. jobs.name: Executive Assistant to the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery Office (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Surventis became an independent company on 30 June 2026. The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is a member of the Executive Committee and is responsible for enterprise transformation, value creation and execution across all businesses and functions. The Executive Assistant runs the Office of the CTO. You make sure the CTO’s time goes to the decisions that matter, that every management meeting is prepared to a board standard, and that agreed actions actually get done. You also take on selected project work. In your role, you help to ensure that the CTO is well prepared for daily priorities by coordinating schedules, organizing meetings and serving as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Together with the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery leadership team, you maintain an overview of commitments, actions and follow-up activities to support transparent and effective collaboration. Working closely with leaders and business functions, you prepare leadership and management meetings to a high standard, coordinate decision papers and document outcomes and next steps clearly and concisely. You contribute to selected transformation and strategy initiatives by organizing information, preparing analyses and creating executive summaries that support informed decision-making. You also play an important role in bringing people together by coordinating workshops, leadership off-sites, site visits, internal communications and external advisor engagements. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in business administration, economics, engineering or a comparable field, or an equivalent qualification at least five years of experience supporting a board member, CEO or executive leader, or experience in consulting, project management, strategy or transformation environments strong Microsoft 365 skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel, along with confidence using modern productivity and AI tools fluent German and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups a collaborative, well-organized and dependable working style combined with empathy, strong communication skills, sound judgment and a commitment to high-quality outcomes WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Senior Industrial Workspace Support Engineer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position: Our Product Family (Industrial Connectivity, Workspace and Data Platform) delivers standardized, managed, and secure Industrial Workspace services for BASF production plants and warehouses worldwide. Covering industrial mobile devices, Windows and Linux platforms, and Industrial IoT solutions, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of endpoint and workspace services that enable reliable and secure operations in production and warehouse environments. With our global platforms and services, and as part of a global team, we enable and continuously evolve digitalization supporting BASF’s production and logistics processes. With our global platform and services and as part of a global team, we enable and continuously evolve digitalization that supports BASF’s production and logistics processes. In this role, you will be part of a global follow-the-sun organization responsible for the reliable operation and support of Industrial Workspace solutions. Working closely with product teams, technology experts, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will help ensure stable operations, resolve operational challenges, drive continuous improvements, and support global deployments and initiatives. Beyond daily operations, you will have the opportunity to contribute your ideas and experience to continuously improve services, processes, and ways of working in collaboration with product and technology teams. Main Tasks: Provide service and operational support for Industrial Workspace services as part of a global follow-the-sun support organization. Support our customers in production and warehouse environments in close collaboration with our global technology and regional consulting teams. Support and operate technologies such as Enterprise Mobility Management solutions, Windows and Linux platforms, container-based infrastructures, and Industrial IoT solutions, depending on your area of expertise. Collaborate closely with internal DevOps teams and external technology vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and ensure stable and secure service operations. Identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational processes, and platform stability, and contribute to their implementation together with product and technology teams. Work in project or operation teams and contribute to service enhancements, technology initiatives, and regional deployments and rollouts. Industrial Workspace Devices Lifecycle Management in BASF Greater China As part of global IWS team, follow the standard processes to steer the full lifecycle of industrial workspace devices, including enrolment, configuration, activation, suspension, return, and decommissioning Support the management of device inventory, device pools, and lifecycle status to ensure transparency and cost control. Support the qualification and onboarding of new industrial mobile devices, including local or special devices and applications into the BASF portfolio in compliance with Industrial Mobility standards and in close collaboration with teams. Stakeholder Coordination & Site Enablement in BASF Greater China Act as the main contact window for plants, lab, logistic, maintenance, and EHS regarding industrial mobile device topics. Support site onboarding activities, including device rollout, user enablement, and coordination of local requirements. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with 3–5 years of relevant professional experience. Experience operating and supporting enterprise-scale endpoint, mobility, or platform services. Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM) solutions in industrial environments (e.g., SOTI MobiControl, MobileIron) Windows platform operations Linux and container platform operations Knowledge of IP networks and wireless technologies. Understanding security and authentication technologies, including the interaction between devices, OS, backend systems, and connectivity models. Strong communication skills and fluent English language skills (written and spoken), combined with a proactive and collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. We are looking for a curious and hands-on professional who enjoys operating reliable services, solving technical challenges, identifying improvement opportunities, and proactively driving them together with the responsible product and technology teams. Nice to h ave Experience working in global, agile teams. Experience with tools such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Power Automate, or Power Apps Knowledge of Industrial IoT or AutoID technologies
