jobs.name: Trade Compliance Operations AP (Executive)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Support BASF group companies to meet all legal and regulatory requirements related to trade compliance. Protect BASF’s license to operate by ensuring adherence to Import and export control, sanctions, and screening obligations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Execute trade control related activities for BASF companies to ensure compliance. Ensure timely update in Daily Operation Reports and regularly review compliance performance with relevant areas against business processes predefined criteria. Evaluate, analyze and verify trade compliance regulatory data and documentation to support system accuracy, database integrity, and ongoing compliance monitoring. Support in resolving issues related to service delivery including communication with internal customers / stakeholders / other business partners. Perform necessarily follow up action to ensure deliverables completed in a timely manner. Ensure that BASF’s trade compliance processes and standards are effectively applied across Asia Pacific (and other supported regions), covering import, export, and regulatory requirements. This includes managing stakeholders and implementing compliance activities using BASF tools and digital solutions. Sharing knowledge exchange for best practices, including participation in regional or cross-regional projects and initiatives Contribute to report preparation, including KPI reporting, cost charging, non-conformance monitoring and improvement initiatives, using BASF tools, Visual Dashboard, and digital solutions. Ensure timely review, update and continuous improvement of work documentation such as process descriptions, work instructions to maintain sustainable knowledge retention and process standardization within department. Support internal and external audits, including conducting Quality Checks to identify potential improvements and implement preventive measures Continuous improvement by leveraging digitalization tools, to enhance operational excellence and process efficiency. Execute assigned processes with a consistently high standard of service to effectively meet the growing demands of business operations across relevant regions. Effective communication with stakeholders as required in daily operation and timely escalation to leader on critical topics where relevant. Execute discussion independently within the team and collaborate for achievement. Commit to continuous self-development through proactive learning and development (70:20:10 approach) and actively contribute to building team capability. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Law, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field. Background in Chemistry or related science is an added advantage for product-related compliance. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in trade compliance, country regulations, product regulatory affairs, or product safety and stewardship related to trade compliance. Experience in regulatory or compliance functions, supply chain operations, or procurement activities within a multinational environment is preferred. Practical experience with import and export processes, including documentation and custom procedures, is an added advantage. Basic knowledge of regulatory controls, import/export requirements, license/permit management, and trade compliance procedures and standards in Asia Pacific countries. Proficiency in MS Office application (Excel /Power Point essential) Experience with SAP systems in supporting compliance or logistics processes would be beneficial. Fluent in English (both written and spoken); proficiency in Chinese is an asset. Experience with digital tools and automation technologies (e.g., Excel automation using formulas, pivot table, basic macro) and data visualization tool (e.g., Power BI). Good analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail, proactive mindset, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. Understanding global trade regulations (e.g. export control, sanctions, restricted party screening) would be an advantage. The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Surventis - Münster - Global Controlling Specialist RFN with focus Business Analytics (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The Global Controlling Specialist reports to the Global Head of RFN Controlling and is the key contact for Digitalization and Data Analytics topics in Controlling. Broad operational controlling and BI expertise combined with strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills are prerequisites to act as a business partner for the Refinish Leadership Team and lead cross-functional data analytics projects across regions. You contribute to the further development of global controlling reporting solutions, ensure high data quality, and support users in making the best use of reporting tools and analytics. Working closely with colleagues from Finance, IT, and Data & Analytics, you coordinate reporting requirements, foster effective cross-functional collaboration, and serve as a strong sparring partner on all Controlling and Digital matters. Together with international teams, you support the digital evolution of Controlling, share knowledge, and contribute to the development of digital skills across the organization. You help introduce automation and AI-supported solutions that improve reporting, analytics, and controlling processes while creating a positive user experience. You also contribute to financial analyses, performance monitoring activities, and ad hoc business requests, enabling informed and transparent decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER master’s degree in finance, accounting, controlling, business analytics, information systems, or a related field with relevant professional experience in controlling, finance, business analytics, or a comparable area strong knowledge of Power BI, Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot, and a solid understanding of reporting and controlling processes self-organized and collaborative working style combined with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset fluent German and English language skills; experience with Databricks, data warehouse environments, and modern analytics platforms is beneficial ideally experience with automation tools such as Power Automate as well as project coordination or project management experience WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: 2027 Agricultural Solutions Professional Development Program - Engineering
jobs.description: Now hiring! 2027 Agricultural Solutions Professional Development Program - Engineering The Professional Development Program Experience Accelerate your career in an early-career role with BASF Agricultural Solutions. BASF’s Professional Development Programs, or PDPs, offer driven, mobile-minded university graduates the opportunity to launch their careers through immersive, real-world experiences. Participants rotate through diverse roles within our business, gaining hands-on exposure to cross-functional teams and meaningful business challenges. The program is designed to build professional skills, foster meaningful connections, and provide a holistic view of BASF’s operations through mentoring, executive engagement, site tours, and training seminars. Throughout the program, participants develop a strong foundation in BASF’s systems and processes while building their professional networks and exploring their career interests. With structured support and a focus on growth, the PDP experience empowers participants to solve complex problems and contribute to impactful work. Upon successful completion, participants may be considered for placement into a permanent role related to their program experience. Engineering PDP Program Summary As a highly motivated upcoming graduate, you will participate in a 24-month rotational development program consisting of two 12-month assignments across BASF Agricultural Solutions engineering and manufacturing locations. The program is designed to strengthen your technical foundation, leadership behaviors, business acumen, and site-based experience while preparing you for permanent engineering placement. Throughout your rotations, you will contribute to meaningful engineering work while gaining exposure to areas such as process engineering, reliability and asset management, project and capital execution, electrical systems, controls and automation, manufacturing excellence, continuous improvement, and technology and digital engineering You will work across sites, functions, engineering disciplines, and stakeholder groups to better understand how engineering decisions support safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable operations. Your experiences, project outcomes, competency development, and feedback will help guide your growth and future placement within the organization. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a program participant, you will... Complete two 12-month rotational assignments across engineering, manufacturing, and technical organizations within BASF Agricultural Solutions. Build technical expertise through hands-on experiences in areas such as process engineering, reliability and asset management, project execution, automation, manufacturing excellence, and digital technologies. Own meaningful projects and deliverables that support business priorities and create measurable value for BASF. Apply engineering principles, data analysis, and problem-solving skills to improve safety, reliability, quality, productivity, and operational performance. Support engineering and capital projects through activities such as planning, design reviews, implementation, commissioning, and startup support. Collaborate with colleagues across Operations, Technology, Environmental Health and Safety, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, and other business functions to achieve shared objectives. Communicate technical findings, project updates, recommendations, and results through presentations, reports, and discussions with technical and non-technical audiences. Build business acumen by understanding how engineering decisions impact safety, quality, cost, service, and overall business performance. Participate in technical training, mentorship, coaching, networking, and leadership development opportunities throughout the program. Develop the skills, experiences, and professional network needed for future placement into an engineering role within BASF. Demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, confidentiality, continuous learning, and BASF's Winning Behaviors. If you... Have completed a bachelor's degree program within 12 months of your date of hire, preferably in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (graduating between December 2026 and May 2027). A master's degree is a plus, but not required. Are authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without restrictions or need for future sponsorship. Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, critical thinking, systems thinking, project management, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively in a cross-functional environment. Embody BASF’s Winning Behaviors: you take accountability, move with speed, and bring an improvement mindset to everything you do. Are self-driven and thrive in collaborative environments, even when working with geographically dispersed teams. Are open to working in multiple geographic locations throughout rotational program and upon place-off from the program. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: District Manager - Ohio Valley
jobs.description:
Now hiring! District Manager - Ohio Valley We are looking for a District Manager Ohio Valley to join our Surventis Surface Treatment team. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. At Surventis Surface Treatment, we develop and manufacture tailor-made technology and system solutions for applied surface technology. Our products protect metals from corrosion, facilitate forming and treatment, prepare parts optimally for the painting process and ensure excellent coating adhesion. Our technologies and products are used in a variety of industries and end markets such as automotive, aerospace, aluminum finishing and metal forming. The chemical treatment of metal surfaces is Surventis Surface Treatment’s core competence. The focus of our worldwide activities is on the development and implementation of customized technology and system solutions for surface treatment. The District Manager oversees sales operations within a specific geographic area, leading a team to achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth. As a District Manager Ohio Valley, you will... Execute strategic sales plans to meet district quotas and expand market share within your assigned territory. Lead and manage a team of sales representatives, providing coaching, training, and performance feedback to enhance their skills and effectiveness. Analyze sales data and market trends to identify new business opportunities and adjust sales strategies accordingly. Have regular field visits with sales representatives allowing them to observe techniques, offer direct coaching, and support client interactions. Work closely with Key Industry Sales and Marketing to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company goals and provide market feedback. Assign Sales and Profit targets to align to strategic initiatives Be responsible for Performance management, talent development and talent retention. Develop and maintain succession plan for the Sale’s District. Hire, train and coach Technical Sales Representative, to develop effective Sales techniques, Technical problem solving, product knowledge and awareness of customer needs. Hire and identify needed training to develop effective Technical problem solving, product knowledge and awareness of customer needs. Manage pipeline and target accounts to meet our growth objectives. Execute Strategy of targets as identified as part of District Strategic Roadmap in collaboration with Regional Marketing and Regional Sales- Industries. Execute global strategies within each Industry Segment key customers. Keep track of competitors’ offers and action building a competitive awareness. Provide input for the development of pricing strategies. Be responsible for Business reviews completion at top 20 accounts. Develop strong business relationships with key decision-makers. Manage sales and pricing processes to align with the company’s pricing guidelines and marketing pricing strategy. Coordinate and execute sales strategies to develop target business. Prepare Supply Agreements within the given authorization framework. Lead the effort and education for the digital processes (Salesforce, Power BI, Power Apps etc). Coordinate with Industry Sales personnel on target account activities. Share market insights and trends with Sales Managers, Key Industry Sales management and Regional Marketing management. Manage AR and Consignment Inventory to assigned goals. If you have... BS Degree Desired 3-5 years of sales experience and leadership Industrial Technical Sales experience including pretreatment, surface treatment, and metalworking in the Specialty Chemical Industry. Sales and Business acumen (account & relationship management, value-based selling, etc.) Leadership skills: ability to motivate and develop a sales team Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong cross-functional collaboration skills Strategic thinking skills The District Manager will reside in his / her assigned District geography. The position requires 50% travel Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Pay transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $146,000 - $175,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Auf diese Weise befähigen wir unser Team, sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Pflegende Hautcremes, milde Shampoos, Sonnenschutzmittel, schonende und umweltfreundliche Waschmittel und leistungsstarke Reiniger für Haushalt und Industrie – all diese Produkte nutzen Inhaltsstoffe aus unserem Bereich Care Chemicals. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft entwerfen! WAS SIE ERWARTET In unserer Einheit bei der BASF Grenzach GmbH sind wir für die Produktion verschiedenster Stoffe aus dem Bereich Care Chemicals verantwortlich. Canola Seed Production Summer Associate Contract Duration: 4 - 6 months (Summer 2027) Location: Lethbridge, AB Wage: $25 - $32 / Hour During peak periods in the season, overtime will be paid for evenings or weekends. We are looking for a Canola Seed Production Summer Associate to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Lethbridge,AB. We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Students will be hired and employed through a third-party contracting agency - Raise Recruiting. Opportunities are based on business needs at our sites. Candidates resumes will be presented to BASF based on requirements of the assignments being a match and fit based on experience. Applications can be considered for multiple opportunities now through March 31, 2027. If you are selected, you will be contacted about the summer employment opportunity directly. As a Canola Seed Production Summer Associate, you create chemistry by... Joining our team where you will be involved in plot and field scale trials for the Certified Seed Supply team. Working with growers within your assigned regions in the production of InVigor canola for market. Being involved in all aspects of seed production from seeding to harvest, including planting, spraying, crop synchronization, mowing harvesting, sample processing, monitoring the health of the crop as it matures and scouting fields for weed, disease and insect pressure. Maintaining relationships with growers and providing agronomic advice in relation to certified seed production under the recommendation of the Production Agronomist. If you have... Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Strong attention to detail in delivering results. Demonstrated problem solving skills and comfort working alone from time to time. The ability to be flexible and modify plans as situations arise, minimizing impact on results. Experience with farm equipment (highly desired). Agronomic knowledge attained through pursuing your degree in Agriculture or similar program, preferably along with experience in the Agriculture or Farming Industry . About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Join us in shaping the future as part of a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunity – regardless of gender, age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or personal beliefs. Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Pay Transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $25 - $32. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Instrument and Electrical Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Instrument and Electrical Technician Livonia, MI (On Site) We are looking for an Instrument and Electrical Technician to join our Performance Materials team in Livonia. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. The BASF Livonia, MI site is a 24/7 operation part of our Performance Materials division that processes chemicals used in the production of polyurethane-based products.  We are seeking an Instrument and Electrical Tech professional like you to collaborate with operations personnel and contracted service suppliers to prepare and execute routine maintenance and non-routine maintenance. We will be relying on you to execute instrumentation and electrical (I&E) jobs and coordinate and oversee external contractors at the Livonia, MI site. "This position is part of a job family with multiple levels and will be filled at a level that is commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and experience. " During your 8-hour day shift (~ 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM) as an Instrument and Electrical Technician, you will… Work in the Maintenance Department under the direction of the Technical Engineering Service (TES) Manager alongside other Maintenance Technicians and external contractors. Be responsible for instrumentation and electrical maintenance in the operation. This will periodically include assisting with mechanical maintenance as well. Operate and maintain site utility equipment. Use your I&E and previous automation experience to service process instrumentation and troubleshoot automation problems. Coordinate and oversee contractors in electrical, automation, instrumentation, or other similar trades. Prepare lockout/tagout documentation and issue safe work permits. Take a self‑directed approach to reviewing work orders, completing assigned tasks, and documenting all work performed. Participate in a monthly rotating on‑call schedule for equipment breakdowns during off‑hours, including some weekends. This position is overtime‑eligible and may be required to respond in some circumstances. Support all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) policies and procedures while promoting a safe working environment. Work with materials deemed hazardous under RCRA, adhering to all site‑accepted safety policies, including PPE requirements. If you… Have a High School DIploma or GED. Technical degree in a related field is preferred. Have approximately 10 years of experience or more of troubleshooting I&E‑related equipment in a manufacturing environment. Are highly motivated and have strong background in troubleshooting process control instrumentation and automation systems. Have the ability to climb, work at heights, work within confined spaces, wear air‑purifying respirators, work under supplied air, and lift up to 50 lbs. Have experience working with process automation technology, including Rockwell ControlLogix PLCs, FactoryTalk Batch, FactoryTalk View, and Ethernet‑based communications. Are able to read technical specifications and P&IDs. Are proficient with computers, specifically Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel. Then… Click below to Belong@BASF! Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Quality & Technical Service Lab
jobs.description: Objectives In alignment with BASF Quality Policy, oversee day‑to‑day quality management of the site to ensure raw materials meet production specifications and finished products satisfy customer expectations. Be responsible for ISO‑related audit activities, and maintain and continuously improve the company’s quality management system. Main Tasks Production Safety Responsibilities ‑ Serve as the Production Safety lead for the Quality & Technical Service Lab Department. Comply with the principle of “whoever is in charge of business shall be accountable for safety; whoever manages production and operations shall be accountable for safety”, and fulfil dual responsibilities for safety performance within the scope of assigned duties. ‑ Be in charge of department‑level safety training, retain relevant records, develop and control safety training plans, assess employees’ safety‑related performance and arrange additional training where required. ‑ Ensure tools, instruments and equipment within the department are correctly deployed for daily operations. ‑ Identify potential workplace hazards and unsafe employee behaviours, and take appropriate corrective actions to eliminate such risks. ‑ Identify all work activities within the department requiring job hazard analysis, organise risk analysis exercises and implement risk‑mitigation measures. ‑ Investigate all incidents and accidents occurring within the department to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, propose disciplinary recommendations for accountable parties and deliver follow‑up employee training. ‑ Secure a safe working environment for employees and contractors, including provision of appropriate personal protective equipment, tools and materials. ‑ Ensure the Quality Control Supervisor implements corresponding obligations in accordance with all safety procedures. ‑ Cascading corporate safety requirements to every employee and contractor within the department. ‑ Ensure all safety rules, procedures and safe working practices are fully understood and followed by all department employees and contractors. Quality Management ‑ Schedule and oversee daily laboratory operations aligned with production and shipment plans. ‑ Ensure raw material and finished‑product conformance against specifications and requirements. ‑ Monitor raw material and finished‑product status in the SAP system; issue Certificates of Analysis (CoA) for delivered finished goods and obtain Quality Deviation Reports (QDR) for non‑conforming batches. ‑ Establish test methodologies for new raw materials and new products during new‑product launch phases. ‑ Guarantee effective implementation of the quality management system and maintain the system in compliance with ISO standards. ‑ Compile and analyse quality‑related data, and prepare relevant reports as requested by line management. Metrology Management ‑ Take charge of calibration for trade‑related measuring instruments onsite, including management of calibration procedures, calibration schedules and calibration‑related budget. Document Control ‑ Maintain and update laboratory operating manuals. ‑ Compile and revise quality‑control manuals. ‑ Ensure proper retention of all quality‑control‑related records. External Audits ‑ Plan, organise and execute internal and external audits for ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 to secure successful audit outcomes. ‑ Ensure timely completion of all corrective actions. Customer Complaint Handling ‑ Lead customer‑complaint investigations. ‑ Conduct root‑cause analysis, define corrective actions, and monitor timely closure of such actions. ‑ Host customer visits, build sound working relationships with customer quality teams and capture customer requirements. Product Stewardship ‑ Act as the site Product Stewardship focal point; collaborate with Greater China and Asia Pacific Product Safety & Stewardship (PSS) teams to prepare Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for products and raw materials used onsite, and deliver relevant training for internal stakeholders. 5S Management ‑ Implement and sustain well‑organised laboratory working environments in compliance with corporate 5S policies. People Management ‑ Set performance objectives for direct reports and conduct performance evaluations. ‑ Formulate individual development plans for direct reports based on incumbent competencies and business requirements. ‑ Address inappropriate behaviours of direct reports, and coordinate with Human Resources to administer disciplinary procedures per corporate policies. ‑ Foster an inclusive, transparent and high‑performance working culture to support talent development and retention. ‑ Manage attendance, overtime, training and leave arrangements for direct reports in line with business needs, corporate policies and applicable laws and regulations. Budget Management ‑ Develop, monitor and optimise annual quality‑function budgets in compliance with quality policies and compliance obligations. ‑ Strictly adhere to corporate finance and cost‑accounting rules. Deploy effective measures to cut maintenance costs, reduce material losses and eliminate waste. Other Assignments ‑ Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager. Requirements - Education: Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Applied Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry. - Working Experience: Minimum 5 years of working experience in quality management and laboratory management within the chemical industry. ‑ Sound knowledge of polymerisation and polymer science. ‑ Bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English for day‑to‑day business delivery. ‑ Competency in office software and enterprise applications including SAP.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As (Junior) Procurement Specialist with Dutch and English, you are responsible for all operational purchasing activities. In detail, you ensure that our BASF companies in Europe are supplied with raw materials, technical goods and services. You play an active role: you implement and adhere to the company's procurement guidelines by conducting numerous Purchase-to-Pay process tasks. In collaboration and consultation with our internal business partners, you handle orders accordingly to the guidelines. Assuring timely deliveries and handling non-conformities are part of your daily tasks. In doing so, you are responsible for entering master data of contracts into our IT systems and keeping this data updated. In this context, you are the central point of contact for operational procurement processes and you answer questions from stakeholders (e. g. internal customers, suppliers, strategic buyers and colleagues from the finance departments). WHAT YOU OFFER bachelor's degree in commerce or a similar field, completed vocational education would be also possible initial professional experience in an area of business and commerce; preferably purchasing is a plus, but not compulsory excellent communication skills in Dutch and English, French and/or German are a plus good knowledge of IT standard applications, experience in working with SAP or other procurement related IT programs are a plus ability to identify customer needs and enjoy consulting WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 -39.000 € , depending on qualification and work experience -  In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the companys success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts HOW TO REACH US Maximilian Mette (Talent Acquisition), maximilian.mette@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56084 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. Dann ist dieser Beruf genau der Richtige für dich! Kunststoff und Kautschuk sind auf Grund ihrer sehr guten chemischen Beständigkeit vielseitig einsetzbar. Bei uns lernst du die Welt dieses Materials genauestens kennen und hast die Möglichkeit dich für die Fachrichtung Formteile, Bauteile oder Halbzeugeherstellung zu bewerben. Gib Gummi in einem der vielseitigsten Berufe bei der BASF! DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Das bieten wir in der Fachrichtung „Bauteile“: Bearbeiten von Kunststoffhalbzeugen mit Hilfe von Kreis- und Bandsägen, Schleifmaschinen, Biege- und Abkantmaschinen Zusammenfügen einzelner Bauteile durch Schweißen, Kleben, Laminieren und Umformen Fertigen, Verlegen und Auskleiden von Rohrleitungen aus Kunststoffen Herstellen und Instandsetzen von Behältern und Apparaten Das bieten wir in der Fachrichtung „Formteile“: Verarbeiten von Kunststoffgranulaten mit Hilfe von Spritzguss-Maschinen Umrüsten von Produktionsmaschinen entsprechend des Produktionsauftrags Warten von Anlagen und gegebenenfalls Beheben von auftretenden Störungen Erwerben von umfassenden Kenntnissen über den gesamten Produktionsprozess DAS BRINGST DU MIT mindestens eine Berufsreife / einen Hauptschulabschluss Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, körperliche Belastbarkeit, keine Angst vor großen Höhen und sicheres Farbsehvermögen Interesse an technisch-handwerklichen Tätigkeiten, handwerkliches Geschick sowie ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine spannende Ausbildung im weltweit führenden Chemieunternehmen in Kooperation mit der BBS Technik I in Ludwigshafen maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote sowie die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an EU-Austauschprojekten attraktive Vergütung – du startest mit 1147 Euro pro Monat im 1. Ausbildungsjahr zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen: Jahresprämie, Erfolgsbeteiligung, 700 Euro Urlaubsgeld, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Teilnahme am BASF Aktienprogramm, Tablet,  Essensgeldzuschuss, Zuschuss Jobticket 30 Tage Urlaub und 37,5 Stunden-Woche Freizeit- und Fitnessangebote sowie Mitarbeiterevents Wohnmöglichkeiten für Azubis von weiter weg Verkürzung der Ausbildung um ein halbes Jahr bei besonders guten Leistungen möglich gute Übernahmechancen bei entsprechenden Leistungen AUSBILDUNG GESCHAFFT - WAS DANN ? Nachdem du das nötige Handwerkszeug erlernt hast, sammelst du Berufserfahrung und wirst ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres Teams. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachkollegen, dem Schichtführer und den Prozessingenieuren verlangt eine_n echte_n Experte_in und umfassende Kenntnisse über den gesamten Produktionsprozess. Außerdem erwartet dich eine Vielzahl interessanter Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungschancen. DEIN WEG ZU UNS: Richtig bewerben - so geht's! Neugierde, Offenheit und Motivation. Für uns steht deine Persönlichkeit im Vordergrund. Noten sind nicht alles. Im ersten Schritt des Auswahlverfahrens bleiben die Schulnoten daher erst einmal unberücksichtigt. Für uns ist der Gesamteindruck entscheidend. Daher LET'S MATCH & BEWIRB DICH JETZT: Bewerbungsstart: ab September 2026 Bewerbungsende: Es gibt keine Frist, du kannst dich bewerben so lange Plätze frei sind! jobs.name: Summer Sales Intern
jobs.description: Summer Sales Intern – Grow Your Future with BASF As a Summer Sales Intern, you’ll be part of a team that’s shaping the future of agriculture while building your own career foundation. Internship Details: Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027 ) Location: Regina and Weyburn SK Compensation: $25 - $32 per hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Contribute to meaningful projects that support farmers, strengthen relationships in our communities and drive sustainability. Build Your Network : Develop lasting relationships with mentors, managers, and peers who will guide and support your career journey. Learn by Doing : Gain practical, hands-on experience in sales, agronomy, and customer engagement that translates into real-world skills. Grow Your Career : Explore career paths and gain visibility into potential full-time opportunities, including our Professional Development Program (PDP). Have Fun : Participate in field tours, networking events, and team activities that make your summer both rewarding as it is memorable. What You’ll Learn: How to manage a customer portfolio and drive innovation in the field. The ins and outs of BASF’s product line and how it supports sustainable agriculture. Communication, leadership, and decision-making skills that will serve you in any career path. What You’ll Do: Build relationships with growers and promote BASF solutions. Support field tours, events, and product demonstrations. Lead a field-scale project and scout fields to gain technical insights. Collaborate with BASF teams to grow the business and your skills. Travel within your assigned territory. What We’re Looking For: You’re currently enrolled in an agriculture or related degree program. You’re passionate about ag, sustainability, and making a difference. You’re a strong communicator, organized, and ready to learn. You have a valid driver’s license and are open to travel. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

jobs.name: Deputy Manager - Sales (Human Nutrition) 1
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About The Role: To drive profitable growth of Human Nutrition business in the South Asia region. Drive sales growth : Plan sales strategy to achieve agreed sales target and grow sustainably in the defined territory. Find opportunities : Develop project pipeline with customers, business partners and through collaboration with technical team. Close profitable deals Market research: Develop market intelligence covering trends, regulation, competitor and growth opportunities How Will You Do It: Lead and execute the India sales strategy to achieve annual revenue, profitability, volume, pricing and selling-cost targets. Own sustainable business growth across Pharma, Vitamins, Carotenoids, Dietary Supplements, Food Ingredients and Beverages. Build, qualify and convert a healthy opportunity pipeline through structured opportunity management and clear conversion plans. Identify and develop new growth spaces in fortification, dietary supplements, healthy aging, sports nutrition and emerging nutrition segments. Drive profitable growth through value-based selling, differentiated solutions and disciplined pricing. Develop and execute strategic account plans, customer-specific business solutions and technical value propositions. Build long-term relationships with key accounts, distributors and relevant decision-makers to strengthen customer loyalty and brand value. Expand the customer portfolio and grow net sales and profit through effective business and distribution development. Deliver accurate sales forecasts and relevant market insights to support effective demand, supply and service planning. Apply customer, product-application and value-chain knowledge to anticipate trends, uncover needs and create commercial opportunities. Monitor customers, competitors, regulations and market developments, translating intelligence into actionable growth initiatives. Share customer and market requirements with Regional Product Management to shape portfolio and go-to-market priorities. Use Sales Excellence tools, CPQ and CRM/Sales Force effectively to improve sales productivity, pipeline visibility, forecast accuracy and execution. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, particularly SCM/CSO, to ensure smooth order processing and resolve potential order blocks. Support advocacy, stakeholder engagement and regulatory initiatives, including food fortification topics. Provide timely reports on sales performance, pipeline, forecasts, pricing and other commercial activities. Job Skills: Sales Management. Key Account Management and Distributor Management. Business Development. Basic Technical understanding and support capabilities. Customer and Market Intelligence. Usage of AI and Digitalization techniques in Sales. Leverage AI-enabled market intelligence, customer insights and digital sales tools to improve forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion. What We Look For: Education: Bachelors / master’s in Nutrition/ Chemical/ equivalent with MBA (preferred). Working Experience: 6 to 8 Years. Techno commercial. Technical & Professional Knowledge:  Experience in Nutraceutical / Vitamins / Fortification / Pharma. Excellent network within Nutrition / Pharma companies / trade channels.

jobs.name: Analista Semi Senior Financial Reporting (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: Este puesto se ofrece bajo un contrato a plazo fijo, basado en proyecto, con una duración mínima garantizada de seis meses. Quiénes somos: Somos BASF, la compañía química más grande del mundo, con más de 150 años de experiencia. En Montevideo, operamos como un HUB que brinda servicios a todas las empresas de BASF en las Américas. Ofrecemos soluciones profesionales en finanzas, adquisiciones, reportes, logística, tecnología, recursos humanos, proyectos, comunicaciones, asuntos legales, medioambiente, seguridad, salud y calidad. Área: En el HUB de Montevideo contamos con el área de Financial Reporting, la cual es responsable de asegurar que los estados financieros se completen de forma adecuada, cumpliendo con las normativas locales e internacionales. Se preparan reportes mensuales, trimestrales y anuales donde se trabaja con Finanzas Local, Controlling y la caza matriz. A fin de mes se toma toda la información desde los módulos de SAP System, para luego reportar nuestras versiones Financieras y Operativas en nuestro sistema oficial. Objetivo principal de la posición: Desempeñar tareas diarias y análisis periódicos relativos Financial Reporting, asegurando la integridad y exactitud de la información contable en SAP y otras bases de datos. Principales tareas: Asegurar la correcta ejecución de los procedimientos y controles de cierre de mes (cubriendo todos los procesos predefinidos como FRC controls), garantizando la calidad del reporte a casa matriz. Contribuir en la preparación de notas a los Estados Financieros, trimestrales y anuales. Realización de los Account Análisis mensuales de acuerdo con el mapping de cuentas predefinido. Preparación de las analíticas de acuerdo con el cronograma definido. Presentación de las mismas corresponda. Contribuir en diversos proyectos e iniciativas a lo largo del año relativos a documentación de procesos, FRC, testeos, auditoría, entre otros. Apoyo y coordinación con Local Finance en lo referente a las actividades bajo su scope (Account análisis, Analíticas, M&A). Proporcionar guía y soporte a los negocios en la aplicación de IFRS16. Ser responsable de la creación y mantenimiento en el sistema (RFEX) para los contratos que cumplan los criterios de capitalización en base a la normativa aplicable (IFRS16), asegurando la calidad de la información contable. Monitoreo integral de la Clearing Account, identificando desvíos y canalizando su resolución, velando por el correcto funcionamiento del proceso. Brindar soporte a los negocios en la estimación y proyección de costos asociados a los contratos de arrendamiento. Velar por la correcta gestión de los costos facturados. Colaborar con tareas relativas a Activos Fijos así como al proceso de Account Analysis. Estar en constante y proactiva comunicación con diversos clientes y stakeholders, trabajando de cerca con las diferentes áreas de la organización. Entender el proceso E2E y el impacto dentro del flujo de trabajo, evaluar y proponer mejoras en el proceso. Requisitos mínimos de educación y calificaciones para la posición: Educación: Estudiantes avanzados o graduados en Contador Público o Administración de Empresas. Experiencia laboral: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia contable en áreas de reporting. Idiomas: Manejo de inglés intermedio a nivel oral y escrito. Se valorará altamente el dominio del portugués. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimiento sólido de Microsoft Office, especialmente de Excel, se valorará la experiencia con macros. Buen dominio de las normas contables. Habilidades blandas: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para mantener un contacto constante con clientes, stakeholders y otras áreas del HUB. Qué ofrecemos: Vivir BASF es ser parte de una cultura donde el foco está en las personas y en su desarrollo profesional y personal. Nuestra diversidad, colaboración y estilo de liderazgo marcan la diferencia. Al sumarte a nuestro equipo, te ofrecemos: Un modelo de trabajo híbrido y flexible Acceso a un ecosistema de aprendizaje con recursos y herramientas disponibles on‑demand Seguro médico privado para vos y tu familia desde el primer día, además de seguro de vida Días adicionales de licencia flexible, además de tu licencia legal Día libre por cumpleaños Día libre por mudanza Bono anual (sujeto al cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos por las políticas internas) Beneficios de bienestar, como servicios de nutrición dentro de la compañía y masajes BASF considera la Ley N° 19.691 y el Decreto N° 73/019 en todos sus procesos de contratación. Cada candidato calificado que cumpla con los requisitos establecidos en la descripción del puesto será considerado en este proceso de contratación sin distinción. Además, BASF es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Aceptamos con entusiasmo nuestra responsabilidad de tomar decisiones de empleo sin tener en cuenta la raza, la edad, el estado civil y social, el origen nacional, la discapacidad, el sexo, la identidad de género o las expresiones, o cualquier otra característica o grupo de candidatos o empleados que no esté relacionado con su aptitud e idoneidad para el puesto. Nuestra dirección está comprometida a seguir esta política en lo que respecta a la contratación, colocación, promoción, transferencia, descenso, despido, terminación, reclutamiento, remuneración y otras formas de compensación, capacitación y trato general durante el empleo.

Internship Details: Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Location: Calgary, AB Compensation: $25 - $32 / Hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Support large-scale agronomic trials and contribute to real-world agricultural solutions. Build Your Network : Engage with growers, retailers, and BASF teams across the business. Learn by Doing : Get hands-on experience with seeding, spraying, harvesting, and evaluating crop trials. Grow Your Career : Present your own research project to peers and senior leaders, and explore future career tracks. Have Fun : Participate in customer tours, field events, and team activities while working independently in the field. What You’ll Learn: Agronomic trial design and execution. Crop evaluation techniques including plant vigor and stand counts. Safe operation of ATVs, sprayers, and farm equipment. Stakeholder engagement and professional communication. Time management and independent work in a regional setting. What You’ll Do: Organize and manage large-scale trials (e.g., InVigor Demonstration Strip Trials). Conduct evaluations on seed treatments, herbicides, and fungicides. Support customer tours and presentations. Operate ATVs and pull-behind sprayers. Transport equipment between trial sites. Complete and present a demand creation or research project. What We’re Looking For: Currently enrolled in an agriculture science or related degree program. Enthusiastic about agronomy and eager to learn. Strong communicator with a commitment to safety. Able to travel within your assigned region and work independently. Valid driver’s licence required. Experience with farm equipment and sprayers is an asset. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

jobs.name: Supervisor, EHS
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives According to the general guidance of the supervisor established on the base of the EHS mandatory requirements and Responsible Care ® principles and practices, support the implementation of the EHS programs, including organizing activities to raise employee awareness of risks and to reduce so as to support avoidance of hazards and occupational illnesses in the site. Main Tasks Implementation of EHS concepts (Mandatory and Responsible Care ) Collaborate with the employees and supervisors on the implementation and improvement actions in their work processes / areas to meet the EHS (environmental, health and safety) standards established according to the applicable company, corporate and mandatory EHS regulations and requirements. EHS Preventive measures and objectives Collaborate with the employees and supervisors to identify and correct potential safety and health hazards according to the applicable company EHS regulations and standards so as to recommend improvement actions to support meeting the EHS requirements. Assist in reviewing new/ existing products, equipment, and processes for potential hazards via studying the work and EHS requirements to identify conflicting technical objectives, unsuitability of standard procedures etc. Provide initial recommendations to the parties involved on modification needed. EHS (mandatory and Responsible Care ® ) education Prepare training / education need analysis vie interviews / questionnaire as defined by the supervisor   and consolidate the feedback / inquiries to propose schedules, programs and target groups to help strengthen the employees’ awareness on EHS. May need to assist in conducting workshops and seminars via material preparation and data collection. Organize the education/ training programs and follow-up on the course evaluations to help decision making on the use of such programs. May need to issue regular newsletters to collect EHS suggestions, concerns and inform employees of the EHS practices and requirements. Monitoring EHS performance Interpret the defined EHS and Responsible Care ® regulations and recommend priorities and actions for improvement, including developing safe work practices and measures with supervisors to monitor conformance through safety and housekeeping inspections in their respective work areas. Coordinate and prepare the internal and external EHS performance audits to ensure the effective realization of the audit activities. Act as Site Occupational Health Contact, to coordinate with occupational medical doctor to implement OH relevant issues. Accident follow-up According to the supervisor’s guidance and company requirements, assist in / lead the investigation of occupational accidents or problem areas and recommend improvement / preventive measures. Documentation Maintain a documentation system to keep company, corporate and mandatory EHS rules / regulations, communication materials, inspection and audit reports etc. to ensure that the major activities are properly documented according to needs. Under the guidance of the supervisor, prepare the EHS presentation materials, statistics and reports (e.g. accidents, survey) to support processes in monitoring the conformance of company / corporate/ mandatory EHS requirements. Be responsible for EHS reporting e.g. GID, REHSA Security Be responsible for the securities affairs of the site and ensure the operation of the security facilities and act as security representative to coordinator with Jiahua security issues. Information Protection Officer Be nominated as IPO in accordance with the global BASF policy for information protection. The other EHS related responsibility refers to EHS responsibility agreement. Requirements Education: Bachelor equivalent in Chemical or Engineering Working Experience: More than 3~5 year experience in chemical industry. Technical & Professional Knowledge: EHS management theory

jobs.name: Freight Cost Management (Senior Executive) - Mandarin Speaker 1
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Provide Accounts Payable's related support to deliver AP services to BASF companies in Asia Pacific in accordance to Accounts Payable processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC), local company legal and statutory requirements. • Ensure that timelines and quality meet the agreed service levels and targets. • To coordinate, train and support the Analyst in performing Accounts Payable's payment process related function. • Assist and support Payment Manager in daily task, implementation of project initiatives as when required. Main Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to): • To be a "First Contact Point" within the team, by providing expert knowledge and support to peers and Analysts through proper knowledge transfer; sharing of resources, knowledge, experience and best practices. • To act as 1st backup for manager on daily task as and when required. • To monitor and ensure all payment transactions are executed within the given and agreed timeframe which defined in the BASF Asia Pacific Finance Services Accounts Payable Service Level Agreement (SLA). • To monitor down payment report executed by payment analyst daily and handle technical error when necessary. • To monitor high value invoice report to ensure the invoices are paid on timely manner. • To monitor and handle critical payment items - manual payments, project related one-time payment and ensure accuracy of payment made. • To monitor and ensure all payment processes are aligned to the established Work Instruction (WI) steps and Process Definition (PD) procedures, with the accordance to FRC. • To ensure the 'accuracy and the timeliness of payment process according to agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA) with BASC’s customer contract. • To coordinate and ensure that the analyst attends to the Accounts Payable Service Desk and Payment mailbox on timely manner. • To monitor the accuracy and completeness of clearing on Account Payable related outgoing payments. • To work closely with internal/external business partners (e.g. Procurement, Invoicing, HRS, MD, IQA, Local/Regional Finance and etc.) on resolving payment related topics. • Provide guidance to team members in resolving issues/queries. Groom and develop team members to be able to handle issues/queries independently • Ensure WI are reviewed on a half yearly basis, and new processes are clearly documented especially for new team members. • Support implementation of accounts payable policies based on guideline according to regional and global standard • Monitor & perform GRIR clearing on a monthly basis including statement of accounts reconciliation • Generate AP monthly aging report and perform analysis (aging/debit balances) with follow up on invoices and block status. • Input VAT management including input VAT verification, non-deductible input VAT adjustment and VAT reconciliation reports preparation. • Regularly analyse on root cause of late payment and propose for solution to improve payment timeliness. • Perform Risk Monitor on timely basis with follow up and stamp of action notes – Risk Monitor Missing Approval, Risk Monitor T&E, Risk Monitor Overdue and Risk Monitor Parked Document. • Support audit yearly audit activities and ensuring prepared by clients reports, audit samples collection, audit walkthrough and vendor balance confirmation letters are completed on time within audit schedule. • Schedule and prepare month end post mortem meeting with the manager on regular basis by having an analysis and status update on GRIR status, Risk Monitor reports, Payment Accuracy and any related areas which concern the impact on P2P operation. Customer Relationship Management • Monitor work execution in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and accurate customer service. • Ensure key stakeholder's queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner. • Monitor all activity are processed within agreed service timelines • Monitor customer queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner with end-to-end approach. • Establish and maintain good working relationship with local companies & stakeholders. Process Excellence • Support Manager to identify, recommend and develop solutions for continuous improvement opportunities. Assist Manager to manage knowledge gained on work problems encountered and steps for resolution to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge throughout accounts payable team. • Act as AP Digital Assistant to improve AP performance indicators towards strategic and data-driven position • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. • Provide support to ensure on-time implementation on global and regional P2P projects. • Collaborate closely with Expert/Specialist community in process enhancement related topics. • Drive process changes in the team by recommending and proposing solutions to local company. • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. Education & Working Experience: • Degree in accounting, finance or business administration • More than 5 years’ experience in Finance and Accounting including 1 - 2 years of experience in supervising a team. • Basic knowledge and understanding of P2P and accounting functions.

Mit unseren engagierten, interdisziplinären Teams unterstützen wir die BASF-Unternehmensbereiche dabei, gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Märkten zu wachsen. Wir setzen Investitionen wettbewerbsfähig um. Rund um den Globus, sorgen wir für sichere und zuverlässige Lösungen, damit die Produktionsanlagen exzellente Leistung erbringen. Dabei verbessern wir uns kontinuierlich und treiben den digitalen Wandel voran. WAS SIE ERWARTET Unsere Einheit E&I-Engineering kümmert sich unter anderem um eine moderne und angemessene Automatisierungstechnik für unsere Produktionsanlagen sowie um die Weiterentwicklung des Arbeitsgebietes Automatisierung für Investitionsprojekte. Mittendrin statt nur dabei! Im Rahmen Ihres Praktikums bearbeiten Sie eine anspruchsvolle Aufgabenstellung auf dem Gebiet „Ethernet in der Prozessindustrie“ und bringen Ihr Fachwissen aktiv ein. Darüber hinaus beschäftigen Sie sich mit der Ethernet-Kommunikation von modernen Steuerungssystemen, Ethernet-Netzwerkkomponenten sowie mit PROFINET und Ethernet-APL. Zusätzlich gewinnen Sie Einblicke in moderne Automatisierungslösungen. Sie arbeiten an der Entwicklung innovativer Konzepte und Lösungen, die neueste Technologien mit realen Anwendungen in der Prozessindustrie verbinden. Gemeinsam mit Ihren Kolleginnen und Kollegen setzen Sie Konzepte mit den Prozessleitsystemen der Firmen Siemens, ABB, Honeywell, Yokogawa sowie Emerson um und unterstützen deren praktische Anwendung. Nicht zuletzt führen Sie Diagnosen von Netzwerktopologien durch, evaluieren die Ergebnisse und bewerten diese. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN laufendes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder eines vergleichbaren technischen Studiengangs erste praktische Erfahrungen oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an Engineering-Themen, Automatisierungstechnik sowie dem Aufbau neuer Anlagen Fähigkeit, sich selbstständig in technische Konzepte einzuarbeiten und diese in der Praxis umzusetzen sowie Interesse an modernen Technologien sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift teamorientierte, innovative sowie eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Lernbereitschaft und analytischem Denkvermögen WAS WIR BIETEN Praxisphase - Theorie aktiv in anspruchsvollen und abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben/Projekten anwenden Teambuddy - Ansprechperson für alle Fragen sowie regelmäßiges Feedback Netzwerke - unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Denkweisen und Arbeitsgebiete kennenlernen Praktikumsvergütung - eine Anerkennung des Einsatzes, weitere Infos finden Sie hier Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung - je nach Einsatzort und -gebiet SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Larissa Anna Treiber (Talent Acquisition), larissa-anna.treiber@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56384 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Gerne können Sie sich auch einen Online-Termin buchen. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier . Erste Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier . ÜBER UNS Die BASF SE mit Sitz in Ludwigshafen am Rhein ist die Konzernzentrale der BASF-Gruppe und Teil des Wirtschaftsballungsraums Metropolregion Rhein Neckar. jobs.name: Prosessoperatør
jobs.description: VELKOMMEN TIL BASF BASF i Sandefjord spesialiserer seg på å lage aktive farmasøytiske ingredienser (API) og kosttilskudd av høykonsentrerte Omega-3-fettsyrer. Rundt 140 personer er basert på Sandefjord-anlegget og dekker også funksjoner som kvalitetsledelse, FoU, prosess- og anleggsutvikling, økonomi og HR. HVA DU KAN FORVENTE Stillingen som Prosessoperatør inngår i turnus ordning, 6-skift (dag, ettermiddag, natt og helger) På hvert skift er det skiftleder, 6 fagoperatører og en lærling. Vi ønsker å ha noen på plass i denne stillingen så hurtig som mulig, senest 1. September. Arbeidet består av: •    Kjøre bedriftens ulike prosessanlegg. •    Dokumentasjon av løpende produksjon. •    Utføre 1. linjes vedlikehold. •    Bidra med innovative løsninger i optimalisering av produksjonen. HVA DU TILBYR •    Fagbrev innen kjemi og prosess fag el. tilsvarende teknisk utdanning. •    Sterk teknisk innsikt og forståelse. •    Initiativrik og løsningsorientert. •    Du må ha gode samarbeidsevner og være dyktig til å kommunisere på norsk, skriftlig og muntlig. I tillegg er det en fordel med god engelsk forståelse. HVA VI TILBYR •    En rolle med høyt fokus på kvalitet og sikkerhet. •    Faglig utvikling og mulighet til å påvirke forbedringsarbeid. •    Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. •    Et godt arbeidsmiljø og tett samarbeid med erfarne kolleger. HVORDAN DU SØKER Send CV og søknadsbrev via søknadsportalen. Spørsmål om stillingen kan rettes til Ole Nese, på email ole.nese@basf.com, eller telefon 92695570. OM OSS Hos BASF skaper vi kjemi for en bærekraftig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk suksess med miljøvern og sosialt ansvar. Mer enn 111 000 ansatte i BASF-gruppen bidrar til suksessen til våre kunder i nesten alle sektorer og nesten alle land i verden. Vår portefølje er organisert i seks segmenter: Kjemikalier, materialer, industrielle løsninger, overflateteknologi, ernæring og omsorg og landbruksløsninger. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
