jobs.name: Counsel, Legal & Compliance Service Hub
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Main Tasks You will draft, review, and negotiate local or international legal and intellectual property contracts, using templates and playbooks within defined limits. You will provide legal and compliance support on various matters, including due diligence, merger and acquisition projects, audits, and legal investigations. You will manage the contract lifecycle, ensure process efficiency, and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of contract templates and knowledge management systems. You will interact with internal clients and external customers as required for your assigned tasks. You will perform ancillary tasks such as preparing presentations, using legal tech tools, and handling translations. jobs.name: Principal Analyst Cyber Security Defense Center (m/f/d)
jobs.description: RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the technical response to our most complex and high-risk security incidents as Case Lead - from triage and analysis through containment, eradication, resolution, and closure Lead investigations and compromise assessments Analyze complex malicious artifacts (binaries, scripts, documents) through static and dynamic analysis and reverse engineering to determine their underlying, often obfuscated, functionality Drive our hypothesis-driven threat hunting program: design hunting campaigns, validate hypotheses against threat intelligence, and convert findings into durable detection coverage Design, review, and continuously improve detection logic, correlation rules, and SOAR playbooks on our Elastic Security platform, applying Detection-as-Code practices Shape the CSDC automation and AI roadmap: co-design AI-assisted triage and investigation workflows and supervise their operation with clear human-in-the-loop safeguards Define the strategic roadmap for detection and response capabilities together with CSDC leadership; evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies Act as technical advisor to CSDC leadership on capability development, and as senior escalation point and on-call resource for critical incidents Mentor and train Tier 2 and Tier 3 analysts; develop advanced training content and drive knowledge transfer across the team Lead cross-functional initiatives with adjacent teams (Cyber Threat Intelligence, Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Platform Engineering) and steer external service providers to meet BASF security requirements Represent the CSDC in internal security governance bodies and in external communities and trusted networks (e.g., BSI, Deutscher CERT-Verbund, CSSA, FIRST) QUALIFICATIONS Education and Experience Degree in computer science, IT security, or a comparable technical qualification 8+ years of professional experience in cyber defense, incident response, with a track record as a recognized subject matter expert Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and investigations under pressure in high-stakes situations Technical Expertise Expert-level knowledge of the internals of mainstream operating systems (Microsoft Windows, Linux) and of network protocols and traffic analysis Deep understanding of current attacker tradecraft: advanced persistent threats, actors, infrastructures, and TTPs, structured along MITRE ATT&CK Strong hands-on expertise with Elastic Security as SIEM and EDR: detection rule development and tuning, investigation and hunting; experience with Elastic automation capabilities (workflows, AI Assistant) and ES|QL is a strong plus Proficiency with modern DFIR tooling (e.g., OSQuery, Velociraptor, Volatility, Suricata, Wireshark) and with malware analysis and reverse engineering tools (e.g., Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, WinDbg) Solid experience in cloud and identity threat detection and response (Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Azure, AWS) Ability to program in Python and ideally Go; confident scripting in common shells (Bash, PowerShell); ability to read C and x86/x64 assembly in the context of reverse engineering Working understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations (model-assisted triage, LLM-assisted investigation, explainability) is a plus Leadership and Communication Proven ability to lead technical experts through stressful situations and to remain a calm, structured decision-maker during critical incidents Strong mentoring and coaching mindset; Rejoignez xarvio Digital Farming , l'entité agriculture numérique du groupe BASF, et participez au développement d'une approche innovante de la protection des cultures : le service HEALTHY FIELDS. Avec HEALTHY FIELDS, les producteurs céréaliers souscrivent à un contrat de Performance sur leurs hectares cultivés plutôt qu'à l'achat de produits phytosanitaires. Ce service innovant de protection des cultures repose sur des modèles agronomiques et épidémiologiques combiné à du suivi terrain afin d'optimiser les interventions et de contribuer à une utilisation raisonnée des intrants. Nous recherchons un étudiant ingénieur motivé pour participer régionalement au développement et à l'amélioration du service, auprès des agriculteurs et de nos partenaires de la distribution agricole. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Complètement intégré à la petite équipe xarvio HEALTHY FIELDS (5 personnes), vous participez à: Suivi agronomique terrain : Assurer le suivi d'un réseau de parcelles engagées dans le service HEALTHY FIELDS et confronter les prévisions des algorithmes à la réalité terrain ; Évaluation des outils numériques : Analyser les performances de l'Outil d'Aide à la Décision  et participer à l'exploitation des données agronomiques ; Expérimentation et innovation : Mettre en place et suivre des essais en grandes parcelles chez des agriculteurs partenaires, évaluer l'intérêt agronomique, économique et environnemental des résultats obtenus ; Compréhension des usages : recueillir les retours des agriculteurs et techniciens utilisateurs du service et établir des recommandations d'amélioration de l'expérience client et de la proposition de valeur du service ; Prospective et développement : réaliser une veille sur les services agricoles innovants, participer à la réflexion stratégique d'évolution du service ; Contribuer à des événements techniques et professionnels aux côtés des équipes xarvio. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 dans le cadre de votre dernière année d'école d’ingénieur en agriculture ou agronomie ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'agriculture de précision et les technologies numériques ; Vous avez des bases en production végétales et en protection des cultures (grandes cultures) ; Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au contact des techniciens et des agriculteurs ; Vous êtes basé dans le nord de la France (région Hauts-de-France, Ile-de-France, Normandie voire Grand Est) et possédez le permis de conduire afin d’effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur le secteur (véhicule fourni par BASF) ; Vous êtes autonome, avez le sens pratique et le goût pour le travail collaboratif en distanciel. Rejoignez xarvio Digital Farming , l'entité agriculture numérique du groupe BASF, et participez au développement d'une approche innovante de la protection des cultures : le service HEALTHY FIELDS. Avec HEALTHY FIELDS, les producteurs céréaliers souscrivent à un contrat de Performance sur leurs hectares cultivés plutôt qu'à l'achat de produits phytosanitaires. Ce service innovant de protection des cultures repose sur des modèles agronomiques et épidémiologiques combiné à du suivi terrain afin d'optimiser les interventions et de contribuer à une utilisation raisonnée des intrants. Nous recherchons un étudiant ingénieur motivé pour participer régionalement au développement et à l'amélioration du service, auprès des agriculteurs et de nos partenaires de la distribution agricole. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Complètement intégré à la petite équipe xarvio HEALTHY FIELDS (5 personnes), vous participez à: Suivi agronomique terrain : Assurer le suivi d'un réseau de parcelles engagées dans le service HEALTHY FIELDS et confronter les prévisions des algorithmes à la réalité terrain ; Évaluation des outils numériques : Analyser les performances de l'Outil d'Aide à la Décision  et participer à l'exploitation des données agronomiques ; Expérimentation et innovation : Mettre en place et suivre des essais en grandes parcelles chez des agriculteurs partenaires, évaluer l'intérêt agronomique, économique et environnemental des résultats obtenus ; Compréhension des usages : recueillir les retours des agriculteurs et techniciens utilisateurs du service et établir des recommandations d'amélioration de l'expérience client et de la proposition de valeur du service ; Prospective et développement : réaliser une veille sur les services agricoles innovants, participer à la réflexion stratégique d'évolution du service ; Contribuer à des événements techniques et professionnels aux côtés des équipes xarvio. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 dans le cadre de votre dernière année d'école d’ingénieur en agriculture ou agronomie ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'agriculture de précision et les technologies numériques ; Vous avez des bases en production végétales et en protection des cultures (grandes cultures) ; Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au contact des techniciens et des agriculteurs ; Vous êtes basé dans l'ouest de la France (région Pays de la Loire, région Centre-Val de Loire, voire le sud de la Normandie) et possédez le permis de conduire afin d’effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur le secteur (véhicule fourni par BASF) ; Vous êtes autonome, avez le sens pratique et le goût pour le travail collaboratif en distanciel. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Gratification de stage selon la réglementation en vigueur ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier; Une immersion au cœur des enjeux de l'agriculture de précision ; Une expérience terrain au contact direct des agriculteurs et conseillers agricoles ; Une découverte concrète des outils numériques appliqués à l'agronomie (OAD, modélisation, données satellitaires) ; Une contribution à des solutions favorisant la performance économique et la transition agroécologique ; Un sujet particulièrement adapté à un mémoire de fin d'études ingénieur associant analyse stratégique, terrain, agriculture numérique et transition agroécologique. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Fournisseur majeur de solutions pour l'agriculture, BASF Agricultural Solutions France a pour ambition d'accompagner les agriculteurs dans la transition agroécologique au travers d'un portefeuille de solutions faites de produits modernes de protection des cultures, de biocontrôle, de solutions digitales, de semences et d'expertises agronomiques. Plus de 300 collaborateurs basés à Ecully à proximité de Lyon et en régions, répondent aux besoins des agriculteurs et aux enjeux de l'agriculture française. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. jobs.name: Senior Specialist Product Costing (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our unit Digital Controlling & Processes, we develop and implement system-based steering concepts for our surface business. We oversee and enhance our SAP S/4HANA systems in the areas of controlling, data analytics and business warehouse. In close collaboration with stakeholders, we actively support our differentiated business steering approach by translating business unit and divisional requirements into robust IT solutions. Additionally, we serve as a consulting unit for all related topics and drive innovation in digital controlling processes. In your new role, you own and continuously develop the global product costing process framework, including standards, governance models, policies, and best practices. As the global expert for product costing and SAP CO-PC, you provide guidance to business stakeholders, service providers, key users, and IT partners and translate business requirements into sustainable process and system solutions. In addition, you drive the harmonization, standardization, and continuous improvement of product costing processes across regions and business units, ensuring efficient and compliant process execution. Together with the BPO provider, you monitor and improve product costing service delivery while ensuring data quality, process transparency, audit readiness, and compliance with internal controls. jobs.name: Grow@BASF Internship Program: Commercial Business - Summer 2027
jobs.description: Commercial Business - Summer 2027 Location: This is a field-based opportunity with coverage across several U.S. locations, rather than being solely based in Research Triangle Park, NC. Come create chemistry with us! BASF's Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts to help farmers achieve the best possible outcomes. We integrate sustainability into our business decisions while working to create economic, environmental and social value through more sustainable and efficient agriculture. The Grow@BASF Internship Program gives undergraduate students the opportunity to apply what they are learning in the classroom to meaningful, real-world assignments while developing both technical and professional skills. Where the Chemistry Happens… BASF's Grow@BASF internship programs were created to provide highly motivated, mobile-minded university students with opportunities to enhance their professional skills through diverse learning experiences. As a Commercial Business intern within Agricultural Solutions, you will have the opportunity to work on real-world business projects, collaborate with experienced BASF professionals and gain exposure to different areas of our commercial organization. Program Summary: As a highly motivated undergraduate student, you will participate in a 12-week summer internship working alongside a mentor and BASF commercial teams. Commercial internship assignments may include opportunities within: Product Marketing Customer Experience Digital Tools Communications Market Analysis Logistics and Supply Chain Depending on your assignment, your experience may include: Supporting meaningful projects that address real-world commercial and business needs. Collecting, organizing and analyzing business or market data to help identify trends and opportunities. Using Microsoft Excel and other applications specific to your internship assignment. Collaborating with cross-functional teams and experienced BASF professionals. Supporting projects related to customers, products, markets, communications, digital tools or business operations. Developing recommendations, presentations and other project deliverables. Building your business, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills through hands-on assignments. Gaining exposure to BASF's Agricultural Solutions business, customers and commercial strategy. Mobility is important for this program Internship assignments may be located in a variety of locations throughout the United States, including BASF's North American headquarters in the Raleigh, NC area. Throughout the summer, interns will receive ongoing feedback, mentorship and professional development opportunities. Interns will be assessed for potential future opportunities, which may include a returning internship or, where applicable, a full-time opportunity within one of BASF's Professional Development rotational programs. Create Your Own Chemistry: What We Offer You… Your Grow@BASF internship is an opportunity to build your professional network, develop new skills and gain meaningful business experience within a global organization. During your internship, you will have opportunities for: Hands-on experience through meaningful commercial business projects. Mentorship and professional development. Development of analytical, business and communication skills. Exposure to multiple areas of BASF's commercial organization. Networking with BASF professionals and leaders. Exploring future career opportunities within BASF. About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We’re looking for a professional like you to act as the face of BASF in the field to promote BASF products and services to increase BASF sales and increase BASF market share at selected key agricultural retail accounts. Focus areas will include BASF Crop Protection, Xitavo soybean seed, InVigor canola seed,  xarvio digital, Seed Treatments & Inoculants, and Services. This includes sharing best practices of value-based selling techniques to other Business Reps to foster a “copy with pride” mindset on how to manage other OUs and sell BASF products. Coordinating across U.S. Crop regions/districts so BASF maximizes our investment. jobs.name: Technical Service Specialist, Tupelo Mississippi
jobs.description:
Now hiring! Technical Service Specialist, Tupelo Mississippi Location- Remote / Homebased in Tupelo Mississippi or nearby Pay Range: $80,000 - $95 ,000 We are looking for a Technical Service Specialist to join our Surface Treatment team in Tupelo Mississippi. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. As a Technical Service Specialist (TSS) you will have responsibility that leads and coordinates all technical, purchasing, inventory, reporting activities, manage assigned projects, and respond to customer needs and complaints for our customer accounts within your territory. This position offers an incentive bonus plan, company car, laptop, phone, and all travel expenses covered by the company; travel for this role is 50% daily travel within your territory with occasional overnight travel. As a Technical Service Specialist, you will... Be the first in line for technical support with customers; providing in-depth technical service to key customers. Foster a Safety mindset acting as a safety ambassador for your customers. Complete all required Surventis compliance trainings, complete and pass all required technical training utilizing the CL3 platform, in person live training and adjacent technical seminars. Train plant personnel, line audits, startup of new processes, troubleshoot problems, continuous improvement, coordinate test work being done for the plant and participate in plant functions, such as system clean outs, team audit meetings, process analysis, and inventory management where necessary. Plan service visits with the purpose of bringing value to the customer (not just pinks and blues). The goal is to develop and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders. Communicate with a written service report utilizing clear purpose driven comments of action items and findings. Load service reports Salesforce and notify all key stakeholders. Participate in business reviews to continually reinforce our value proposition while keeping our customers out of the zone of indifference. Set up each account with the proper process instructions for the chemical process supplied by Surventis. Educate customers on proper handling of chemicals, reagents, and sample submission procedures. Assist & facilitate the installation, and troubleshoot and train proper use of process equipment provided by Surventis to the account. Look for opportunities to add business whenever possible, to be done in concert with the Technical Sales Representative (our best leads come from our customers). If you have... Bachelors Degree in Chemistry of Chemical Engineering is preferred. We are also open to high school diploma with more experience. Minimum of 1 year of technical experience with pretreatment, coatings, surface treatment, metalworking and adjacent industry applications is preferred. We are also open to fresh undergraduates with chemistry background. Ability to learn new skills and techniques associated with different product applications and chemical programs. (Products include metalworking fluids, paint pretreatment, e-coat, etc.) Ability to work autonomously, perform job responsibilities, and make consequential decisions without the need for continual direct supervision. Understanding of the chemical process, knowledge of Manufacturing Plant operations and the importance of safety. Technical expertise regarding products, specifications, processes, operations, testing, and data collection. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills and analytical experience for testing and technical evaluation. Strong inventory management/control and product ordering is required. Relationship management experience, building and strengthening relationships with customer's technical department. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Basic computer skills are required. (MS Office Products, Salesforce, etc.) Ability to work collaboratively with internal and external teammates (Surventis and customers) to execute established account strategy and achieve established goals. Ability to lift 50lbs and stand for long periods of time. Travel for this position is 40% with occasional overnight travel within your territory. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Pay transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $80,000 - $95,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position The Customs Classification Senior Executive is responsible for all related activities required for customs classification of BASF products and raw materials as well as other non-chemical materials to be classified. He or she must comply with the applicable laws and customs regulations to ensure a correct and up-to-date classification. In the role, he or she is part of the Global Customs Classification team and needs to closely work together with the National Customs Classification Senior Executive. Main Tasks Delivery of Customs service to business Collaborate cross-functionally with internal working partners in support of trade compliance, supply chain, and general company objectives and projects Support business unit queries related to customs such as classification, duty and analysis Support organizing meeting with countries and any business review as necessary Respond promptly to management Proactively address and resolve any discrepancies or customs-related issues (e.g.tariff classification mismatch, etc.) by troubleshooting the root cause and communicating clearly with Support of the global harmonization of customs classification data and BASF’s IT processes on customs classification Support and understanding of BASF interests at national and international representation of the group interests in this work area C ustoms Compliance responsibilities Support Customs Compliance related assessment, health checks, audit and its documentation Support is desirable Good Microsoft office knowledge Good analytical and work management skills Good knowledge of SAP and SAP GTS is highly desirable English (fluent in spoken and written) Other countries’ language will be advantages The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. jobs.name: (Senior) Regulatory Validation Coordinator (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will execute assigned validation and verification activities for new laboratory and computerized systems and changes to existing systems, in accordance with the approved validation strategy, agreed priorities and applicable OECD GLP requirements. You will prepare and maintain computerized system lifecycle documents and applicable SOPs, ensure they remain accurate, traceable and current, and coordinate review and approval by the designated owner. You will perform validation impact and risk assessments, recommend proportionate controls and escalate decisions beyond the defined framework. You will coordinate deviation investigations, root-cause analysis and CAPA follow-up and escalate significant risks, overdue actions or decisions requiring management approval. You will coordinate and ensure the timely completion of calibration activities for assigned laboratory equipment, in accordance with approved procedures, schedules and priorities. You will apply specialist expertise in GLP validation, computerized system compliance and data integrity and provide practical guidance to stakeholders. You will provide first-line operational IT support for assigned laboratory systems, coordinate issue resolution and escalate matters requiring system-owner or IT decisions. You will prepare assigned validation and calibration areas and documentation for GLP audits and regulatory inspections and coordinate follow-up actions allocated to the role. You will identify improvement opportunities, recommend practical enhancements and coordinate approved changes within the assigned scope. You will coordinate assigned activities across laboratory operations, Quality Assurance, IT, system owners and suppliers, track progress and escalate delivery risks. WHAT YOU OFFER You have a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Engineering, IT or a related field. You have relevant professional experience in GxP validation or another regulated environment and can independently coordinate defined validation, documentation or quality-related activities. You have knowledge of GAMP 5 and applicable OECD GLP guidelines. You have knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, which is considered an advantage. You are accurate, service-minded and collaborative, with a positive and hands-on attitude. You have strong organizational and planning skills and can manage multiple priorities. You show a strong interest in laboratory systems, computing technologies and data management. You have excellent oral and written communication skills and are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER You will join a committed and collaborative team in an international, regulated environment. From day one, you will take on meaningful responsibilities and receive structured on-the-job training and knowledge transfer to further develop your expertise in GLP validation, computerized systems, data integrity and laboratory equipment calibration. We offer competitive compensation and attractive benefits, together with opportunities for professional development and career growth within an international company. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . ABOUT US As a reliable partner of the agricultural sector, BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV offers innovative solutions in the area of crop protection and pest control to improve agricultural production, increase the profitability of agricultural companies and thereby improve the living standards of a growing population. Our strength lies in supporting farmers in the face of the challenges presented by an increasingly complex agricultural sector and in working with them to secure basic human necessities, such as food, nutrition and energy. Learn more about BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV at BASF Innovation Center Gent. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Fino al 1° luglio, la nostra attività faceva parte di BASF. Nell'ambito dell'attuale fase di transizione, tutte le offerte di lavoro e il processo di candidatura sono ancora pubblicati sulla piattaforma BASF e quindi presentati interamente con il marchio BASF. Ti chiediamo di non lasciarti confondere da questo aspetto: tutte le posizioni aperte sono ruoli presso Surventis e la tua candidatura verrà inoltrata direttamente a noi. In Surventis andiamo oltre la superficie in tutto ciò che facciamo. Mettiamo il cliente al centro, pensiamo sempre un passo avanti e sviluppiamo soluzioni che creano valore concreto e partnership durature. Ci ispiriamo a vicenda a guardare oltre, ad assumerci la responsabilità del nostro lavoro e a spingerci costantemente oltre i limiti di ciò che è possibile. Se porti al lavoro la tua autenticità, metti in discussione le risposte più ovvie e desideri crescere insieme a un team che crede davvero in questi valori, questo è il posto giusto per te. COSA TI PUOI ASPETTARE In questo ruolo sarai il punto di riferimento per i clienti dei marchi Glasurit e RM e contribuirai alle attività di back office commerciale, garantendo un servizio preciso e puntuale. Collaborerai quotidianamente con clienti, forza vendita e funzioni interne per assicurare una gestione efficace delle richieste e un flusso di informazioni continuo. In particolare, ti occuperai di: Gestire le richieste dei clienti tramite telefono, e-mail e sistemi aziendali, fornendo informazioni su prodotti, ordini e servizi. Inserire, monitorare e aggiornare gli ordini nei sistemi gestionali (ad esempio ERP e CRM), verificandone la corretta evasione. Supportare la gestione di offerte commerciali, listini e relativa documentazione. Gestire reclami e segnalazioni di primo livello, coinvolgendo le funzioni competenti e assicurandoti un puntuale follow-up. Collaborare con i team di vendita, logistica e magazzino per monitorare tempi di consegna, disponibilità dei prodotti e gestione dei resi. Registrare in modo accurato dati, richieste e interazioni all'interno dei sistemi aziendali. Predisporre reportistica di base relativa alle attività di assistenza clienti. Segnalare eventuali anomalie o scostamenti rispetto alle procedure aziendali. COSA POTRESTI OFFRIRCI Diploma di scuola secondaria superiore (preferibilmente a indirizzo commerciale, amministrativo o tecnico); una laurea, anche triennale, in discipline economiche, linguistiche o umanistiche costituisce titolo preferenziale. Esperienza pregressa di 2-3 anni in attività di customer service o back office commerciale costituisce un requisito preferenziale. jobs.description: Now hiring! Precision Technology Summer Associate We are looking for a Precision Technology Summer Associate to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Saskatoon, SK. Location: Saskatoon, SK Contract Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Wage: $25 - $32 / Hour During peak periods in the season, overtime will be paid for evenings or weekends. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. Conducting precision technology-focused activities for field trials of local and global breeding programs aimed at developing hybrids that provide the highest return to growers. Preparing fields for aerial surveys, creating survey plans, scheduling data collection routines, validating processes, processing image data, acquiring data, and conducting data analytics for the breeding pipeline. Planning and conducting surveys using remotely piloted aircraft to gather data on specific phenotypic targets at different growth stages of the crop, subject to holding a valid basic operations drone pilot certificate. jobs.name: Cyber Security M&A Risk Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. You will be a part of our Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance Team, which manages the Cyber Security Framework for the whole BASF Group. In this role, you will work closely with Corporate M&A, Legal, Data Privacy, IT, business units, and transaction teams to assess and manage cyber security risks in Corporate M&A Projects (Investments/Divestitures). RESPONSIBILITIES Analyzing investments and divestitures from a cyber security perspective throughout the M&A lifecycle, from initial assessment and due diligence through signing, closing, integration, or separation, as well as participation in Post-Merger Audits. Identifying, assessing, and prioritizing cyber security risks of target companies, joint ventures, and divested businesses, and defining appropriate controls and mitigation measures based on the transaction context. Evaluating the cyber security posture of relevant organizations, systems, assets, infrastructure, applications, cloud services, data, third parties, and operational technology, where applicable, using a risk-based approach. Collaborating closely with Corporate M&A, Legal, Data Privacy, IT, business representatives, and external advisors to ensure that cyber security considerations are reflected in transaction decisions and contractual arrangements. Facilitating cyber security due diligence assessments, risk workshops, threat analyses, and targeted vulnerability assessments to identify material risks, dependencies, and potential deal impacts. Maintaining deal-specific cyber security risk registers and associated risk treatment plans, including clear ownership, priorities, target dates, and escalation of material or residual risks. Providing cyber security GRC guidance for Day-1 readiness, integration, carve-out and separation activities, transition service arrangements, and the implementation or transfer of required security controls. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field 4-7 years of relevant work experience Experience in cyber security, particularly in cyber security governance, risk management, and compliance and Project Management; experience in M&A, investments, divestitures, or corporate transactions is highly desirable Strong understanding of cyber security risk management principles and the ability to translate technical findings into business, financial, contractual, and transaction-related risk implications Experience with cyber security due diligence, risk assessments, threat modeling, vulnerability assessments, and the evaluation of complex IT, cloud, third-party, and operational technology environments Knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to cyber security, including their application within international transactions Experience in project management, M&A integration or separation, transition service arrangements, or cyber security remediation programs is a plus. Passion for working in an international, cross-functional, and transaction-driven environment, including the ability to manage sensitive information and competing priorities Experience in Communications with Senior Management and defend Due Diligence findings Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary teams and present cyber security risks clearly to technical stakeholders, business leaders, and decision-makers Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or comparable qualifications are a plus Confident communication in English, both spoken and written. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.description: Now hiring! Sr E&I Reliability Engineer Hannibal, MO We are looking for a Sr. Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Reliability Engineer I to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Hannibal, MO. In this role, you will lead site reliability for electrical power distribution, instrumentation, control systems, and safety-related assets throughout their lifecycle. You will also be responsible for providing reliability support to the site by implementing and driving reliability programs and providing guidance for repair, maintenance and inspection activities. You will use tools such as FMEA, RCFA, RBI, criticality analysis, and other reliability-based maintenance engineering principles to improve electrical, instrumentation, and controls performance. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sr E&I Reliability Engineer, you create chemistry by... Ensuring that all E&I reliability-related activities, including electrical power systems, control systems, and critical instrumentation, are compliant with the company Responsible Care Management System, ISA standards, and applicable statutory regulations, and that relevant asset management systems, procedures, and standards are followed to maintain compliance at all times. Applying appropriate reliability tools to drive improvements, optimize costs, and improve Asset Effectiveness (i.e. Bad Actor Program, FMEA, RBI, RBM, RCM/Criticality Analysis, RCFA, etc.) for E&I assets. Maintaining site reliability programs for critical instrumentation and safety instrumented systems (SIS), electrical distribution assets (e.g., generators, transformers, MCCs, heat tracing, utility power), and control systems. Monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for proactive identification and resolution of reliability issues, including findings from inspection reports. Supporting capital projects by supplying E&I engineering expertise in the specification, design, commissioning, and startup activities in accordance with plant design requirements, as well as regulatory and BASF standards, utilizing your general understanding of industrial maintenance procedures, including work planning, preventive maintenance, and repair parts acquisition. Designing maintenance strategies, procedures, inspection plans and methods for E&I assets. If you... Possess a Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering or related E&I technical discipline. Have a bachelor’s degree and 6 or more years’ experience within a manufacturing or engineering role with technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, and control systems; OR have a master’s degree and 4 or more years’ experience within a manufacturing or engineering role with technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, and control systems. Have strong troubleshooting and diagnostic capabilities within operations and maintenance teams, with experience applying several reliability concepts to electrical and instrumentation assets in an industrial environment. Have strong interpersonal skills. Possess knowledge of Reliability Management tools: maintenance strategies, inspection strategies, Bad Actor Program, RCFA. Have the ability to develop and maintain metrics to measure reliability and efficiency of equipment, including the use of digital tools (e.g. Power BI). Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. jobs.name: Internship Risk Management & Internal Controls (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we are connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We are looking for you as an intern to support our global Risk Management & Internal Controls team. In a collaborative environment, you contribute to strengthening and continuously developing BASF Agricultural Solutions’ risk and internal controls framework. In your new role, you support risk assessments as well as structured risk documentation and reporting, contributing to transparent and reliable governance processes. As a trusted expert, you monitor changes in European tax regulations, assess their impact, and ensure timely implementation within the organization. You continuously enhance key processes, including reporting, risk management, and upstream activities, to increase efficiency, quality, and compliance. By identifying emerging trends and evaluating best-practice solutions, you strengthen knowledge and innovation management and translate new ideas into tangible business value. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you initiate and lead cross-functional projects, transitions, and global rollout initiatives that support the department’s transformation agenda. You contribute to the strategic development of tax-related systems, processes, and concepts while preparing the organization for future business, regulatory, and technology changes. jobs.name: R&D Performance Management Specialist (h/f)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF Agricultural Solutions, and everything we do is driven by our love of agriculture. Our solutions are specifically designed for different cropping systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible benefits to farmers, growers and other stakeholders across the value chain. We are committed to building a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth. Discover our Agricultural Solutions and career opportunities ! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In your new role, you will be responsible for governing the key performance indicator (KPI) system for the technical development of products in the EMEA and CIS region. You will establish harmonized KPI definitions, common calculation methods and a binding reporting calendar; To support the success of field trials and the efficiency of product development, you will design relevant dashboards and management reports, analyze performance variances and derive root-cause analyses, concrete action recommendations and robust decision-making insights; Working closely with your colleagues, you will harmonize metrics and data standards to ensure consistent reporting and reliable comparisons of field-trial and product-development activities across countries and country clusters; You will lead seasonal planning governance, ensure timely planning and the availability of trial protocols, and provide transparency regarding the capacities and skills required to successfully conduct field trials; Finally, you will translate business requirements into digital solutions and develop suitable tools to support planning, risk management and management decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER Master’s degree or equivalent university degree, preferably in agricultural sciences, life sciences, data science, business informatics, decision analytics or a related field; At least ten years of relevant professional experience in performance management, field-trial data analysis, agricultural research and product development, or a comparable R&D environment; Excellent understanding of processes and data structures related to agronomic trials, as well as practical experience with specialized applications such as ARM, SPEAD, Tardis and PENALTI or DoQtor+, multi-trial analysis tools and data-completeness control tools; Excellent command of English and advanced skills in Microsoft Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Excel, including VBA or macros, Power Pivot and advanced data modeling; Analytical mindset and the ability to solve problems pragmatically; Ability to work independently, with precision and a strong sense of priorities. WHAT WE OFFER A stimulating and exciting opportunity in a committed and highly skilled team; An environment that fosters innovation, idea sharing and well-being; A setting that enables you to develop your potential within an international group. ABOUT US As a leading provider of agricultural solutions, BASF Agricultural Solutions France aims to support farmers in the agroecological transition through a portfolio combining modern crop-protection products, biological control, digital solutions, seeds and agronomic expertise. More than 300 employees based in Écully, near Lyon, and across the regions meet the needs of farmers and address the challenges facing French agriculture. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: GB/G Master Data Associate Analyst
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role The Master Data Business Partner Analyst ensures the accurate creation and modification of customer, supplier, and bank master data for the LATAM and/or North America regions within agreed service-level timelines. The role validates data quality, supports stakeholders and projects, follows internal controls and procedures, and maintains a strong focus on customer experience and fraud-risk prevention. What's In It for You •  Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative •  Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions •  Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways •  Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs •  Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture •  Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities •  Validate and perform quality checks on customer, supplier, and bank master data for creation and modification requests in accordance with internal policies and procedures. •  Help prevent potential fraud exposure by confirming that master-data requests meet applicable control and documentation requirements. •  Execute mass-change requests in compliance with internal policies and procedures. •  Support local, regional, and global projects by participating in meetings, preparing reports, and responding to inquiries. •  Maintain clear and proactive communication with stakeholders and other functions to improve the user experience. •  Prepare presentations and reports, perform testing, maintain documentation in Know It, handle ad hoc requests, and deliver user training. •  Act as a backup for other analysts when required. •  Complete assigned activities within agreed service-level timelines and promptly escalate issues when support is needed. Education and Experience •  Education: Professional qualification in Finance (e.g. B com, CA, CPA, etc.) or MBA or Master degree in finance / Accounting or related disciplines. •  Work Experience: 3-5 years of experience in master-data maintenance, procurement, credit, finance operations, or a related field. •  Process Knowledge: Understanding of customer, supplier, and bank master-data creation and maintenance, data-quality controls, internal procedures, service-level requirements, and fraud-risk prevention. •  Decision-Making: Tasks and responsibilities are completed under close guidance or alignment with the team lead. •  Leadership: No leadership experience is required. •  Project Experience: Project experience is not required, although exposure to local, regional, or global initiatives is an advantage. •  Core Skills: Teamwork, effective communication, customer focus, attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage ad hoc requests. Technical Skills •  Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. •  Exposure to SAP or another ERP system is preferred. •  Advanced Spanish, intermediate English, and basic Portuguese proficiency are required for the regional scope described in the source JD. •  Experience with customer, supplier, and bank master-data processes is preferred. •  Ability to prepare reports, presentations, process documentation, and testing evidence. •  Experience in a shared services, multinational, or GCC environment is preferred. About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir beispielsweise Lösungen auf dem Gebiet des Pflanzenschutzes, für technische Anwendungen in der Bauchemie oder Rohstoffe für die Lackindustrie. Weltweit arbeiten wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an innovativen Lösungen, die Endverbraucher:innen und industrielle Formulierer überzeugen - und das zunehmend auf Basis von natürlichen und nachhaltig gewonnenen Rohstoffen. Gestalten Sie die digitale Zukunft unserer Logistik mit: Sie evaluieren und begleiten Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsprojekte, beispielsweise bei der Einführung von Applikationen zur Verwaltung von Fahrer-, Qualifikations- und Flottendaten. jobs.name: TOP START International Business Leader Program (China) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF With TOP START (China) , our exclusive three-year program for future leaders, we will prepare you for a leading position in general management. Contribute your creativity, passion and entrepreneurial drive at BASF and start your successful career with us! Learn more about TOP START here WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you eager to gain comprehensive insights into BASF from various perspectives and regions? Do you feel thrilled working on mission-critical projects in an international context? Do you appreciate diversity and a stimulating environment? Are you eager to step out of your comfort zone and grow as a leader every day? Our TOP START International Business Leader Program offers a unique opportunity for the best graduates around the world to experience all that while maximizing their potential and developing themselves into a leading position for a successful general management career. You are ready to take on responsibility? Actively participate in our diverse international environment from day one and contribute to BASF's success by leading business-driven projects. Are you flexible, open-minded, and feel at home in the world? Be part of three different units in various regions of the world, with at least one assignment based in China within three years. Gain an in-depth understanding of a variety of business areas both at the operational and strategic level. Personalized development and mentoring are of importance to you? Our coaching and development programs, combined with continuous feedback and an individual mentor from our top management, accompany and support you on your way to a successful career. Networking is an essential part of your professional life? Throughout the trainee program, you are in close exchange with our program manager and participate in numerous networking opportunities with trainees, alumni, and board members. WHAT YOU OFFER Outstanding performance - You have an excellent degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) with no more than three years of work experience. On top of your strong management expertise, you ideally bring a general technical curiosity or even have a background that combines management and technology to quickly understand and navigate complex innovation-driven environments. Experiences out of your comfort zone - You have first practical experiences in leading companies, e.g., through demanding internships. Your international experiences have strengthened your communication skills and fluency in English and Mandarin. Think and act like a leader - Your analytical mindset helps you quickly capture complex topics and situations, and you enjoy an innovative and sustainable approach. Inspiration and openness - Your future-oriented actions and implementation of ideas are characterized by your entrepreneurial drive, empathy and a strong sense of collaboration. WHAT WE OFFER A successful start to your career at a global company with individual career planning tailored specifically to you, challenging and diverse tasks and a wide range of development measures. Attractive compensation, including occupational social benefits and outstanding development opportunities within an international company. HOW TO REACH US Laura Beltempo (Talent Acquisition), laura-rebecca.beltempo@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59842 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . The selection process includes a background check of the last diploma obtained and a criminal record certificate. Please submit the required documents only after our request. ABOUT US BASF has been a committed partner to Greater China since 1885. With large production sites in Shanghai, Nanjing, Chongqing and Zhanjiang, BASF is a major foreign investor in the country’s chemical industry, and operates the Innovation Campus Shanghai, BASF’s largest R&D site in Asia. BASF posted sales of approximately €8.2 billion in 2025 to customers in Greater China and employed 12,452 people as of the end of the year. BASF currently operates 29 major wholly-owned subsidiaries, 11 major joint ventures, and maintains 30 sales offices in Greater China. BASF’s portfolio in Greater China comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; and the standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. These solutions are used in almost all areas of daily life such as in houses, cars, food, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, textile, household goods, electronic equipment and packaging. As of the end of 2025, BASF has cumulatively invested more than €15 billion in Greater China (more than €18 billion with partners) to build a locally competitive production, marketing, sales, technical service and innovation network. For further information, please visit: BASF – China (Mainland) Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Accountant
jobs.description: Main responsibilities Financial accounting & reporting • Manage monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities, including journal entries, accruals, provisions and reconciliations. • Ensure ledger accuracy and appropriate accounting treatment under IFRS, local GAAP and company policies; prepare statutory and management reporting. Statutory, tax & audit • Ensure statutory and tax compliance and oversee required filings in cooperation with Tax and external advisers. • Coordinate internal and external audits, maintain accounting documentation and follow up agreed corrective actions. Controls & risk • Maintain effective accounting controls, approval procedures and segregation of duties. • Identify control gaps and financial risks, implement remediation measures and escalate significant issues. Treasury & working capital • Monitor liquidity, cash flow and working capital; oversee payment controls and banking activities. • Monitor receivables, payables and overdue balances and support cash forecasting and credit management. Business support • Support budgeting and forecasting and explain significant financial variances. • Provide reliable financial analysis and recommendations to support management decisions. Processes & systems • Maintain accounting policies and procedures and drive standardization, simplification and automation. • Support ERP changes, finance projects and effective collaboration with Shared Service Centers. General • Protect confidential information, uphold company values and compliance requirements, and contribute to operational excellence. Competencies • Accounting judgment and business acumen • Analytical thinking and structured problem solving • Communication and influencing • Collaboration and customer focus • Planning, execution and accountability • Continuous improvement mindset • Integrity, adaptability and resilience Education • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Professional accounting qualification or postgraduate degree is an advantage. Professional experience • At least 7 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance or audit. • Proven experience in closing, statutory reporting, taxation, internal controls and audits. • Experience with auditors, authorities and professional advisers. • Multinational, Shared Service, SAP and finance transformation experience are advantages. Technical knowledge • Strong knowledge of IFRS, local accounting standards and tax requirements. • Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP and reporting tools; SAP preferred. • Understanding of treasury, cash flow and working capital principles. Languages • Fluent English and local language, written and spoken. • Additional languages are an advantage. jobs.name: Engineering Manager - Greenville, Ohio
jobs.description:
Now hiring! Engineering Manager Greenville, OH We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team in Greenville, OH. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. The Role: The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading the process engineering and quality control functions at the Greenville, Ohio manufacturing site, which produces specialty resins for the automotive industry. This role provides technical leadership to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient support of the site's 24/7 manufacturing operations. The Engineering Manager drives process optimization, continuous improvement, quality performance, and operational excellence while supporting the site's safety, reliability, and business objectives. The department consists of approximately 20 employees, including process engineers, laboratory professionals, and hourly quality personnel. Reporting directly to the Site Director, the Engineering Manager serves as a member of the site leadership team and collaborates closely with operations, maintenance, technology, commercial, and supply chain functions. Process engineering and quality management are critical drivers of manufacturing performance, making this role essential to the site's ability to achieve its operational, business, and financial objectives. As a member of the site leadership team, the Engineering Manager partners closely with operations and maintenance leaders to help establish and execute the site's strategic direction. This position also serves as a vital link between the site and key corporate functions. The Engineering Manager acts as the primary liaison to corporate technology organizations, ensuring alignment on product formulations, process requirements, technology transfers, and new product introductions. In addition, the role serves as the site's primary interface with the global quality organization, coordinating quality initiatives, supporting audits and investigations, and ensuring effective communication between site operations and corporate quality teams. As an Engineering Manager, you will... Partner closely with Operations leadership to achieve production, quality, safety, and cost targets. Provide technical leadership during major plant upsets, quality problems, capacity constraints, and startup activities. Identify and execute opportunities that improve plant profitability and return on invested capital Champion Process Safety Management (PSM) and Responsible Care programs and ensure engineering activities support safe and compliant plant operations. Ensure process engineering support for Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs) Lead and sustain key Process Safety Management (PSM) elements, including management of change (MOC) and pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), ensuring procedures are current, effective, and consistently executed while monitoring performance metrics and driving continuous improvement of process safety compliance. Ensure process safety incidents, near misses, and operational upsets are thoroughly investigated and corrective actions are implemented. Serve as the site liaison to corporate technology, R&D, and product management teams for new product commercialization and technical support. Develop and manage departmental operating budget while identifying opportunities to improve plant profitability. Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and recruitment of engineering and quality personnel. If you have... B.S., ChE 10+ years of experience in the chemical industry Strong technical background Proven record of troubleshooting process issues Good communication, teamwork, and driving change Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Design and optimize SC services (based on GB demand, legal requirements, M&A, investments, strategic projects etc.) Conduct impact and cost analysis of new services in SC Service environment Identify needs for optimization/process changes/automation and drive implementation Provide input for tender strategies and ensure continuous improvement Support the customs related topics and provide expert support for Customs Management Main Tasks Identify required models, methods and tools for Service Design Structure, group and prioritize business requirements Ensure usage of new information and communication technology to design or re-design supply chain services Develop new and extend existing services based on requirements from the business and align with service catalog Test new services prior to implementation and calculate cost Deliver basis for technical concepts in cooperation with DevOp Team and Business Experts Drive automation and digitalization for GB Drive continuous improvement and change management in the operation Create customer-specific and cross-regional distribution concepts in cooperation with respective SDU, Purchase to Pay, Procurement, Custom and Finance team. Drive as Expert to integrate new businesses into GB service structure In-depth knowledge of business and SAP processes and their implementation in foreign trade and other related areas like Supply Chain, Transport Management, and Import Export Management. Proficient in the creation of concepts and process design, with expertise in SAP GTS in the module of Customs Management Requirements Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain management, Logistics, Information System with SAP Certification, or equivalent Minimum 5 years in SCM / Logistics area Supply Chain Management / process knowledge, strong in SAP R/3 and SAP S4/HANA(OTC & TM module) experience, Business Intelligence Tools like SCI , Import Export Operations, foreign documentary trade,customs management, analytical thinking, leading with key performance indicators, and good in communication skills. The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .
