The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with a deep understanding of supply chain and logistics operations. Job Requirements Data Analytics & Insights Conduct exploratory, descriptive and diagnostic analyses Translate findings into actionable recommendations Develop KPI frameworks and business reviews Support benchmarking and ad hoc analytics Dashboard Development & Reporting Design and maintain Power BI dashboards Build data models, DAX measures and Power Query transformations Gather business requirements and develop reporting solutions Data Management & Governance Manage datasets, data models and pipelines Perform data cleansing, validation and reconciliation Support data governance and master data quality Process Automation Analyse existing DDS operational processes and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and work quality, primarily through automation and digital solutions Review and manage automation requests from internal stakeholders, translating business needs into effective digital tools and process enhancements Develop and implement automation solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Python, VBA Macros, RPA, and related technologies Maintain and optimize both new and existing RPA workflows to ensure reliability and continuous improvement Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Statistics or related field 3-5 years in data analytics, BI or supply chain analytics Hands-on Power BI experience, process automation, digitalization projects, or related fields SAP supply chain data experience preferred Advanced Power BI, DAX and Power Query Strong SQL Python (Pandas) SAP data structures and TM knowledge Data governance and quality management Microsoft Fabric/Azure analytics tools advantageous Power Automate, Power Apps Demonstrated jobs.name: Risk Management System (RMS) Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build Your Career on Our Standalone Transformation ). In your new position, you support the implementation and maintenance, and continuous improvement of the RMS, including definition of requirements, setting standards, methodologies, and governance processes. You act as a sparring partner and the operational point of contact for business units and functions, ensuring the consistent application of RMS requirements and fostering a risk-aware culture across the organization. You provide expert guidance and challenge in risk identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation, supporting informed decision-making and effective risk management practices. You contribute to the identification and evaluation of emerging risks and risk trends and support the integration of these insights into business planning and management processes. With your expertise, you support the development and delivery of RMS training sessions and guidance materials and contribute to improving risk awareness across the organization. You facilitate risk review meetings with business units and functions, challenge risk assessments where appropriate, and ensure high-quality risk documentation and follow-up actions. Furthermore, you consolidate risk information and prepare meaningful risk reports and analyses for management and governance bodies. Last but not least, you actively contribute to increasing RMS maturity across the organization and collaborate closely with the RMS Expert 1, the Team Lead, and other key stakeholders to continuously enhance the effectiveness of the risk management system. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in law, economics, natural sciences, or a comparable field at least three years of experience in an RMS department ideally within the agriculture, chemical, or another regulated industry strong knowledge of RMS methodologies including risk assessment, simulation and reporting, as well as familiarity with risk management software and automation tools excellent English skills as well as proficiency in standard IT applications strong analytical and communication skills combined with problem-solving ability, integrity, assertiveness, and the willingness to act as a role model for RMS culture WHAT WE OFFER Responsibility within a leading international agricultural company. Working in a fully international global environment with continuous exchange with colleagues across Agricultural Solutions worldwide. Opportunity to contribute to a robust and future-oriented governance environment. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing are always our top priority. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (isabel.maisack@basf.com) will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Find out more about BASF Agricultural Solutions here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digitalization is a true part of BASF's DNA — creating new customer experiences, driving business growth, and making processes more efficient. Global Digital Services drives BASF's digital transformation through innovative, global, high-quality digital products and a strong agile culture, and the Digital Hub Madrid is one of our key global delivery locations. We are seeking an AI Architect for BASF's DevHub — the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by thousands of engineers and product teams across BASF. DevHub already ships an enterprise AI Gateway (50+ governed models, Entra ID, EU data residency, per-cost-center billing, Grafana observability) and a catalog that is a schema-validated knowledge graph of every product and its infrastructure. As AI Architect, you will own the technical vision and architecture of DevHub's AI capabilities: defining how AI is built, integrated, governed, and scaled across the platform. You will work directly with the Product Manager as the architectural counterpart, shaping the AI roadmap, setting technical standards, and ensuring the team builds the right things the right way. You will treat the platform as a product — designing the systems that serve both humans and agents, with the multi-tenant scoping, cost-tracking, guardrails and governance an enterprise platform demands RESPONSIBILITIES Own the AI architecture. Define and evolve the technical architecture for DevHub's AI capabilities: the AI Gateway, agentic services, retrieval/context pipelines, and platform-AI integration points. Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs) and RFCs that guide the team. Set technical direction for the team. Be the architectural authority on pattern selection, technology choices, and build-vs-buy decisions. Ensure the team applies the right pattern for each problem: deterministic pipelines + structured outputs where outcomes are structured; multi-step/multi-agent orchestration only for genuinely open-ended tasks. Design platform-as-product AI capabilities. Architect reusable building blocks (shared retrieval/"context engine," guardrail and evaluation libraries, MCP/tool layer), scaffolder templates, SDK/API surfaces, and stable versioned interfaces — designed once, reused across features and teams. Architect for humans and agents. Design the MCP / SDK / API surface that exposes platform capabilities — read-first, RBAC- and tenant-aware — so internal and external AI clients can query and (later, gated) act on the platform. Drive evaluation and quality standards. Define the evaluation framework: eval harnesses, golden tests, retrieval-quality metrics, grounding and hallucination controls. Establish context engineering as the primary lever over model selection — the Gateway already solves model choice. Shape MLOps / LLMOps practices. Design the path from experiment to production: prompt/version management, model adaptation pipelines, CI/CD for AI artefacts. Ensure prompts and retrieval are treated as versioned, tested production assets. Architect for multi-tenancy and governance. Design per-product / per-tenant scoping of context, tools, and actions. Define the observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, distributed tracing) and per-product cost/FinOps visibility. Ensure platform RBAC (Entra ID / AccessIT), OWASP LLM Top 10 defences, auditability, and BASF / EU AI Act compliance are embedded by design. Mentor and uplift the engineering team. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the AI engineers. Conduct architecture reviews, pair on complex problems, and raise the team's technical bar. You are not a people manager, but you are the person the team looks to for technical decisions. Represent AI architecture to stakeholders. Engage with Enterprise Architecture, Product Family leadership, and external partners (Databricks, Microsoft) on architectural alignment, technology strategy, and integration patterns. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and vice versa. QUALIFICATIONS Education: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related field. Experience: 7+ years in software/platform engineering, including 2-3 years in technical leadership or architecture roles and recent experience in Generative AI and/or AI-driven systems. Strong Python expertise and production AI/LLM architecture experience, with a platform mindset and ability to set technical direction. Deep experience designing production-scale LLM systems, including RAG architectures, agentic patterns, context engineering, and appropriate use of autonomous agents. Strong system design skills for distributed, multi-tenant systems, including API boundaries, data flows, resilience, ADRs, RFCs, and architecture diagrams. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM/RAG systems, including eval harnesses, golden tests, retrieval-quality metrics, grounding, and hallucination control. Expert-level Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, async) and production-grade API/platform service design. Experience designing reusable self-service platform components, templates, SDKs, and golden paths across teams. Deep Azure experience, Kubernetes/AKS at scale, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code (HCL/Terraform). Experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores such as Azure AI Search, and state management in multi-tenant platforms. Knowledge of LLM providers and platforms including OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, and MCP. Strong understanding of authentication/authorization, RBAC, tenant isolation, guardrails, auditability, OWASP LLM Top 10, and EU AI Act implications. Experience mentoring engineers, conducting architecture reviews, setting technical standards, and communicating technical decisions clearly. Nice to have: Databricks/Unity Catalog, TypeScript, Grafana, MLflow, FinOps for AI, A2A, agentic development standards, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Grid, and experience working with enterprise architecture and vendor teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application comes directly to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it – this is your place. WHAT YOU WILL DO Our Communications team works closely with the business to ensure our strategy is understood and our story is heard. As Regional Communications Specialist Southern EMEA , you give the Surventis brand its voice in Spain, Portugal, Türkiye and across Southern Europe. You shape how Surventis shows up in your region: sharp communication and media strategies, a strong regional network, and stories that earn trust. You work hand in hand with our business units to strengthen our reputation and keep our people engaged and in the loop. You build and nurture relationships with media, industry associations and key external stakeholders, and make sure Surventis is visible and respected in the region. You craft tailored communication plans and messages that land, especially for strategic projects and organizational transformations. You coordinate crisis communication and issue management with internal partners, including EHS. You support our leaders with compelling speeches, presentations and briefing materials for media moments and corporate events. You create content for internal and external audiences, from press releases to intranet stories and social posts, in a voice that is unmistakably Surventis. You bring global messages to life locally and adapt them for employees, digitally and on site. You are an ambassador for our brand, as a company and as an employer, in your region. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or a related field Several years of experience in internal and external communications in an international corporate environment Proven experience in media relations, change communications and crisis communications, ideally with an existing network in Spanish media Strong writing skills across formats, from speeches and press releases to social posts Strong advisory skills and proven experience working with leaders and stakeholders at all levels A creative mind, a proactive and structured working style, networking talent and a knack for solving problems Excellent presentation and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Confident with communication tools and platforms (e.g., CMS) and genuinely curious about AI Excellent written and spoken English and Spanish; Portuguese, French, Turkish or Italian is a plus WHAT WE OFFER The chance to shape the image of Surventis in a fast-moving, supportive environment, with the latest AI tools built into everyday communications. 30 vacation days/year (full-time). Attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan. Local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. A feedback culture firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. HOW TO REACH US Submit your CV in English through the job posting so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, our Spanish Talent Acquisition team based in Germany will contact you (phone prefix +49) and guide you through the process. With each step, you’ll be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact Vanessa Morales (vanessa.morales-soto@basf.com*). *Please note that we will not be able to accept applications via this email address. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Now hiring! Process Engineer Bishop, TX (On-site) We are looking for a Process Engineer to join our Nutrition & Health team in Bishop, TX. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF Nutrition and Health, we develop, produce and market ingredients and solutions for the nutrition and health industries that fulfill the highest safety, regulatory and sustainability standards. We bring our passion and energy to work every day, knowing that through our cutting-edge research and global collaboration, we deliver products that support the health and wellbeing of humans and animals alike across the globe. Our areas of impact include Human Nutrition, Animal Nutrition, Aroma Ingredients, Pharma Solutions and Enzymes. Working in Nutrition and Health offers opportunities for you to develop and grow at every stage of your career. If you enjoy working in a truly inclusive, and highly collaborative environment where you will be valued, recognized, and rewarded for your contributions, we look forward to meeting you! Looking to grow your career in a place where performance and positivity thrive? At BASF, we highly value our employees' feedback, which we gather through annual surveys conducted globally. Recently, feedback from BASF employees at our Bishop site revealed that 96% of respondents are proud to work for BASF, 93% indicated they enjoy their work and 93% would recommend BASF to others as a good place to work.  These results reflect a vibrant, supportive, and high-performing environment—exactly the kind of place where you can do your best work. As part of the Technology and Process Engineering Team, the Process Engineer provides day-to-day support to Operations to ensure the process runs safely, reliably, and efficiently. The Process Engineer also provides strategic leadership in the optimization and improvement of the process. As a Process Engineer, you create chemistry by… Designing, optimizing, and troubleshooting chemical manufacturing processes to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and reliability. Analyzing process performance and implementing improvements to increase throughput, yield, and production capacity. Providing technical support to operators with troubleshooting and clear operating guidance. Developing and maintaining process documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, operating procedures, and process calculations Assessing process hazards and reviewing changes before implementation. Working with operations, maintenance, quality, and project teams to implement improvements. Identifying, justifying, and leading or participating in continuous improvement or optimization projects focused on waste reduction, cost savings, energy efficiency, and operational excellence. Ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including participation in PHA, HAZOP, and MOC processes. If you… Hold a bachelor's or master’s degree in Chemical Engineering from an accredited university. Possess 1-3 years of experience in chemical manufacturing, refining, petrochemical, pharmaceuticals, or related process manufacturing environments. 3-5 years of experience is preferred. Preferrably bring experience supporting continuous process manufacturing operations Have demonstrated experience solving complex process and operational issues. Are a strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills person. Possess effective verbal and written communication skills. Are able to work cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, and EHS teams Have demonstrated knowledge of engineering economics as well as strong commitment to professional and technical development. Preferred qualifications Experience with chemical process design and optimization. Understanding of heat transfer, fluid flow, reaction engineering, and mass transfer principles. Experience utilizing process simulation, modeling, and data analysis tools. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Especialista Sr. de Compensaciones & Beneficios
jobs.description: NEGOCIO SOLUCIONES PARA LA AGRICULTURA En BASF somos apasionados por la agricultura y todo lo que hacemos nace de ese compromiso. Nuestras soluciones están diseñadas para responder a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y a los diferentes sistemas de cultivo, integrando semillas y traits, protección de cultivos, herramientas digitales y soluciones de sustentabilidad. Junto a productores y a toda la cadena de valor, trabajamos para generar resultados sostenibles y construir una agricultura cada vez más innovadora, productiva y preparada para el futuro. Por amor a la agricultura, el trabajo más valioso sobre la tierra.  #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth ACERCA DE LA POSICIÓN Como Especialista Sr. de Compensaciones y Beneficios, serás responsable por definir y ejecutar la estrategia de Total Rewards para el negocio en Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, Chile y Perú, impulsando soluciones que contribuyan a la atracción, retención y experiencia de nuestros colaboradores. Trabajarás junto a líderes, a HRBPs y al equipo de Recursos Humanos, para promover prácticas competitivas, equitativas y sostenibles, conectadas con las necesidades de las personas y del negocio. Tus principales desafíos serán: Impulsar la implementación y evolución de las estrategias de Compensaciones y Beneficios de los países a cargo, asegurando la adecuación a las particularidades de cada mercado. Asesorar a líderes y HRBPs en aspectos vinculados con estructuras salariales, promociones, equidad, y esquemas de compensación. Liderar evaluaciones de puestos y análisis de competitividad externa, integrando información de mercado y tendencias para desarrollar recomendaciones que orienten la toma de decisiones vinculadas a Total Rewards. Gestionar programas de incentivos y reconocimiento, participando en iniciativas de Compensaciones y Beneficios asociadas a procesos de transformación organizacional. Administrar el portafolio de beneficios, incluyendo políticas, proveedores, costos y presupuesto, con foco en su competitividad, sostenibilidad y contribución a la experiencia de los colaboradores. Gestionar las métricas del área y transformarlas en inputs para identificar oportunidades y orientar la evolución de las prácticas del área. REQUISITOS DEL PERFIL Formación universitaria completa en Recursos Humanos, Administración de Empresas, y/o carreras afines. Inglés Avanzado. Serán valorados estudios de posgrado y/o especialización en Compensaciones, Beneficios o áreas relacionadas. Experiencia: Sólida trayectoria en Compensaciones y Beneficios, con participación en procesos de esquemas de remuneración, beneficios, evaluaciones de puestos, encuestas salariales e incentivos. Gestión de análisis de mercado, proveedores, costos y presupuesto. Se valorará el haber participado en proyectos de transformación organizacional y en iniciativas que requieran articulación con líderes, HRBPs y múltiples stakeholders. Conocimientos Técnicos: Arquitectura de esquemas de compensación y de beneficios Evaluación de puestos y estrategia organizacional Tendencias de mercado y competitividad salarial People Analytics aplicado a Total Rewards Gestión financiera, presupuesto y proveedores Marco normativo de Compensaciones y Beneficios Competencias de Gestión: Análisis estratégico con visión de negocio Perspectiva y foco en Employee Experience (EX) Ownership y orientación a resultados y a la mejora continua Mindset digital y toma de decisiones basada en datos Sólidas habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento. Articulación y trabajo en equipo con stakeholders Nuestra química valora el talento y la diversidad de género, edad, raza, color, nacionalidad, creencias, orientación sexual, identidad y expresión de género, discapacidad y todas las demás características, diferencias y semejanzas que son parte de la diversidad humana . ¡Te invitamos a postularte a nuestras vacantes!

jobs.name: Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field) NW Iowa, N Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota Territory We are looking for a Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager to join our Agricultural Solutions team. This role for the Thurston Genetics business unit within BASF revolves around the customer experience and driving profitable growth. The foundation for this is a strong team that brings technical product and product placement, industry and market knowledge in order to understand the diverse markets where we build trusting and satisfying customer relationships. The person in this role will be responsible for managing 35-40 accounts across the assigned territory. Additionally, they will provide support on another 10-15 accounts located in Wisconsin and Canada. They will meet BASF specified targets by creating value for the existing customer base and prospecting for new opportunities for Thurston Genetics corn hybrids. They will report to the National Sales Manager. They will reside within the Northern Sales territory. Traveling up to 35% of the time overnight. Our opportunities can take you all over North America. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field), you create chemistry by... Managing business relationships with assigned seed company accounts, which may include Corporate and/or Regional Business relationships. Relying on your Account Management experience and demonstrated corn germplasm knowledge, you will develop and communicate product information to accounts allowing for effective business solutions to be developed representing mutually successful and profitable results. Forecasting sales and seedstock supply needs are key to business units success as well as managing through inventory shortages. Thinking strategically and with high self-motivation, you will build strong relationships with accounts to ensure Thurston Genetics and BASF are positioned as preferred suppliers. Having strong business acumen and demonstrating understanding of the agricultural markets will help drive strategic decisions for the business, developing and executing strong business plans for results. Having opportunities to take on special projects related to candidate skills and experience. Participating in building product testing plans including field days, observation plots and research yield trials across North America. Utilizing your corn product management and field evaluation experience, you will focus on identifying and characterizing high performing corn inbreds and hybrids for commercial release. Being willing and able to travel approximately 35% of the time. Considerable time will be spent traveling with other account managers to learn customer and sales territory needs. Significant travel required initially with the amount of travel decreasing as the candidate becomes more experienced and knowledgeable in the territory. If you... Have a B.S. Degree in a Crop Genetics, or agronomy-related field is very desirable, and at least 10 years of experience in such a field is required. Have at least 5 years of experience in building and maintaining strong customer relationships. Have prior experience in corn product management or in corn hybrid evaluation. Have prior experience with plot data analysis software, hybrid advancement presentations, sales presentations, and interaction with sales personnel and growers. Are excellent in verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to work well with others on a wide range of topics is mandatory. Have self-motivation and the ability to work independently. Have strong computer skills and experience with relational databases and have the ability to use multiple presentation methods to effectively communicate to broad customer base is required. Are willing and able to travel 35%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Order Management (Executive)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position The Executive, Order Management, will execute the customer order management processes with a consistent high level of service across ASEAN, ANZ, Taiwan for the Customer Service which is still with GB. Main Tasks Operations and Performance Execute the Customer Order Management processes set up in KL Hub with the different models & interfaces Processing of sales and purchase orders from various customers in a timely manner Service contact for assigned countries – monitor order status and provide update information to the countries and customers BL draft checking (for LC orders, 3rd party supplier orders and key customer orders) Manage Insurance Certificate (if necessary) Follow up BL receipt status based on ETD Collection of Original Bill of Lading and other documents from goods suppliers Provide full and accurate required documents to customers Upload / maintain documents in SAP for audit trail Support documents for internal and external audit purpose Register all and follow-up with all non-conformances in the NCM system to ensure a quick and efficient customer response Participate proactively in new workflow for on time & accurate documents Ensure that delivery capability and reliability of all orders Ensure that a minimum internal cycle time of order processing is achieved by improving the process wherever possible Verifying pricing with Marketing and execute & monitor all guidelines implemented Troubleshooting and problem solving Process debit and credit notes wherever applicable (BU) Requirements Education Bachelor degree or High Diploma preferably in Business or Supply Chain Management Working Experience 2-4 years relevant experience in supply chain management, including hands-on experience in order management and shipping document handling Technical & Professional Knowledge Supply Chain Management / process knowledge, SAP (SD module) experience, operational order management including shipping documentation, foreign documentary trade, good communication skills. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Manager - Human Resources
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Main responsibilities Site HR Leadership & Business Partnership Act as the primary HR partner for Bangpakong and Rayong site, translating business requirements into practical people solutions aligned with company policies and local law. Advise site management and business leaders on workforce planning, organization changes, employee relations, performance matters, staffing, development, and employee exits. Monitor headcount, employee movements, turnover, and organization data to support workforce planning, succession, recruitment, and employee development decisions. Review site HR practices, procedures, and work instructions, and recommend improvements based on business needs, market practices, and regulatory developments. Employee Relations, Labor Relations and Workforce Advisory & Compliance Serve as the primary HR focal point for employee relations and workforce advisory matters at the site. Provide guidance to leaders and employees on workplace practices, employee concerns, performance management, organizational changes, and policy application. Facilitate fair, consistent, and compliant resolution of people-related matters while balancing employee experience, business requirements, and legal considerations. Support workforce transitions, organizational effectiveness, and change initiatives through proactive consultation and risk management. Maintain appropriate documentation and governance standards to ensure regulatory compliance and organizational integrity. Collaborate with HR Management, Legal, and business leaders on complex workforce matters and continuous improvement initiatives. Manage day-to-day employee relations matters for the assigned site and legal entity scope. Plan and implement employee communication and engagement activities, including employee surveys, communication meetings, and site initiatives that promote constructive dialogue. Legal Entity Accountability & Authority Interaction Act as the HR owner for labor-related matters at site and legal entity level within the assigned scope. Engage with relevant local authorities on operational HR matters and coordinate with specialist functions for topics involving labor, social security, tax, immigration, permits, or other regulatory requirements. Support government inspections, audits, and regulatory inquiries through accurate documentation, clear ownership, and timely responses. Monitor and support compliance with applicable national, provincial, municipal, district, and industrial-estate requirements affecting employment and site operations. Build constructive working relationships with government offices, external parties, industrial-estate representatives, and neighboring organizations where required for site operations. Core Site HR Operations Coordinate site recruitment, onboarding, employee orientation, and workforce-provider or outsourcing activities. Coordinate training delivery and records and work with line managers to monitor on-the-job training plans and completion. Administer site performance-management activities, including communications, documentation, and cycle readiness. Coordinate employee welfare and benefits administration at site level and facilitate employee support in line with company processes. Maintain appropriate site HR records and provide accurate data and inputs to HR processes, audits, and management reporting. People Leadership & Collaboration Lead, coach, and develop assigned team members and service-provider resources, setting clear priorities and performance expectations. Collaborate across HR, Legal, EHS, site operations, finance, and business functions to deliver coordinated solutions. Handle sensitive and confidential matters with professionalism, sound judgment, appropriate escalation, and respect for all parties. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Law, Political Science, Business Administration, or a related field. At least 7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in employee relations, labor relations, site HR, or an HR generalist role within the manufacturing or chemical industry. Strong knowledge of Thai labor law, employment regulations, and compliance requirements. Proven experience in employee relations, labor relations, and workforce advisory. Proven ability to handle sensitive workforce issues and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments with both blue-collar and white-collar employees. Experience supporting multiple sites or legal entities is an advantage. Relevant certifications or qualifications required by local regulations. Work location Bangpakong, Chonburi BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

jobs.name: Internship Granulation and Film Technology (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are a leading global research organization with over 3000 employees working in the field of material and analytical science, chemical synthesis, process development, bioscience, catalysis and digitalization. With our creative and diverse teams as well as our cutting-edge research, we help to make our customers more successful and drive the sustainability transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The “Coating & Film Processing” unit develops manufacturing processes and products for future-oriented technologies such as lithium-ion batteries, electrolysis, fuel cells and CO2 capture. A core element of our development work is the coating of functional materials. Based on laboratory experiments, formulations and process conditions are developed to maximize product performance and establish scalable manufacturing processes. During a five- to six-month internship starting in February/March 2027, you have the opportunity to get to know BASF and make your first professional contacts. In addition, you can apply the expertise you have acquired to practical challenges. Your work will focus on the following topics: You become part of a highly motivated team of experienced engineers and laboratory technicians. In the development of new formulations, you support our laboratory team and apply various mixing and dispersion methods. You plan and conduct coating trials using new materials. Based on your observations during the experiments, you derive the next experimental steps. In doing so, you independently apply analytical methods such as rheology and microscopy, including image analysis. To gain a deeper understanding of the experiments, you support our colleagues in the electrochemical characterization of the samples produced. If required, you use in-house simulation tools or develop your own evaluation routines. You present your results in team meetings and discuss them with colleagues from the relevant specialist departments. WHAT YOU OFFER currently enrolled in a degree program in process engineering or chemical engineering with a strong academic record practical experience in conducting laboratory experiments knowledge of heat and mass transfer, particle technology, formulation technology, or drying technology with very good grades good command of MS Office and, ideally, some prior knowledge of Python good communication skills and a strong team spirit WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information you will find here Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Corinna Granterath (Talent Acquisition), corinna.granterath@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59302 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE here . Beyond the campaign activities, you gain insights into international HR Reporting processes by supporting evaluations, ad-hoc analyses, and continuous improvement initiatives within the team. WHAT YOU OFFER currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Human Resources, Economics, Social Sciences, Data Analytics, or a related field initial experience in reporting, data analysis, HR, or project support is an advantage strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented working style excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously confident handling of MS Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint strong communication and stakeholder management skills ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory WHAT WE OFFER From day one you will be part of the BASF family. jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application comes directly to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it – this is your place. WHAT YOU WILL DO Support for HR processes and projects. Support in applying the collective bargaining agreement and managing employment-related queries. Basic advice to managers on employment and recruitment matters. Coordination with the Personnel Administration team to ensure the proper management of new hires, terminations, contracts, payroll and other administrative processes. Handling and resolving employee queries related to payroll, holidays, leave and employment conditions. Preparation of reports and monitoring of HR indicators, such as absenteeism, labour costs and headcount. Support in preparing documentation for official bodies and employee representatives. Collaboration on internal reorganisation processes and other HR projects as required. Monitoring regulatory changes and supporting the implementation of new employment measures. Support and management of the HR department’s administrative tasks. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources and Labour Relations, or an equivalent academic qualification. At least one year of experience in an employment law role within a company. Advanced level of spoken and written English. User-level knowledge of office software and SAP HR modules. Excellent organisational and customer-service skills, along with analytical and innovative thinking. WHAT WE OFFER The chance to shape the image of Surventis in a fast-moving, supportive environment, with the latest AI tools built into everyday communications. 30 vacation days/year (full-time). Attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan. Local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. A feedback culture firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Submit your CV through the job posting so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, our Spanish Talent Acquisition team based in Germany will contact you (phone prefix +49) and guide you through the process. With each step, you’ll be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact: Vanessa (vanessa.morales-soto@basf.com*). *Please note that we will not be able to accept applications via this email address. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Seed Agronomic Sales Advisor - Western Iowa (Field)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Seed Agronomic Sales Advisor - Western Iowa (Field) Western Iowa - Field (relocation assistance/sign on bonus/etc) We are looking for an Seed Agronomic Sales Advisor to join our Agricultural Solutions team and support the Western Iowa territory. As an Seed Agronomic Sales Advisor, you will develop and strengthen strategic relationships with retailers, growers, and consultants across your territory. Serving as a trusted agronomic expert, you will provide recommendations on BASF seed, crop protection, and seed treatment solutions that help customers maximize productivity, yield, and profitability. You will serve as the primary business lead for assigned retailers, driving growth through effective business planning, product positioning, and customer engagement. In this role, you will be accountable for achieving annual sales targets across the seed, crop protection, and seed treatment portfolios while collaborating closely with internal and external partners to deliver value to customers. This position requires regular travel throughout the territory, including overnight travel of up to 5%. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As an Seed Agronomic Sales Advisor, you create chemistry by... Establishing strategic business and agronomic plans with key growers, serving as the primary BASF contact and delivering both short- and long-term solutions that meet customer needs. Developing territory and retailer business plans that drive growth across seed, crop protection, and seed treatment portfolios while positioning BASF as the partner of choice. Creating demand for BASF seed (70%) and crop protection products (30%) through targeted sales strategies, forecasting, product positioning, and collaborative customer engagement. Serving as a trusted advisor to growers and retailers by providing expert agronomic, seed, and crop protection recommendations. Driving achievement of sales, market share, and financial targets through accurate forecasting, KPI management, and disciplined execution. Collaborating with sales teams, technical service representatives, strategic account managers, and retail partners to implement customer plans and accelerate business growth. Building strong partnerships with retail agronomists, seed managers, and sales teams through joint customer interactions that maximise product placement and performance. Developing and executing market development strategies, product launch plans, crop-focused activities, and product positioning initiatives that support territory growth objectives. If you... Hold a Bachelor’s Degree and have 4+ years of professional sales experience. Have a proven track record of driving sales results, coupled with strong business acumen and analytical thinking. Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach. Excel at time, territory, and resource management, enabling you to effectively prioritize and achieve business objectives. Are proficient with digital tools and technologies, including Microsoft Office applications and agricultural sales platforms such as Sales X and SalesForce. Thrive in a collaborative environment and use data, insights, and technology to support strategic decision-making and deliver results. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Technical Service Manager Refining Catalysts
jobs.description: Location: Ataşehir Working type: Hybrid WELCOME TO BASF BASF is a leader in innovative catalysts for the petroleum refining industry. Through its Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) catalysts, additives, and expert technical services, the business helps customers maximize the production of high-value fuels and petrochemicals while addressing their unique operational needs. With a strong focus on customer-driven research and development, BASF continuously develops innovative solutions that enhance refinery efficiency, flexibility, and profitability. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a member of BASF's Global FCC Technical Service team, you will play a critical role in maximizing customer value, refinery performance, and business growth across our FCC catalyst portfolio. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and a key link between commercial, technical, manufacturing, and innovation teams, you will drive technical excellence, strengthen customer partnerships, and help shape the future of FCC technology solutions. Play a critical role BASF's FCC Technical Service team, providing expert support on catalyst performance, additive applications, troubleshooting, and refinery unit optimization to deliver outstanding customer outcomes. Build trusted relationships with refinery customers by leading technical reviews, site visits, startups, turnarounds, and performance assessments, while serving as a key technical advisor. Partner with Commercial, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Management, and Global Technology teams to support customer retention, drive business growth, and successfully develop and commercialize new solutions. Deliver technical excellence through catalyst evaluations, refinery data analysis, and resolution of complex FCC operating challenges, ensuring recommendations align with both customer and business objectives. Drive operational effectiveness by supporting technical projects, resource planning, customer deliverables, and continuous improvements to processes, tools, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Liaise with industry experts, licensors, laboratories, and consultants to ensure high levels of service delivery to our customers WHAT YOU OFFER You must hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline. Minimum of five years of direct Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) experience gained within a refinery, licensor, catalyst or additive manufacturer, or a combination of these environments. Ten or more years is preferred. Candidates without direct FCC experience will not be considered. Working knowledge of refinery operations and economics, including the operational and commercial factors that influence FCC unit performance and customer decision-making. Proven experience leading technical teams and delivering complex, cross-functional projects in a customer-focused environment. Demonstrated ability to evaluate FCC catalyst performance, analyse refinery operating data, troubleshoot technical issues, and develop actionable recommendations. Strong business acumen, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical recommendations clearly and connect them to measurable customer value. Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% of working time.

Opportunity to contribute to a robust and future-oriented governance environment. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. jobs.description: Now hiring! This position is part of the global E&M Strategy to establish and build and maintain knowledge in the area of Advanced Process Control in the North American region. Up to 50% domestic and international travel required to various BASF sites to support projects and initiatives. Local telecommuting permitted two days per week. No Direct Reports. Maintaining and revamping existing APC applications as required to ensure optimal utilization. Developing standardized work processes for APC project development, management and maintenance as well as for the required support infrastructure including application server installation, networks, and firewalls. Identifying, championing, implementing and maintaining Process Automation Systems, specializing in the Advanced Process Control Technology area. Leading optimization efforts to identify and correct base layer control strategies, making recommendations for and designing Advanced Regulatory Control opportunities. Leading studies to determine the economic feasibility of APC implementations. Leading the evaluation of new technology as it applies to Advanced and Basic Process Control, especially with regard to Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions. A Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a closely related Engineering field. Fifteen (15) years of related experience. Ten (10) years of experience which must include: Lead Advanced process control projects in the Chemicals, Refining or Petrochemicals industry including all aspects of project justification, development, implementation and ongoing support; Core chemistries experience including Acetylene, Acrylic Acid, Butadiene, Ethylene Oxide, MDI, TDI, and Steam Cracker technology for ethylene and propylene; Common process industry unit operations such as reactors, distillation towers, heat exchangers along with common techniques to control and optimize; Aspen DMCPlus & DMC3 from all aspects including data collection, model building and deployment, and maintenance; Control concepts including Control Theory, Basic and Advanced Regulatory Control, and Advanced Process Control; Loop Tuning for standard, Cascade, ratio, and split range control loop strategies with dynamic rates; Implementing AI based solutions suitable for Process Control; Control system technology including common instrumentation used in continuous plant processes; Control strategy development in standard DCS solutions: ABB 800xa, Emerson DeltaV, Honeywell Experion, and Schneider Foxboro; Design and implement control and advanced control improvements including Control Room Operators & Supervisors, Engineers, Plant Management and Vendors; Advanced Process Control, basic and advanced regulatory control and control theory including loop tuning and complex control strategies; Basic Process Control Systems (BPCS) base functionality with respect to regulatory control capabilities and implementation. jobs.name: Global Customs Duty Optimization (Senior Executive)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position The purpose of this role is to support customs duty optimization activities across international operations while ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations. The position is responsible for analyzing customs duty cost developments, monitoring customs duty savings programs, preparing reports and dashboards, and supporting the implementation of customs duty optimization initiatives. The role collaborates with Customs, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to identify savings opportunities, assess financial impacts, and support the realization of customs duty benefits through effective monitoring and reporting. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Support cost-benefit evaluations on customs duty topics to ensure compliance and maximize operational efficiency. Analyze customs duty data and prepare trend analyses to identify opportunities for cost optimization and assess potential financial impacts arising from changes in customs legislation. Support Expert in collaboration with Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Business Units in customs duty optimization initiatives. Monitor duty exemption, deferment, suspension, and other customs savings programs, including associated financial impacts and realized benefits. Perform analyses related to tariff classification and other customs-related matters to support customs duty optimization activities. Prepare customs duty cost development reports, dashboards, and management updates, including findings and recommendations. Monitor duty drawback, refunds, incentives, recovery programs, aging items, and support the tracking of financial exposure, penalties, and fines. Monitor and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to customs duty optimization, customs cost developments, and savings realization across the regions. Support process improvements, reporting enhancements, automation initiatives, and data quality activities related to customs duty optimization. Assist expert with regional stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate customs duty-related information. Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. Job Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, International Trade, Supply Chain Management, or related field. 3-5 years of experience in Finance, Audit, Customs, Controlling or related fields. Knowledge of customs legislation, international import and export regulations, and customs duty optimization programs is an advantage. Attention to detail and proficiency in tracking, monitoring, and reporting using dashboards or analytical tools. Ability to analyse financial and customs-related data, identify trends or anomalies, and translate findings into actionable insights. Knowledge of tariff classification, customs duty regulations, customs legislation, and customs cost optimization principles. Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to enhance reporting processes, automation, and controls. Proficiency in SAP ERP, SAP GTS, Power BI, or similar reporting and analytical tools is an advantage. Ability to work collaboratively across departments with clear communication to business stakeholders. Ability to work flexibly and collaborate with stakeholders across different time zones. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF BASF is a leader in innovative catalysts for the petroleum refining industry. Through its Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) catalysts, additives, and expert technical services, the business helps customers maximize the production of high-value fuels and petrochemicals while addressing their unique operational needs. With a strong focus on customer-driven research and development, BASF continuously develops innovative solutions that enhance refinery efficiency, flexibility, and profitability. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Technical Service Manager – Refining Catalysts is responsible for delivering technical expertise and customer support across BASF’s FCC catalyst and additive portfolio. The role partners closely with refinery customers, commercial teams, manufacturing, R&D, and product management to optimize catalyst performance, solve complex operational challenges, strengthen customer relationships, and drive sustainable business growth. Provide expert technical support for FCC catalyst and additive applications, including performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and refinery unit optimization Build and maintain strong customer opportunities and deliver value-driven recommendations Lead the resolution of complex technical and operational challenges while ensuring alignment with customer and business objectives Support technology teams to develop, evaluate, and commercialize innovative catalyst solutions Manage technical projects and customer deliverables while ensuring high standards of safety, quality, and compliance Collaborate with licensors, laboratories, consultants, and industry experts to deliver best-in-class technical solutions and customer service Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance technical processes, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction Represent BASF as a trusted technical advisor and industry expert within the refining sector WHAT YOU OFFER Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline Minimum 5 years of direct FCC experience, gained within a refinery, licensor, catalyst supplier, additive manufacturer, or a combination of these environments Strong knowledge of FCC catalyst technologies, refinery operations, process optimization, and refinery economics Proven ability to evaluate catalyst performance, analyze operating data, troubleshoot technical issues, and provide actionable recommendations Experience leading technical projects and
