jobs.name: Senior Manager - Sales Home Care ASEANA
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives Take full commercial responsibility for the Home Care business in ASEAN and ANZ (ASEANA), delivering sustainable and profitable growth. Own the regional commercial P&L, including sales volume, pricing strategy, profitability, working capital, discretionary costs, inventory management (DIV), and receivables management (DSO). Develop and execute regional business strategies aligned with global and Asia Pacific growth ambitions. Strengthen BASF's market leadership position through strategic account management, customer partnership development, and new business acquisition. Lead and develop a high-performing sales organization, fostering a customer-centric, performance-driven, and compliant culture. Establish strong cross-functional collaboration to ensure execution excellence across the value chain. Ensure full compliance with BASF standards, local regulations, trade controls, and chemical industry requirements across ASEAN and ANZ. Main responsibilities 1. Commercial Leadership & P&L Management Own and deliver regional commercial targets covering sales volume, revenue, contribution margin, profitability, working capital, and cash-flow related KPIs. Define and implement pricing strategies to optimize market share, profitability, and value capture. Drive rigorous management of discretionary spending, inventory levels, and accounts receivable to achieve financial targets. Establish robust forecasting processes and monitor business performance through regular reviews and corrective actions. Identify business risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure sustainable performance delivery. 2. Business Strategy & Market Development Develop and implement the ASEANA Home Care commercial strategy in alignment with global business objectives. Drive market expansion initiatives across priority countries, market segments, and customer groups. Lead commercialization of new product launches and innovations in collaboration with Product Management, Marketing, Technical Service, and R&D teams. Evaluate and optimize go-to-market models, distribution networks, and sales channels to maximize business effectiveness. Develop strategic growth plans for key markets and customer segments. 3. Strategic Account Management Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with Local, Regional, and Global Key Accounts. Act as executive sponsor for strategic customers and lead engagement with senior customer stakeholders. Drive account planning processes and establish multi-year growth partnerships. Lead complex commercial negotiations, contract discussions, and strategic supply agreements to defend and expand BASF's supply share. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive issue resolution and value-added partnership development. 4. Market Intelligence & Business Insights Monitor and analyze market trends, customer requirements, competitive activity, regulatory developments, and macro-economic conditions. Translate market intelligence into actionable commercial strategies and growth initiatives. Identify emerging business opportunities and potential threats to support proactive decision-making. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to regional and global leadership teams. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration Foster strong collaboration and alignment between Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical, R&D, Supply Chain Management, Operations, and other business units. Ensure customer strategies are fully supported through effective cross-functional execution. Lead resolution of supply, product, service, and operational challenges impacting business performance. Promote knowledge sharing and best-practice exchange across countries and functions. 6. People Leadership & Talent Development Lead, coach, and inspire the regional sales organization to achieve ambitious commercial objectives. Establish annual targets, performance objectives, and development plans for team members. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching and feedback. Develop succession plans for critical positions and strengthen organizational capabilities. Attract, retain, and develop top talent while fostering an inclusive and high-performance culture. 7. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Ensure full compliance with BASF Code of Conduct, EHS standards, trade compliance requirements, product stewardship requirements, and local regulations. Oversee import/export activities and commercial transactions in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. Ensure compliance with chemical-specific regulations across all countries within the ASEANA region. Implement preventive measures to achieve zero non-compliance incidents and safeguard BASF's reputation. Promote a strong culture of safety, ethics, and operational excellence. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. 10+ years of sales and commercial leadership experience in Home Care, specialty chemicals, ingredients, or related industries. Proven track record in driving profitable business growth, managing regional P&L, and delivering commercial results. Experience leading regional sales teams and managing business operations across multiple ASEAN countries. Strong expertise in strategic account management, business development, and complex customer negotiations. Solid understanding of pricing strategy, profitability management, and market expansion. Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Technical, Supply Chain, and Operations. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to develop high-performing teams. Fluent English communication skills are required; proficiency in additional ASEAN languages is an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently across ASEAN and ANZ markets. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

This position provides technical support and process definition needed to execute in shift activities. This position plays an important role in driving standardization across shifts, optimizes fixed and variable unit costs, improve quality, and works closely with other support groups to ensure that proper priorities are placed on items of backlog. This role will be responsible for the coordination, communication, accountability and expectation of day to day operations while working with the production team to ensure consistency in process and procedure. Ensure and engage in consistent communication, shift turnover, proactive action, mindset, and behavior are occurring over each shift. (rationalize the production plan to make sure that it is aligned with all business needs) Review and validate production data and production reports as needed to support the production accounting process. (Tech.) / B.Sc. / M.Sc./ Diploma in Chemical Engineering Working Experience: Experience in a manufacturing environment, is preferred. jobs.name: E&I Planner/Supervisor
jobs.description: Now hiring! E&I Planner/Supervisor Savannah, GA We are looking for an E&I Planner and Supervisor to join our Performance Chemicals team in Savannah, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As an E&I Planner/Supervisor, you will lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of electrical and instrumentation maintenance while collaborating with E&I technicians, Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, EHS, contractors, and vendors. Your leadership will strengthen workplace and process safety, equipment reliability, schedule performance, and production continuity across the Savannah site. As a E&I Planner/Supervisor, you create chemistry by... Leading the safe planning, scheduling, and execution of electrical and instrumentation maintenance to improve equipment reliability and production availability. Supervising and developing electrical and instrumentation team members by assigning work, setting priorities, providing technical guidance, and coordinating training. Creating detailed job plans that identify required labor, materials, tools, permits, equipment access, and safety precautions. Managing maintenance backlogs and coordinating weekly schedules, shutdowns, and equipment outages with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Reliability, and Environmental, Health and Safety teams. Providing technical oversight for troubleshooting, calibration, installation, maintenance, and commissioning of electrical, instrumentation, and control systems. Coordinating contractors, vendors, materials, and small improvement projects to ensure work is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with site requirements. If you... Hold an associate’s degree or relevant technical degree and have at least five years of industrial electrical and instrumentation experience, preferably in chemical manufacturing or a similarly regulated environment. Preferably hold a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, instrumentation, engineering technology, maintenance, or a related field with the same amount of experience. Bring at least three years of experience in electrical and instrumentation planning, coordination, team leadership, or supervision. Bring a safety-first mindset and experience in MOC (management of change) process. Have strong technical knowledge of instrumentation, calibration, control loops, valves, motors, variable frequency drives, motor control centers, switchgear, electrical distribution, technical drawings, and control-system interfaces. Are experienced in developing maintenance job plans and managing preventive maintenance programs, work orders, equipment records, and backlogs within SAP or another computerized maintenance management system. Demonstrate strong leadership, communication, planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate employees, contractors, vendors, and cross-functional teams. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Chemical Operator
jobs.description: Now hiring! Chemical Operator Mauldin, SC (On-site) Starting pay: $26.00 hourly (overtime pay eligibility) We are looking for Chemical Operators to join our Care Chemicals (EM) team in Mauldin, SC. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. As a Chemical Operator, you will assist higher-level operators in all phases of production work. This position is part of a job family with multiple levels and will be filled at a level that is commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and experience. During your 12-hour shift as a Chemical Operator, you will… Batch manufacture, including weighing and charging raw materials, handling acids and caustics. Operate the DCS control system. Unload raw materials from tankers, railcars, and ISO containers to vessels and tanks. Transfer products from vessels to storage tanks, tanks, etc. Operate a fork truck to transfer material and perform housekeeping items. Type of work involves complex chemical reactions and operations with various types of equipment located on many levels, which requires a high degree of concentration during various phases of the operation. Operating procedures vary batch-to-batch and product-to-product and must be carefully followed to produce on spec material. If you… Hold a high school diploma/GED or equivalent. Associate's degree from a recognized technical/community college is a plus. Have a minimum of 1 year of experience in a manufacturing environment. Have previous chemical experience (strongly preferred). Are able and willing to wear a respirator. jobs.name: R&D Operations Country Manager
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Agriculture is all about balance. The balance that is crucial to everyone’s existence – also for our Agricultural Solutions division. We connect innovative thinking with practical action to find the right balance for success – for farmers, agriculture and future generations. With seeds and traits, crop protection and digital solutions, we help farmers produce food more efficiently, protect the land and meet the needs of society. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Lead the planning and execution of field trials across Italy, ensuring delivery within the allocated budget and agreed timelines. Ensure field trial results are validated and accurately reported within established deadlines. Oversee R&D testing facilities and their official certifications, ensuring compliance with Good Experimental Practice (GEP) and applicable national regulations. Drive continuous improvement in field R&D Operations by optimizing technical and digital tools and supporting the ongoing training and development of the field biologist team. Act as the key contact for national authorities on R&D activities and facilities, including GEP and Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) matters. WHAT YOU OFFER A university degree in agriculture, natural sciences, or a related field. Several years of experience in crop protection, preferably in product research and development. Solid knowledge of the technical and regulatory requirements for developing crop protection products. Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams. A proven track record of working in international and multicultural environments. Good working knowledge of MS Office applications and project management tools. Excellent knowledge of English, fluency in Italian, both written and spoken. WHAT WE OFFER Employment under the Italian Chemical Industry National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), with A1 classification. An indicative gross annual salary of €80,000–€90,000, depending on your skills and relevant experience. Performance-based variable bonus. Company participation bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: Now hiring! Seed Science Operations Agronomist Saskatoon, SK (Onsite) We are looking for an Agronomist to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Saskatoon, SK. Located in Saskatoon, SK this role is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and evaluating field trials for the purpose of delivering high quality data, in support of product advancement. This role will mainly be focused on canola trait efficacy, chemistry, and yield trialing within the central Saskatchewan region . In addition, this team member will ensure high standards of compliance are upheld through collaborations with regulatory, stewardship, quality, and safety teams within the organization. As an Seed Science Operations Agronomist, you create chemistry by... Executing field trial protocols to support Breeding and Trait Development programmes. Establishing, maintaining, and evaluating canola field trials to generate high-quality data for product advancement. Conducting trait efficacy, chemistry, and yield trialing activities across the central Saskatchewan region . Collecting and analysing field performance data to support research and development objectives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of field trial programmes. Upholding regulatory, stewardship, quality, and safety standards across all trialing activities. Supporting the advancement of crop innovation through accurate data generation and effective trial management. If you have... Hold a Master’s degree in Biological Sciences, Agronomy, Plant Pathology, Weed Science, or a related field; a Bachelor’s degree plus 2 years of relevant experience; or a High School Diploma/GED plus 6 years of relevant experience. Have experience coordinating and conducting small-plot research trials. Previous experience with canola, preferred. Are proficient in operating agricultural research equipment and data collection tools such as: tractors, planters, sprayers, drones (UAS), and/or combine harvesters. Have experience using trial management and data collection software. Demonstrate knowledge of regulated and stewarded crop trial management. Possess strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively, including supervising contract employees when needed. Now hiring! Technical Service Specialist – Wisconsin Located in the state of WI or close (Remote) We are looking for a Technical Service Specialist to join our Sales team in WI. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it- this is your place. As a Technical Service Specialist (TSS) you will have responsibility that leads and coordinates all technical, purchasing, inventory, reporting activities, manage assigned projects, and respond to customer needs and complaints for our customer accounts within your territory. This position offers an incentive bonus plan, company car, laptop, phone, and all travel expenses covered by the company; travel for this role is 50-75% daily travel within your territory with occasional overnight travel. As a Technical Service Specialist, you will... Providing technical support and service to key customers at their facility. Fostering a Safety mindset acting as a safety ambassador for your customers. Completing all required Surventis compliance trainings, complete and pass all required technical training utilizing the Surventis/ Chemetall CL3 platform, in person live training and adjacent technical seminars. Training of plant personnel, line audits, startup of new processes, troubleshooting problems, continuous improvement, coordination of test work being done for the plant and participating in plant functions, such as system clean outs, team audit meetings, process analysis, and inventory management where necessary. Planning service visits with the purpose of bringing value to the customer. The goal is to develop and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders. Communicating with a written service report utilizing clear purpose driven comments of action items and findings. Loading service reports Salesforce and notifying all key stakeholders. Participating in business reviews to continually reinforce our value proposition while keeping our customers out of the zone of indifference. Setting up each account with the proper process instructions for the chemical process supplied by Surventis/ Chemetall. Educating customers on proper handling of chemicals, reagents, and sample submission procedures. Assisting & facilitating the installation, troubleshooting and training of proper use of process equipment provided by Surventis / Chemetall to the account. Looking for opportunities to add business whenever possible, to be done in concert with the Technical Sales Representative (our best leads come from our customers). If you have... Inventory management/control and product ordering. Relationship management experience, building and strengthening relationships with customer's technical department. jobs.name: New Business Development Manager - Industrial Specialties Market
jobs.description: Now hiring! New Business Development Manager - Industrial Specialties Market Remote - US We are looking for a New Business Development Manager - Industrial Specialties Market to join our Industrial Formulators team in Care Chemicals in the US. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development sites. Industrial formulators deliver value by servicing high-value life-science and industrial specialty segments with high-performance ingredients used across diverse industrial applications.  We elevate everyday outcomes through superior chemistry, that boosts application and process performance, supplying surfactants, chelates, and polymers to industrial customers and end-use markets including agrochemical; CASE raw materials (emulsion/polymer manufacturing, additive manufacturing, pigment dispersions); pulp and paper; water treatment; rubber/plastic; textile & leather; health, and contract/chemical processing manufacturing. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. jobs.description: Now hiring! Supply Chain Planner Geismar LA On Site We are looking for a Supply Chain Planner to join our Performance Materials team in Geismar, LA. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction. These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness, and lightweight applications. The Supply Chain Planner, Polyurethanes (PU) reports to the Supply Chain Manager for Polyurethanes (PU).   As a member of the Polyurethane Systems Supply Chain Team, you will be primarily responsible for raw material planning at the Geismar LA facility.  This will include planning of internal and external raw materials and packaging, imports, and management of supply/demand balance. As a Supply Chain Planner, you create chemistry by... Leveraging your educational and professional background in Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, Operations, or a related field, to manage inventory levels to support targets and achieve desired customer service levels. Providing your familiarity with material planning processes, including Material Requirements Planning (MRP),  as you order raw materials and packaging to meet the production plan. Coordinating and reconciling monthly cycle counts. Preparing all documentation for outbound shipments including exports. Contributing to supply chain KPIs including inventory targets, cost savings initiatives, reduction of dysfunctional inventory. If you have... BA or BS degree in Supply Chain management, Business Management or related field preferred with a minimum 2 years of experience in Supply Chain, Customer Care, production planning, production scheduling, material planning, or related field is required. (Non-degreed candidates would be expected to have 6-10 years of related experience in Customer Care, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations or Production). Detailed working knowledge of SAP relative to production planning, raw material replenishment, material master maintenance, shipping scheduling, and inventory reconciliation. Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint. Proven ability to work in a team environment to collaborate for achievement. Outstanding communications, written and verbal communication skills, conflict resolution and negotiation skills. Ensure laboratory capability and continuous improvement through management of analytical methods, equipment, calibration, data integrity, workflows, and testing performance. Manage the Quality Laboratory fixed-cost budget, capital expenditure roadmap, and resource planning while identifying and delivering on cost savings and productivity initiatives. Quality Performance, Risk Management & Improvement Establish, communicate, and drive Quality and laboratory objectives, KPIs, risks, and improvement priorities aligned with site and regional strategies. Analyze Quality, laboratory, process, and customer data to identify trends, systemic risks, capability gaps, and improvement opportunities. Identify relationships among internal deviations, analytical results, customer complaints, and product performance to recognize recurring or systemic risks and prevent recurrence. In conjunction with Operations, Technical, Supply Chain, Product Management, Sales, and Regional Quality teams. jobs.name: Global Category Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. About the Role The Global Category Manager for Merchandise Goods owns the global category strategy and value-delivery agenda while being based in Asia. The role defines category direction, leads strategic supplier relationships, governs complex negotiations, establishes portfolio and sourcing standards, and ensures a competitive, resilient, and sustainable supplier base across regions. The GCM is accountable for translating business priorities into a multi-year category roadmap and for aligning execution through Global Category Buyers, General Buyers, Procurement Technical Managers, Procurement Operations, Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial teams, Finance, and other business stakeholders. Role boundary . This is a Global Category Manager role, not a General Buyer or operational purchasing role. The GCM owns category strategy, global supplier governance, negotiation direction, and value delivery. Regional and local execution is assigned through the integrated category team and relevant procurement operations. How You Will Do It Global Category Strategy Ownership Develop, maintain, and periodically refresh the global Merchandise Goods category strategy and multi-year roadmap. Define category objectives, sourcing models, supplier architecture, regional execution priorities, value levers, risks, and implementation milestones. Integrate business requirements, market intelligence, supplier capabilities, demand patterns, product economics, and regional insights into category decisions. Provide clear direction, priorities, targets, and decision principles to Global Category Buyers and other execution teams. Spend, Demand, and Portfolio Governance Establish a reliable global fact base by supplier, product family, SKU, country, region, channel, and business. Lead demand and portfolio governance, including assortment rationalization, specification simplification, SKU reduction, approved product lists, and prevention of uncontrolled product proliferation. Define governance for delegated spend, local sourcing, supplier onboarding, material creation, catalogs, approvals, and exceptions. Partner with Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain to balance customer requirements, commercial value, complexity, and sourcing feasibility. Strategic Supplier and Market Management Define supplier segmentation and the target supplier panel for the category. Build and manage executive relationships with strategic suppliers, distributors, and private-label partners. Establish supplier power maps, development plans, performance routines, and clearly defined improvement milestones. Monitor supplier competitiveness, financial health, innovation capability, capacity, service, quality, sustainability, and supply risk. Develop global and regional market intelligence covering cost drivers, industry trends, alternative suppliers, emerging technologies, and channel developments. Negotiation Governance and Leadership Define the annual negotiation agenda, targets, governance, team composition, and escalation approach for strategic and complex negotiations. Lead or personally participate in major global negotiations and support GCBs in regional negotiations. Ensure negotiation strategies use robust fact bases, demand bundling, cost models, competitive alternatives, and appropriate commercial tactics. Govern sourcing recommendations and supplier awards within delegated authority, ensuring consistency with the category strategy. Promote negotiation excellence through preparation standards, Negotiation Board governance, coaching, lessons learned, and best-practice sharing. Private-Label, White-Label, and Alternative Sourcing Define the global strategy for private-label and white-label products, including portfolio priorities and supplier-selection criteria. Identify best-cost-country and alternative-sourcing opportunities while considering quality, lead time, supply-chain reliability, regulatory requirements, and implementation feasibility. Coordinate with Product Management and technical stakeholders on product specifications, qualification pathways, branding, packaging, and commercialization requirements. Drive scalable sourcing models that reduce fragmentation and improve margins, competitiveness, and supply resilience. Value Creation and Financial Performance Own the category value-creation pipeline and deliver validated savings, cost avoidance, cash, working-capital, margin, and process-efficiency contributions. Prioritize initiatives across supplier consolidation, demand bundling, assortment optimization, specification harmonization, best-cost sourcing, private-label expansion, and commercial-term improvement. Validate financial benefits with Finance or Controlling and maintain transparent implementation and benefit tracking. Communicate category developments, forecasts, opportunities, risks, and business implications to procurement and business leadership. Risk Management, Continuity, Sustainability, and Compliance Maintain a global risk view covering supplier concentration, capacity, geography, logistics, quality, continuity, compliance, and market exposure. Define mitigation plans, alternative sources, contingency arrangements, and escalation protocols for critical products and suppliers. Ensure category strategies and supplier decisions comply with procurement policies, approval requirements, contractual standards, legal obligations, sustainability expectations, and applicable product requirements. Drive supplier and product opportunities supporting responsible sourcing, reduced waste, improved packaging, lower environmental impact, and circular solutions where commercially and technically viable. Functional Leadership and Cross-Regional Execution Provide functional direction to GCBs and other assigned category resources without creating an additional disciplinary reporting line. Translate the global strategy into clear regional mandates, objectives, negotiation targets, work packages, and implementation priorities. Coach category-team members in strategy, supplier management, negotiation, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery. Establish a regular category operating rhythm covering strategy reviews, supplier reviews, initiative tracking, risk management, and decisions. Resolve cross-regional conflicts, facilitate decisions, and ensure continuity during handovers or organizational changes. Stakeholder and Business Partnership Act as the global procurement counterpart for business and functional leaders on Merchandise Goods. Partner with Product Management, Commercial teams, Supply Chain, Procurement Operations, Finance, Quality, Legal, Sustainability, and technical stakeholders. Align category decisions with business strategy, customer needs, margin objectives, product portfolio priorities, and operational requirements. Present fact-based recommendations to leadership and secure timely decisions, resources, and sponsorship for implementation. What We Look For Degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry, Materials, or a related discipline; an advanced qualification is advantageous. Substantial experience in procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, supplier relationship management, and complex commercial negotiations. Demonstrated experience developing category strategies and leading execution in a global or multi-regional matrix environment. Experience with merchandise goods, consumables, equipment, distribution, private-label products, or similarly fragmented portfolios is advantageous. Strong analytical capability and demonstrated ability to translate spend, market, margin, and supplier data into strategic decisions and implemented results. Working knowledge of procurement governance, contracting, supplier risk, sustainability, SAP processes, Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant analytics or reporting tools. Excellent written and spoken English; additional Asian or regional languages are an advantage. Strategic thinking and the ability to convert business priorities into category direction and executable plans. Commercial judgment, negotiation leadership, and executive supplier engagement. Functional leadership, coaching, influence without authority, and cross-cultural collaboration. Analytical problem-solving, decision quality, and disciplined prioritization. Change leadership, resilience, conflict resolution, and effective escalation. Integrity, transparency, accountability, and consistent role-model behavior. What We Offer A global category leadership role based in Asia, with direct exposure to business leadership, strategic suppliers, regional procurement teams, and transformation initiatives. The opportunity to shape an evolving merchandise category and establish scalable global governance, sourcing, supplier, and portfolio-management practices. A collaborative international environment focused on strategy, negotiation excellence, professional growth, and measurable business value. Continuous development through global procurement communities, market analytics, supplier innovation, category strategy, and digitalization. jobs.description: Now hiring! Reliability Engineer Savannah, GA Rrelocation assistance We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our Performance Chemicals team in Savannah, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As a Reliability Engineer, you will lead site reliability initiatives and manage a multi-year reliability roadmap focused on improving equipment availability, asset effectiveness, safety, and lifecycle costs. You will use industry reliability methodologies, including Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Risk-Based Inspection (RBI), Root Cause Analysis and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCA/RCFA), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Bad Actor Analysis, preventive and predictive maintenance, and condition monitoring, across rotating and static equipment. You will also provide technical expertise related to hazard assessments, materials of construction, chemical compatibility, and equipment design. Working closely with Operations, Management, Capital, Stores, Procurement, contractors, and expert services teams, you will help achieve reliability Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a Reliability Engineer, you create chemistry by... Leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) investigations for complex and recurring equipment failures, utilizing Cause and Effect Mapping, Fishbone Analysis, 5 Whys, Failure Mode Analysis, and corrective action development to identify root causes, eliminate recurring failures, and verify the effective implementation of solutions. Developing and improving asset reliability and Mechanical Integrity programs, including Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Risk-Based Inspection (RBI), corrosion management, structural integrity, pressure relief device compliance, piping integrity, and flexible hose programs to ensure the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of plant assets. Analyzing SAP/Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) data, work order history, failure modes, equipment defects, and asset performance indicators to identify reliability risks, bad actors, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities, while developing and communicating reliability metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and recommendations to leadership and site stakeholders. Developing critical equipment, spare parts, and equipment care strategies aligned with business objectives and operational, safety, and environmental risks. Leading predictive and precision maintenance programs, including vibration analysis, ultrasound, thermography, lubrication, alignment, balancing, and defect elimination. Driving precision maintenance best practices, including alignment, balancing, contamination control, proper installation, bearing practices, torque management, and pipe strain elimination. Developing equipment standards, repair procedures, work instructions, job plans, and technical requirements to support routine Management of Change (MOC), maintenance activities, turnarounds, and capital projects. If you... Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Bring at least 5 years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, Mechanical Integrity, or asset reliability within an industrial manufacturing environment. Demonstrate experience leading Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) investigations using Cause and Effect Mapping or similar root cause analysis methodologies. Possess working knowledge of Mechanical Integrity programs, including Risk-Based Inspection (RBI), fixed equipment reliability, corrosion management, and regulatory compliance. Offer experience developing reliability strategies using Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), condition monitoring, and precision maintenance best practices. Bring knowledge of rotating equipment design and operation, including pumps, compressors, motors, gearboxes, and associated systems. Demonstrate experience using SAP Plant Maintenance (SAP PM), Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), and reliability analytics to identify opportunities and improve equipment performance. Possess the following certifications, or be willing to obtain at least one of them: Machinery Lubrication Engineer/Technician certifications (MLA I and/or MLT I), Vibration Analysis Category II, Ultrasound Level I, Infrared Thermography Level I, API 570 Piping Inspector or API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspector. jobs.description: Now hiring! Maintenance Planner Savannah, GA We are looking for a Maintenance Planner to join our Performance Chemicals team in Savannah, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As a Maintenance Planner, you will plan, schedule, estimate, and coordinate routine, corrective, preventive, construction, and outage maintenance so work is safe, executable, cost-effective, and aligned with production needs. Create and maintain SAP job plans, work orders, and BOM updates; generates purchase requisitions; coordinates planned maintenance with Maintenance Supervision and Operations. You will manage the maintenance work-order planning, scheduling, materials and services, SAP/CMMS information, contractor coordination, equipment master data, and continuous improvement to reduce downtime and improve reliability. As a Maintenance Planner, you create chemistry by... Developing detailed SAP job plans and field-execution packages, including scope, work sequence, labor crafts, estimated hours, materials, equipment, special tools, services, permits, isolations, and safety requirements. Reviewing and prioritizing maintenance backlogs and unplanned work, coordinating maintenance and production schedules, grouping related work, managing SAP status codes and planned start and finish dates, and optimizing crew utilization and customer service. Conducting job walk-downs with Maintenance, Operations, and Engineering to validate work scope, identify constraints, confirm parts and support requirements, and facilitate material pre-kitting. Maintaining work orders, work history, actual costs, completed work documentation, job-plan libraries, equipment Bills of Materials (BOMs), asset records, and lessons learned, while improving job plans based on execution feedback. Coordinating vendor and contractor activities by defining scopes of work, obtaining quotations, managing schedules, and supporting compliance with approved procurement, safety, and quality requirements. Planning major turnarounds in partnership with Production and Maintenance leadership, including developing schedules, manpower plans, resource assignments, and parts-kitting requirements, while responding to schedule breakers, shutdowns, start-ups, and other non-routine work. Leading and supporting planning reviews with Maintenance Supervision, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS), Logistics, Quality, contractors, and vendors to align priorities and resolve execution issues. Incorporating Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) policies, Responsible Care expectations, safe-work permits, isolations, pre-task risk assessments, craft qualifications, and site Management of Change (MOC) requirements into maintenance planning activities. If you... jobs.name: Asset and Product Manager
jobs.description: Now hiring! Asset and Product Manager Florham Park, NJ (Hybrid) We are looking for an Asset and Product Manager to join our Care Chemicals team in Florham Park, NJ. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development sites. As the Asset and Product Manager, you will have responsibility for the profitability, growth, and strategic direction of BASF’s APG (alkyl polyglucoside) portfolio for North America. You will connect market and customer needs with pricing, supply, operations, and long-term asset strategy across regional production and BASF’s global supply network. As an Asset and Product Manager, you create chemistry by… Owning portfolio performance: Drive sustainable, profitable growth for the APG portfolio through disciplined management of price, volume, product mix, cost, margin, and customer opportunities. Developing product and asset strategy: Develop, communicate, and execute product and asset strategies, including portfolio positioning, capacity requirements, asset utilization, supply-network options, technology, scale, and cost competitiveness. Leading pricing and margin management: Establish pricing strategies with business management; support customer bids; strengthen pricing-process discipline; evaluate raw-material and other cost movements; and recommend timely corrective actions. Turning market intelligence into action: Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, supply-demand dynamics, market pricing, raw-material developments, and technology changes using internal and external sources. Managing business planning and KPIs: Support forecasting, scenario analysis, and portfolio-performance reviews. Track margin, volume, mix, asset utilization, forecast quality, and progress against strategic growth priorities. Building strong stakeholder alignment: Collaborate closely with Care Chemicals sales, marketing, finance, operations, production, supply chain, other product managers, global network partners, and BASF platform groups. If you… Hold a bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Business, Marketing, Sales, or another relevant technical or commercial discipline. Preferably have over 5 years of commercial experience in product management, marketing, sales, finance, or a related commercial role. Demonstrate strong financial and analytical capability, including pricing, margin, cost, and scenario analysis. Can translate market, customer, financial, and operational information into clear recommendations, priorities, and executable plans. Have experience collaborating across commercial, supply-chain, operational, manufacturing, and financial teams. Exhibit excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive pay range for this role is $129,600 – $162,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Sales, Engineering Plastics
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced sales professional to drive sustainable and profitable growth for our Engineering Plastics business in Taiwan. In this role, you will develop strategic customer accounts, expand opportunities in the Consumer Electronics and Medical segments, manage distributor partnerships, and work closely with local and regional teams to deliver value-added solutions. This is an individual contributor role with opportunities to demonstrate leadership and take on broader responsibilities as the business evolves. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Develop and execute strategic account plans for key customers to achieve sales, profitability, growth, and market-share objectives. Build strong relationships across customer organizations and the value chain, understand customer needs, and create new business opportunities through value-added solutions. Manage distributor partnerships through joint business planning, performance reviews, opportunity pipeline development, and channel strategies. Own the commercial pipeline, including opportunity development, project prioritization, sales forecasting, annual planning, CRM management, and performance tracking. Lead the review, negotiation, and execution of commercial agreements with customers and distributors, balancing growth, profitability, compliance, and risk. Drive pricing and profitability through value-based selling, strategic pricing initiatives, and optimization of the product portfolio. Strengthen customer engagement through regular business reviews, seminars, technical workshops, and timely support on technical, quality, application, and commercial topics. Monitor market trends, customer demand, competitive activity, and industry developments to identify opportunities and manage risks. Collaborate with local and regional cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions and support successful project commercialization. Partner with credit control to review customer credit needs, make appropriate recommendations, and support timely payment collection. Ensure business activities comply with applicable policies, quality standards, competition law, and audit requirements. T e c hn i c a l & Professional Knowledge Bachelor's degree in a related field, preferably Engineering or Materials Science. 5+ years of sales, business development, or key account management experience. Experience in engineering plastics or related materials preferred. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and customer management skills. Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

Support internal and external audit requests and remediation efforts where necessary. Ensure adherence to local GAAP and all relevant regulatory requirements. jobs.name: Asistente Administrativo/a
jobs.description: Negocio La innovación aplicada al desarrollo de Soluciones para la Agricultura es parte de nuestro ADN. Con un completo portafolio de soluciones inteligentes y productos de alto valor como semillas, productos químicos y biológicos para la protección de cultivos, higiene ambiental y agricultura digital. Acompañamos al productor agropecuario para potenciar el éxito de cada una de sus campañas agrícolas. Todo esto combinando rentabilidad con sustentabilidad y responsabilidad social para contribuir a un futuro mejor. Área El Área de Asistencia Administrativa desempeña un papel estratégico dentro de nuestra organización. Su principal responsabilidad es brindar soporte integral a los ejecutivos de BASF, actuando como un facilitador clave en la interacción con stakeholders internos y externos. Esta área se caracteriza por su alto nivel de compromiso, confidencialidad y profesionalismo, siendo un socio confiable en la gestión de temas que pueden tener un impacto significativo en la compañía. Esta área contribuye activamente al desarrollo organizacional, fortaleciendo la eficiencia, la comunicación y la toma de decisiones en todos los niveles. Candidato/a En esta posición será responsable de brindar soporte integral al Vicepresidente de LATAM West y ejecutivos de BASF, asegurando una gestión eficiente de las actividades ejecutivas, administrativas y de proyectos estratégicos. Entre sus principales responsabilidades se encuentran la administración de la agenda ejecutiva, la coordinación de reuniones, viajes, vistas y eventos regionales, así como el apoyo en la preparación de presentaciones, reportes y comunicaciones para la dirección. Además, será responsable de la gestión y seguimiento de órdenes de compra, proveedores, contratos, facturas y procesos de pago, garantizando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos internos y una operación eficiente. Finalmente, liderará la coordinación y el seguimiento de proyectos e iniciativas especiales de la región, facilitando la colaboración entre equipos, monitoreando hitos y entregables, y asegurando el cumplimiento de los plazos y objetivos establecidos. Esta función contribuye directamente a la efectividad de la organización, la optimización de recursos y la ejecución exitosa de las prioridades estratégicas de LATAM West. Para desempeñar esta función, se requiere formación universitaria completa en Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería o carreras afines, así como un nivel avanzado de idioma inglés. Además, es necesario contar con al menos 5 años de experiencia en posiciones similares de soporte o asistencia administrativa. Se valorará especialmente el manejo de herramientas digitales, en particular Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint y Outlook) y SAP. Buscamos personas con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento, capacidad de organización y planificación y una actitud proactiva, competencias fundamentales para desarrollarse con éxito en esta posición. Nuestra química valora el talento y la diversidad de género, edad, raza, color, nacionalidad, creencias, orientación sexual, identidad y expresión de género, discapacidad y todas las demás características, diferencias y semejanzas que son parte de la diversidad humana . ¡Te invitamos a postularte a nuestras vacantes! #BASF_YoRecomiendo

Strong ownership of operational deliverables while working within a review and escalation framework. Effective coordination with BPO providers, auditors, advisors and regional teams. Comfortable working in a lean, changing and transformation-oriented environment. jobs.name: France Financial Controlling Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As the Financial Controlling Manager for France, you will manage the financial performances and support teams in monitoring their results and achieving their objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Analysing business profitability, financial results, and margins; Defining and monitoring budgets, forecasts, and financial controlling processes; Analysing variances between forecasts and actual results, and proposing corrective actions; Designing and monitoring dashboards and decision-support tools; Assessing and monitoring financial risks and commitments; Supporting and advising teams through your expertise. You will also manage a team of two employees, supporting their development as well as their administrative and operational management. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a Master’s degree, ideally in finance, controlling, accounting, or a related field, and have at least 7 years of experience in a similar role; You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, both written and spoken; You demonstrate strong analytical and decision-making skills, together with an excellent sense of responsibility and organisation; Your ability to work collaboratively and support a range of stakeholders enables you to contribute effectively to performance management and financial decision-making. WHAT WE OFFER A stimulating and exciting opportunity within a committed and highly skilled team; An environment that encourages innovation, idea-sharing, and well-being; An international environment where you can develop your full potential. ABOUT US SURVENTIS Services SAS specialises in the marketing and distribution of eco-efficient paint systems for automotive body repair professionals. Thanks to the reputation of the century-old premium brands R-M and Glasurit, approved by the leading players in the automotive industry, as well as our innovative products and services, we are the leading automotive paint distributor in France. The company operates throughout the country through several warehouses, with its head office located in Compans, Seine-et-Marne (77). Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.description: What You Can Expect? A comprehensive exposure to customs operations within the supply chain, specifically for the chemistry industry. Study foundational customs knowledge and terminology relevant to international Trade Perform data analysis for customs broker audit Project using digital skills. Coordinate various activities for AEO project for BASF legal entity in ASEANA region. Explore the effects of duties and taxes on international business transactions in the chemistry sector based on Free trade agreement. Gain knowledge about trade facilities, such as free trade agreements, Authorised Economic Operator (AEO), duty drawbacks etc. that benefit global commerce. Participate in improvement initiatives discussion to work on improvement plans and timelines like Power BI dashboard, audit workflow etc. Actively participate in Projects to apply gained knowledge and reinforce learning. Support specification harmonization across North American manufacturing locations, subject to validated product, safety, transportation, equipment, customer, and regulatory requirements. Monitor steel and tinplate market developments, supplier capacity, lead times, and key cost drivers. Coordinate technical qualification of alternatives covering dimensions, lids, closures, linings, printing, pallet patterns, slip sheets, filling-line compatibility, handling, transport, and storage. They help teams measure operational performance, identify gaps & risks, evaluate root causes, prioritize corrective actions, track improvement effectiveness, alternative pathways and make consistent data-driven decisions across the global supply chain network. (25%) Operational Engagement & Performance Reviews •    Lead the performance contribution to regional operational and service reviews, facilitating fact-based discussions and clear decisions. •    Develop a strong understanding of regional operating models, priorities and constraints. •    Analyse digital performance signals, trends and recurring issues, and connect performance findings to operational realities. •    Build credibility as a trusted partner and key contact for assigned Performance Solutions. (20%) Root-Cause Evaluation & Corrective Actions •    Facilitate structured root-cause discussions with stakeholders. •    Drive development of practical corrective and preventive action plans with clear ownership and milestones. •    Lead action tracking to completion, validate outcomes and escalate risks or delays when required. (20%) Continuous Improvement & Best Practices •    Lead identification of opportunities to improve service, reliability, efficiency and operational effectiveness. •    Challenge existing practices constructively and recommend improvements. •    Capture successful regional practices and lessons learned and promote their adoption across the global network. •    Drive harmonization of performance management approaches across regions. (10%) Stakeholder Management & SCNC Collaboration •    Provide objective, fact-based recommendations and challenge stakeholders constructively to support leadership decisions. •    Influence stakeholders without authority to drive action and accountability. •    Lead collaboration with other ODS Senior Executives, support peer reviews and contribute operational knowledge to new Performance Solutions. Practical experience participating in operational reviews, KPI reporting, performance management, root-cause evaluation and corrective-action follow-up. Strong knowledge of supply chain operations and operational excellence, transportation and logistics, performance management, continuous improvement and process analysis. Working knowledge of SAP and Power BI, with exposure to digital supply chain, analytics and automation tools. Basic-to-intermediate SQL capability. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In the Performance Materials Division, we develop innovative plastics and foams for all kinds of applications. Whether it is for cars, buildings or sports goods - we always look for the ideal material solution. To do this, we work closely with our customers: from production and logistics to research and sales, all the way to component testing, design consulting and simulation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our unit Global Information Management supports the Performance Materials division in all IT-relevant topics. This includes, in particular, the provision of tailor-made individual solutions. We are looking for you to join us as a working student for 20 hours per week. Working closely with your colleagues, you will support the design, development, testing, and implementation of AI-powered applications, such as copilot, intelligent agents, as well as digital solutions, using modern software and AI development methodologies. You will be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, machine learning, as well as automation initiatives and developing application features, AI workflows, integrations, and reusable components. You will also support the development of backend services, APIs, user interfaces, and enterprise integrations, using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, SQL, Azure AI Services, and modern web frameworks. Furthermore you will contribute to the development and evaluation of AI assistants, knowledge systems, MCP-enabled services, tool integrations, and business-specific AI applications. Through testing, debugging, validation, monitoring, and performance analysis, you will continuously help improve the quality and optimization of these solutions. As part of proofs of concept, hackathons, innovation projects, and technology evaluations, you will explore new AI frameworks, development approaches, as well as engineering practices. Last but not least, you will create technical documentation, implementation guides, support materials, presentations, and knowledge-transfer content, helping to ensure the sustainable operation and successful adoption of the AI solutions developed. WHAT YOU OFFER ongoing Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a comparable field initial practical experience in software or AI development and an interest in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Deep Learning, RAG, and LLM frameworks very good Python skills and knowledge of HTML, CSS, as well as JavaScript experience with FastAPI, SQL, Azure AI Services, or Angular is a plus very good written and spoken English skills strong problem-solving skills, a careful and analytical approach to work, and enthusiasm for teamwork, communication, and exploring new technologies WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase – actively applying theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Team buddy – contact person for all questions as well as regular feedback, personal and individual support, and training by our experts Networks – get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking, and fields of work Remuneration – Remuneration is in accordance with the collective agreement for the chemical industry. Flexible working hours – depending on the assignment unit, temporary full-time employment during the lecture-free period (semester break) is possible by arrangement. Como parte de la transición actual, todas las ofertas de empleo y el proceso de solicitud siguen alojados en la plataforma de BASF y, por tanto, se presentan íntegramente bajo la imagen corporativa de BASF. Por favor, no te confundas por ello: todas las vacantes corresponden a puestos en Surventis y tu candidatura será enviada directamente a nosotros. En Surventis, vamos más allá de la superficie en todo lo que hacemos. Ponemos a los clientes en el centro, nos anticipamos a las necesidades y desarrollamos soluciones que generan valor real y relaciones duraderas. Nos inspiramos mutuamente para ir más allá, asumir la responsabilidad de nuestro trabajo y nos esforzarnos continuamente por ampliar los límites de lo posible. Si aportas tu mejor versión, cuestionas las respuestas evidentes y quieres crecer junto a un equipo que realmente cree en ello, este es tu lugar. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR Entiende, interpreta y realiza anotaciones en las Órdenes de Fabricación (OF) y/o fichas, así como su seguimiento y control. Realiza la puesta en marcha y parada de equipos. Realiza la recepción de cargas y la adición de materiales al proceso (líquidos y/ o sólidos). Realiza las tareas de filtrado, envasado y toma de muestras. Realiza la carga y descarga de camiones cisterna. Opera con equipos e instalaciones del segmento / planta de forma segura. Controla el proceso de fabricación del producto. Registra las salidas de producto de la planta. Utiliza y realiza un correcto mantenimiento de EPIS (Equipos de Protección Individual). Cumplimenta los registros de calidad y controles internos del proceso de producción. Realiza tareas de limpieza y mantenimiento de la zona de trabajo LO QUE OFRECES Bachillerato, FP2 o Ciclo Formativo Grado Superior Química Industrial, Operador de Planta Química, Logística y Transporte y/o titulación académica equivalente. Our products are used in many downstream applications including the production of foams, adhesives, textiles, automobiles, food production, paper, packaging, wire, cable, clothing, and so much more. Monomers go into the production of countless household and industrial goods and make a positive impact on people's lives every day. You will also provide technical guidance to the I/E/A maintenance team. jobs.name: Technical Agronomist
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Do you want to contribute to better agricultural solutions by delivering reliable trial results and supporting a collaborative team? This role offers the chance to make a real impact on how we develop and refine our products. In this role you will be responsible for c ompleting an allocation of R&D agronomic trials according to protocol, GEP and EPPO requirements . You will collaborate closely with a local grower, on farm, to establish a trials base to store equipment and act as a centre of operation within your region. You will establish links with local farmers, grower bodies and agronomists within region to enable access to other suitable trial sites. You will promote high standards of Health & Safety within in your region.  You will ensure regional bases, facilities and processes comply with BASF EH&S requirements and you will implement ongoing improvements as required. You will provide supervision and day to day support of temporary Assistant Technical Agronomists. You will be responsible for specific activities to aid effective the running of the R&D Operations function: including Calibration, vehicle maintenance, fire alarm checks, undergraduate temporary recruitment. You will build strong relationships with the BASF Sales team to support market development activities in your region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in Agriculture, Biological Sciences, or equivalent, in addition to 3+ years of hands-on trials experience. NPTC Certificate of Competence in the use of Pesticides (PA1 and PA6). Strong organisation, planning, and communication skills. BASIS certification with ongoing CPD to maintain professional registration. Solid IT proficiency, including Microsoft Word and ARM trial management software. Please note: A valid UK driver’s licence is essential for this position. WHAT WE OFFER At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. We offer a total package which includes: Attractive salary Bonus Defined contribution pension scheme 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Company share scheme Private healthcare Life insurance On the job training and development opportunities Company Car We believe that diversity and inclusion make the difference. Only when people with diverse backgrounds come together, contribute their various experiences and attitudes, and look at challenges from different perspectives, will creative innovations and ground-breaking solutions be created. We celebrate diversity and we actively promote an inclusive work environment. In the UK we have an active Diversity & Inclusion Strategy Action Group and work closely with external partner Inclusive Employers. We are an equal opportunities employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard or reference to age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status and other protected characteristics. For more information please visit: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/careers/why-join-basf/basf-locally.html Location: Home-based (ideally located in Gloucestershire, Warwickshire or Northamptonshire) with frequent national travel. A company car will be provided. Closing Date: 08.11.2026 ABOUT US Since 1880, BASF has been a cornerstone of industry in the UK. With locations spanning from Littlehampton on England's South Coast to Callanish on the Isle of Lewis in Scotland, our presence is truly nationwide. Our UK headquarters in Stockport, Greater Manchester, is the hub for our dedicated sales and services teams. From our manufacturing sites across the UK, we supply essential raw materials to a diverse range of industries, including agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, energy, and pharmaceuticals. Troubleshooting plant processes and equipment, implementing corrective actions to minimize downtime, and supporting preventive-maintenance planning and equipment-readiness activities. Ensuring processing activities are completed safely and accurately in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures, stewardship requirements, production plans, quality standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
