Bring at least three years of experience in seed processing, agricultural manufacturing, warehouse operations or industrial production environments. Demonstrate experience operating and troubleshooting multiple plant processes and equipment systems. Apply advanced knowledge of seed conditioning, cleaning, treatment, packaging, warehousing, inventory management and logistics. Lead with demonstrated team-development, communication, organizational and problem-solving skills, and coordinate multiple operational prioriies effectively. Utilize inventory-management systems, SAP, Microsoft Office and plant operational-reporting systems to support accurate execution and documentation. jobs.name: Transport Management (Executive) 1 1
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. O bjectives of the Position: Responsible for ensuring transport management for inbound or outbound (as assigned) are as per stipulated guidelines, procedures and requirements Support process improvement, knowledge and risk management as per overseas delivery services M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities: Outbound Processing transports for packaged deliveries with a focus on sea freight to our customers in compliance with the required customer deadlines at cost-optimal conditions Managing the loading planning & consolidation/deconsolidation activities at the associated companies and external locations or sites, including monitoring of loading times. Legal, internal, safety-relevant and packaging-related regulations must be considered, and customer-specific service levels and other quality requirements must be met Monitoring of all necessary or relevant shipment milestones and ensuring prompt follow ups, updates and correspondences to all relevant stakeholders. Monitoring and assessing the quality of our service providers, transport reliability and feedback rates and tracking shipments & vessels Preparation of all necessary transport documents, control of the proper filing of documents, in particular freight accounting bases, and examination of additional costs incurred Inbound Processing transport for packaged deliveries with a focus on sea freight to our sites within EMEA Managing the loading planning & consolidation/deconsolidation activities at the associated companies and external locations or sites, including monitoring of loading times. Legal, internal, safety-relevant and packaging-related regulations must be considered, and site-specific service levels and other quality requirements must be met Monitoring of all necessary or relevant shipment milestones and ensuring prompt follow ups, updates and correspondences to all relevant stakeholders. Monitoring and assessing the quality of our service providers, transport reliability and feedback rates, and tracking shipments & vessels Preparation and monitoring of all necessary transport documents (e.g verifying draft documents), control of the proper filing of documents, in particular freight accounting bases, and examination of additional costs incurred Job Requirements: Edu c a t i o n: Fresh graduates from programs such as Transport Management, IT, Business Studies, or other relevant fields who are interested in exploring a career in supply chain. W o r k in g Experience: 1-2 years in logistics Career starters or first professional experience in transport management T e c hn i c al & Professional Knowledge: Experience in supply chain operations, distribution and warehousing processes Knowledge of the processes of filling and shipping units Experience in handling of MS Office products and, ideally, SAP R/3 quality management and transport management Structured, independent and process-oriented working width High degree of customer orientation High proficiency in spoken and written English The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com.

jobs.name: Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada
jobs.description: Now hiring! Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada Calgary, Alberta. (Hybrid) We are looking for a Head of HR to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Calgary, Alberta. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. We are seeking a strategic and business-focused Human Resources leader to serve as HR Head, Canada for our Agricultural Solutions business. Reporting operationally to the Global Head of Human Resources, Agricultural Solutions and administratively to the Head of Agricultural Solutions Canada, you will lead the people agenda for Canada while helping shape and advance the broader global HR strategy. As a member of both the Canadian Leadership Team and the Global Human Resources Leadership Team, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and act as a key link between global strategy and local execution. In this role, you will ensure Canadian business, workforce, and regulatory considerations are represented within a global organization while driving enterprise HR priorities across Canada. As a Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada, you create chemistry by... Leading the Human Resources strategy and agenda for BASF Agricultural Solutions Canada. Partnering with senior leaders to drive organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, and leadership development. Translating global HR strategies and priorities into effective solutions that support Canadian business objectives while balancing local needs and enterprise priorities. Representing Canadian business and workforce perspectives in global HR discussions and decision-making processes. Providing strategic counsel and coaching to leaders on organizational design, employee relations, culture, performance management, and change initiatives. Leading complex employee relations matters, organizational changes, and business transformation initiatives across Canada. Ensuring compliance with Canadian employment legislation, labor standards, human rights requirements, privacy regulations, and BASF policies. Delivering Human Resources programs and services through collaboration with global Centers of Expertise, shared service organizations, external providers, and business leaders. Fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture that supports employee engagement and business success. If you have... Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field. 12+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including at least 5 years in senior HR leadership roles. Broad Human Resources leadership experience across talent management, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee relations, change management, leadership development, and succession planning. Strong knowledge of Canadian employment legislation and Human Resources practices. Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, multinational organization. Proven success partnering with executive and senior leadership teams to drive business and talent outcomes. Experience working across multiple geographies, cultures, and stakeholder groups. Demonstrated success leading organizational change, transformation, integration, or restructuring initiatives. Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills. Preferred Qualifications Master's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Psychology, or a related field. Chartered Professional in Human Resources (CPHR) designation. Experience serving on both business leadership teams and HR leadership teams. Experience within agriculture, manufacturing, life sciences, chemical, industrial, or other complex operational environments Create your own chemistry with you@BASF Adding value to our customers begins with adding value to you. you@BASF is the suite of benefits, perks, programs and unique opportunities we offer to support you – the whole you – in all stages of your life and career. With you@BASF, you create your own chemistry. The total rewards that you receive as a BASF employee go way beyond a paycheck. From competitive health and insurance plans to robust retirement benefits that include company-matching contributions, to making sure you never stop learning, we believe investing in you is investing in our success. Working for a large, global organization, you’ll have a chance to grow professionally and personally, expand your network and build a rewarding and dynamic career.  We also provide engaging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your role. About us As the world’s leading chemical company, we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! We constantly strive to become an even better workplace. As a result of our commitment to our employees, BASF has earned various awards, including being recognized by Mediacorp in 2025 as one of Canada's Top Employers for eleventh consecutive year, one of the Greater Toronto Area's Top Employers for the twelfth year in a row, and twice being named one of Canada's Top Employers for Young People and Best Diversity Employers. We provide a fulfilling work environment with a strong emphasis on the physical and psychological safety of our employees and the communities we operate in. We are always working to form the best team with an emphasis on diversity, equity, and inclusion and through lifelong learning and development. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request personal or financial information of any kind via either text message or direct message on any social media platform or job board. jobs.name: Operatør med erfaring indenfor fødevare- eller pharmaproduktion
jobs.description: VELKOMMEN TIL BASF BASF A/S Ballerup har gennem årene ved konstant innovation udviklet en proces, som er helt unik. Vi er specialiserede i mikroindkapslede formuleringer af vitaminer og carotenoider. Vores produkter anvendes hovedsageligt til fødevare-, kosttilskud- og medicinalindustrien. Vi beskæftiger ca. 135 medarbejdere, men mangler operatører, for at få planen til at gå op. Derfor savner vi dig, din gode personlighed og kompetencer til at gøre en forskel sammen med nogle rigtig dygtige kollegaer. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Du vil indgå i et team, som har den primære opgave at sikre optimal produktion med processen af vitaminer. På sigt forventer BASF, at du kan bestride alle jobfunktioner i produktionen indenfor proces og pakning. - Som operatør inden for fremstilling af vitaminer har man ansvaret for spraytørringsanlægget samt de tilknyttede processer. Dette indebærer klargøring, betjening og overvågning af anlægget for at sikre en effektiv og sikker produktion. - Som operatør i pakkeafdelingen har man ansvaret for både de automatiske og manuelle pakkelinjer samt de processer, der foregår i forbindelse med disse. Dette inkluderer fremtagning, kontrol og afvejning af råvarer, opsugning og blanding samt styring af råvarelagret. Herudover indgår der i begge typer job: •    Skriftlig dokumentation og rapportering af produktionsforløb •    Prøveudtagning og proceskontrol •    Rengøring af anlæg, udstyr og lokaler Arbejdstiden planlægges typisk på skiftehold med et forskelligt antal vagter af enten 8, 12 eller 12,5 timer placeret over hele ugen (f.eks. kl. 6-14, kl. 06:00 – 18:30 og/eller 18:00 – 06:30). HVAD DU TILBYDER •    Du har en relevant uddannelse som procesoperatør, industrioperatør eller tilsvarende. Alternativt har du relevant erhvervserfaring, gerne fra levnedsmiddel- eller medicinalbranchen. •    Fleksibilitet, ordenssans, teknisk flair og hygiejneforståelse. •    Du har gode samarbejdsevner og frem for alt er du ansvarsbevidst. •    Gode kundskaber i skriftligt og mundtligt dansk. •    Du har kørekort til bil (type B). •    Kendskab til GMP og truckkort vil være en stor fordel. HVAD VI TILBYDER Ansvar fra første dag i et udfordrende arbejdsmiljø og med læring i jobbet som del af et engageret team.  En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke, der inkluderer sundhedsordning, sundhedstjek, fysioterapi, træningsrum, bruttolønsordning m.m. Herudover er BASF A/S Ballerup en røgfri arbejdsplads, med røgfri arbejdstid. SÅDAN SØGER OG KONTAKTER DU OS Du kan kontakte vores rekrutteringsteam her: https://www.basf.com/global/en/careers/contact . ANSØGNINGSFRIST Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rigtige kandidat. OM OS Hos BASF skaber vi kemi for en bæredygtig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk succes med miljøbeskyttelse og social ansvarlighed. De ca. 110.000 ansatte i BASF-koncernen arbejder for at bidrage til succes for vores kunder, som man finder i de fleste brancher og i næsten ethvert land over hele verden. Mangfoldighed er vores største styrke! Vi tror på, at succes skabes gennem diversitet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, oprindelse, seksuel orientering, religion eller funktionsnedsættelse til at søge stillingen.

jobs.name: Project Manager / Engineer, Plant Development
jobs.description: VELKOMMEN TIL BASF BASF i Sandefjord har ledig en spennende stilling for deg som ønsker å jobbe med teknologiutvikling! Vi søker Project Manager / Engineer til vår omega-3 fabrikk i Sandefjord. I denne stillingen vil du ha en sentral rolle i blant annet prosjektering og prosjektledelse hos oss. Produksjonsanlegget i Sandefjord spesialiserer seg på å lage aktive farmasøytiske ingredienser (API) og kosttilskudd av høykonsentrerte omega-3-fettsyrer. Rundt 130 personer er basert i Sandefjord og dekker også funksjoner som kvalitetsledelse, FoU, prosess- og anleggsutvikling, økonomi og HR. HVA DU KAN FORVENTE BASF i Sandefjord fokuserer på prosjekter tilknyttet kapasitetsøkning, fornybar energi og energigjenvinning, automatisering og utbytteøkning i produksjon. Som prosjektingeniør/prosjektleder vil du få ansvar for design og gjennomføring av multidisiplinære prosjekter. Arbeidsoppgavene dine vil blant annet være: Prosjektering og gjennomføring av større eller mindre endringsprosjekter i våre produksjonsanlegg Prosjektledelse i forbindelse med endringene Ha fagansvar for tekniske spesifikasjoner ved innkjøp av nytt utstyr/anlegg Være en pådriver for kontinuerlig forbedringer ved fabrikken Samarbeide tett med eksterne leverandører, entreprenører og interne driftsmiljø HVA DU TILBYR •    Bachelor eller mastergrad (mekanisk ingeniør eller prosessingeniør) •    Hvis du er nyutdannet, er vi også interessert i din søknad og ønsker deg velkommen til å søke •    Gjerne erfaring fra prosjektledelse (fortrinnsvis fra prosessindustri) •    Gjerne erfaring med design av prosessanlegg, enten innenfor mekanisk- eller prosessdisiplinene •    Gjerne erfaring med hygienisk design og krav som stilles til mat- og farmasøytisk produksjon •    Du er initiativrik og løsningsorientert •    Du trives med å jobbe i team, liker å ta ansvar og kan jobbe selvstendig •    Gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk kreves HVA VI TILBYR Vi kan tilby deg en spennende rolle i en bedrift med et globalt fokus. Vi har et faglig sterkt miljø og imøtekommende og hyggelige kolleger. Vi har som målsetning å skape innovative løsninger som oppfyller nåværende og fremtidige behov i samfunnet. Vi gir deg ansvar fra dag en, og vi arbeider kontinuerlig med utviklingen av vårt arbeidsmiljø og byggingen av en god prestasjonskultur. Vi er opptatt av de ansattes personlige vekst, og legger forholdene til rette for nye utfordringer og utviklingsmuligheter i hele konsernet. HVORDAN DU SØKER Du søker gjennom vår søknadsportal. Du må laste opp CVen din, søknadsbrev og dokumentasjon på utdanning, og svare på spørsmålene som er oppgitt i søknadsportalen. Vi vil intervjue kandidater fortløpende, så vi anbefaler at du søker så snart som mulig. Har du spørsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Elin Kulås, Technology Development Manager, elin.kulas@basf.com. Du kan kontakte vårt rekrutteringsteam her: Kontakt Informasjon om vår søknadsprosess kan finnes her: Søknad OM OSS Hos BASF skaper vi kjemi for en bærekraftig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk suksess med miljøvern og sosialt ansvar. Mer enn 111 000 ansatte i BASF-gruppen bidrar til suksessen til våre kunder i nesten alle sektorer og nesten alle land i verden. Vår portefølje er organisert i seks segmenter: Kjemikalier, materialer, industrielle løsninger, overflateteknologi, ernæring & helse og landbruksløsninger. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. jobs.description:
Now hiring! Warehouse Manager Buena Park, CA We are looking for a Warehouse Manager to join our team in Buena Park, CA. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Surventis is seeking an experienced Warehouse Manager to lead daily warehouse and site operations at our Buena Park distribution facility supporting the Automotive Refinish Coatings business. This role is accountable for safe, compliant and efficient warehousing, inventory integrity, transportation coordination, team leadership, site security, and customer-focused operational performance. As a Warehouse Manager, you will... Lead receiving, put-away, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, returns and related warehouse activities. Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, physical inventories, discrepancy investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Lead, coach, schedule and develop warehouse employees and temporary labor while building a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable OSHA, DOT, EPA, California, hazardous-materials, hazardous-waste, fire-code and local requirements. Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation with Customer Service, Supply Chain, carriers and service providers. Improve warehouse layout, slotting, space utilization, material flow, productivity, quality, service and cost performance. Serve as the primary on-site contact for operational issues, audits, inspections, security, emergency response, visitors and contractors. Use SAP tools to execute inventory and shipment transactions, monitor performance and resolve exceptions. If you have... Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field. At least 7 years of warehouse, distribution, or logistics experience, including 3 years leading warehouse teams. Experience handling hazardous materials or operating in a regulated distribution environment. Working knowledge of SAP or a comparable ERP or warehouse management system. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience in automotive refinish, coatings, chemicals, manufacturing, or a related industry preferred. Experience managing transportation providers or third-party logistics partners preferred. Lean Six Sigma, APICS/ASCM, CSCMP, or comparable training or certification preferred. jobs.name: Production Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Production Technician Central, SC We are looking for a Production Technician to join our Performance Materials team in Clemson, SC. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. The BASF Performance Materials business responds quickly to customer needs, without cutting corners to sacrifice safety or quality.  The business services a wide range of customers in many different markets from automotive, construction, refrigeration, appliances, etc.  The operators within the Clemson Site must adapt to change safely, quickly, and efficiently while maintaining the highest quality requirements.   The Operator III manufactures blended resin systems for foam application to meet our customer needs. **This role works around a 3 rotating shift. Shift hours are: 1st Shift: 5am -1:30pm 2nd Shift: 1pm – 9:30pm 3rd Shift: 9pm – 5:30am During your rotating shift as a Production Technician, you will Use product recipes to produce blended resin systems in multiple blend vessels including the PSM process. Have knowledge of raw materials and the hazards, locations, etc. of those raw materials and knowledgeable of the process equipment. Use interface screens to the process control system to add exact quantities of chemicals to match product recipes, follow step by step batch instructions, and take samples as required. Load drums, totes, cylinders, and tank trucks with the final product. Unload raw materials via rail car to bulk storage, tank truck to bulk storage tank, tank truck to tote, and box vans of drums & totes. Follow standard operating procedures to unload and check-in various raw materials for production. Be an integral part of the site’s safety culture. This individual is responsible for certain areas of the plant from a safety and housekeeping perspective.  Operator I will also be required to master a certain number of standard operating procedure. Train in Department of Transportation (DOT). This individual must be able to understand hazard communication and DOT OSHA requirements for chemical transportation, storage, and handling. Understand how to use personal protective equipment to perform all necessary job functions within the process. Be able to become a certified forklift driver. If you... Possess a High School Diploma (2 Year technical degree preferred) Have good communication skills Have a high level of attention to detail Are able to lift at least 50lbs. ** ‘Selected candidate is going to be HAZMAT trained by the site for which he would need to be clean shaved. This is to ensure any activity that requires the candidate to wear a respirator, the fit is adequate. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.description: M ain Tasks Functional Tasks (Inclusive but not limited): You will draft, review, and negotiate until close out local or international contracts, agreements, using BASF approved templates and playbooks. You will provide legal and compliance support on various matters as assigned to you by your supervisor from time to time, including but not limited to documentary reviews, transactional due diligence, M&A projects, audits, compliance and legal investigations. You will manage the contract lifecycle, ensure process efficiency, and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of contract templates and knowledge management systems. You will interact with internal clients and external customers as required for your assigned tasks. You will perform ancillary tasks such as attending meetings, preparing minutes of meetings, presentations, usage of legal tech tools including AI, and handling translations. Open to experiences in contracts & agreement, procurement, quantity surveyor. You are fluent in English and Thai language, enabling you to successfully contribute to an international environment. You are used to work with legal databases and standard IT applications with familiarity with AI an added advantage. Able to communicate with teammates and stakeholders effectively and timely, raise concerns, employ utmost respect, respectful of the chain of command and deploys courtesy in all aspects of your work. Your very good analytical skills, your goal-oriented approach and your pronounced customer orientation make you an important member of our team.

In Ihrer neuen Position entwickeln Sie die B2B-Marketingstrategie für den Industriepark Lausitz sowie dessen Geschäftsfelder und Services und setzen diese eigenständig um. Dabei sorgen Sie für eine klare Positionierung des Standorts in relevanten Zielmärkten und entwickeln hierfür überzeugende Leistungsversprechen und zielgruppengerechte Botschaften. Gemeinsam zum Erfolg: Sie konzipieren Kampagnen zur Generierung qualifizierter Leads sowie konkreter Ansiedlungs- und Serviceanfragen und entwickeln zielgruppenspezifische Vertriebsunterlagen, Präsentationen, Standortprofile, Landingpages und Case Studies. Sie sind proaktiv: Sie koordinieren Kunden-, Investoren-, Messe- und Netzwerkaktivitäten mit definiertem Marketing- oder Leadziel und sorgen für deren zielgerichtete Umsetzung. jobs.name: ASEAN Finance Manager (Platform & Operations)
jobs.description:
Objectives of the position: The ASEAN Finance Manager (Platform & Operations) leads local finance activities across Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Singapore, ensuring effective statutory reporting, tax, treasury, audit, compliance and finance governance. The role provides functional leadership to country finance resources and coordinates closely with BPO providers and regional expert teams. Because the platform operates with a lean team, this is a hands-on leadership role. The manager directly participates in Thailand operational finance activities, reviews the work of the Thailand Senior Accountant and remains accountable for significant judgments, escalations and stakeholder coordination. Core responsibilities: ASEAN Finance Leadership Lead and coordinate local finance activities across the ASEAN platform. Set priorities, clarify accountabilities and align country resources with regional and global requirements. Ensure timely completion and appropriate review of statutory, tax, audit and compliance deliverables. Drive consistent accounting, control and governance standards across countries while respecting local requirements. Hands-on Thailand Finance Operations Actively participate in Thailand month-end, statutory reporting, tax, audit, treasury and compliance activities. Review key reconciliations, statutory schedules, tax filings and other deliverables prepared by the Senior Accountant or service providers. Provide technical guidance on complex or non-routine accounting and tax matters. Lead significant discussions with auditors, tax advisors, banks, authorities and internal stakeholders. Step into operational activities when required to ensure business continuity and timely delivery. Statutory Reporting, Audit & Compliance Oversee statutory reporting and external audit activities across the covered countries. Ensure local regulatory deliverables are completed accurately and on time. Monitor relevant accounting and regulatory developments and coordinate impact assessment. Track significant audit findings, compliance gaps and remediation actions. Tax Governance Oversee VAT or GST, withholding tax, corporate income tax and related local tax compliance. Coordinate with regional tax teams and external tax advisors. Review and escalate significant tax risks, uncertain positions and non-routine transactions. Support transfer pricing and other required tax documentation and governance activities. Treasury & Cash Management Oversee local banking, cash visibility and treasury coordination. Review cash forecasts and local liquidity requirements. Coordinate with regional treasury on bank accounts, funding and controls. Support resolution of significant banking and treasury matters. BPO & Service Provider Governance Govern outsourced finance services and define clear interfaces between local teams, BPO providers and regional functions. Monitor service levels, quality, controls and unresolved issues. Lead escalations and drive root-cause resolution and continuous improvement. Ensure retained local responsibilities are adequately performed and documented. Transformation & TSA Exit Lead finance readiness and transition activities for Day-2 operations. Support TSA exit, carve-out, ERP deployment and finance process transformation. Coordinate knowledge transfer, control readiness and stabilization activities. Drive sustainable process design and reduce unnecessary duplication between local teams and external providers. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead, coach and develop country finance team members. Build collaboration across Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Singapore. Act as the principal finance contact for local management, regional finance, tax, treasury, auditors, advisors and BPO partners. Communicate risks, decisions, dependencies and progress clearly to senior stakeholders. Professional and educational qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field; CPA, ACCA or equivalent qualification preferred. Approximately 10-15 years of finance and accounting experience, including meaningful leadership responsibility. Experience supporting or overseeing multiple ASEAN countries. Strong hands-on background in statutory accounting, tax, audit and local compliance. Experience with shared services, BPO governance, carve-outs, TSA exits or finance transformation is highly desirable. Manufacturing or multinational company experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, tax governance, internal controls and treasury processes. Ability to review detailed operational work and resolve complex accounting or compliance issues. SAP experience preferred; SAP S/4HANA and finance transformation exposure are advantageous. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills. Professional proficiency in Thai and English. Hands-on leader who can balance regional governance with local execution. Sound judgment, strong risk awareness and disciplined escalation. Able to lead effectively in a lean organization with changing priorities. Collaborative and credible with country teams, senior stakeholders and external parties. Strong ownership of delivery, controls and license-to-operate requirements. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Service Unit Global Engineering Services crafts and engineers a sustainable future with world class technical expertise. Our interdisciplinary, global, committed teams serve the BASF businesses to grow with our customers, products and markets. We add value by delivering competitive execution of investments. On construction sites across the globe, we deliver safe and reliable solutions to build and keep BASF assets operating at top performance. In doing so, we continuously improve and drive digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In the field of industrial communications technology, we support operations with industrial and hazard communication technology. In addition to conventional system technologies, we use innovative technologies for early hazard detection in the process industry. You will support us in the further development and implementation of our solutions. Possible topics include artificial intelligence (AI), PLC programming, computer vision, evaluation of innovative technologies. The focus of your work will be jointly determined depending on your interests and skills. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work for this purpose in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team, in which you will present and discuss your results and implement them in the companies. WHAT YOU OFFER advanced bachelor's or master's degree in a STEM field of study good programming skills (e.g. Python, C/C++, Codesys) advantageous: knowledge in software versioning and MLOps (e.g. Git, DVC), machine learning, computer vision, network technology very good communication in German and English independent familiarization with new topics as well as the ability to actively contribute your ideas to the team we look forward to receiving your application documents, including a current certificate of enrollment. if it is a compulsory internship, please attach your study regulations or a corresponding document certifying the duration of the compulsory internship to your complete application documents WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Yulia Haars (Talent Acquisition), yulia.haars@basf.com, will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
